paras.en: Butler creates a psychological profile of Asimov, determining that he’s a “contrarian” who “wants to be romanced.” Knowing he’s a fan of Bob Dylan, Butler just happens to be playing a Dylan song on the piano when Asimov shows up for a tasting. While Asimov pans the first glass of smoky wine, Butler tries again, by pretending it's actually a glass of Barolo, the same stuff Asimov says he fell in love with when he first got into wine. “I have no complaints,” Asimov says—an endorsement that Butler promptly attaches to Fumare’s label.
paras.zh: 巴特勒对阿西莫夫进行了心理分析，认为他是一个“想要浪漫”的“逆向者”。巴特勒知道自己是鲍勃·迪伦的粉丝，当阿西莫夫出现品酒时，他恰好在钢琴上弹奏迪伦的歌曲。当阿西莫夫倒出第一杯烟熏酒时，巴特勒再次尝试，假装这实际上是一杯巴罗洛葡萄酒，阿西莫夫说他第一次接触葡萄酒时就爱上了同样的东西。 “我没有任何抱怨，”阿西莫夫说道，巴特勒立即将这一认可贴在了富马雷的标签上。

paras.en: In another episode, Butler starts an AI dating company called Sole, but instead of matching people with a chatbot, as he’s purporting to do, he matches them with other humans to see if they connect.
paras.zh: 在另一集中，巴特勒创办了一家名为 Sole 的人工智能约会公司，但他并没有像他声称的那样将人们与聊天机器人进行匹配，而是将他们与其他人进行匹配，看看他们是否有联系。

paras.en: “The idea was that people trust in the technology more than a conversation with one another,” he says.
paras.zh: “我们的想法是，人们对技术的信任超过了彼此之间的对话，”他说。

paras.en: These days, many of Butler’s stunts either directly or indirectly relate to Big Tech—for good reason.
paras.zh: 如今，巴特勒的许多特技都直接或间接与大型科技公司相关——这是有充分理由的。

paras.en: “A lot of it is built on speculative promises and the idea of utopia rather than connected to reality. Tech CEOs constantly coming out and lying about what they’ll be able to do in 10 years to shit-coin their stock price,” he says, adding that the sector is “riddled with inauthenticity.”
paras.zh: “其中很多都是建立在投机性承诺和乌托邦的想法之上，而不是与现实联系在一起。科技公司的首席执行官们经常出面撒谎，谎称他们将在 10 年内做什么，以拉低股价，”他说，并补充说该行业“充满了不真实性”。

paras.en: Despite having the backing of HBO, his own work still feels authentic and haphazard, as opposed to overly polished. He says it’s usually just him and a couple of other people carrying out the stunts. “One of the episodes was basically me and me in my bedroom,” he says, noting that while he’s been working on the finale for six years, originally envisioning it as a feature film, all the others except for the pilot were shot in the last eight months.
paras.zh: 尽管有 HBO 的支持，他自己的作品仍然给人真实和随意的感觉，而不是过于精致。他说通常只有他和其他几个人来表演特技。 “其中一集基本上是我和我在卧室里，”他说，并指出虽然他花了六年的时间来制作结局，最初将其设想为一部故事片，但除了试播集之外的所有其他剧集都是在过去八个月内拍摄的。

paras.en: “There’s a DIY characteristic to the stuff anyway, and I want the people watching to not feel excluded from the pieces of it. And that's always a thing where I'm like, ‘Oh, if the budget for the show was much bigger, it might not feel like this anymore,’” he tells me.
paras.zh: “无论如何，这些东西都有一种 DIY 的特点，我希望观看的人不会感到被排除在外。我总是会想，‘哦，如果节目的预算大得多，可能就不会再有这样的感觉了，’”他告诉我。

paras.en: Considering all the pranks he’s pulled off, I ask him point-blank if it’s a bad idea for people to answer the phone when he calls. He rebuffs, pressing me for my take.
paras.zh: 考虑到他搞过的所有恶作剧，我直截了当地问他，当他打电话时，人们接电话是不是一个坏主意。他拒绝了，并催促我接受。

paras.en: Truthfully, I think there’s a high chance that if you engage with Butler on camera, you’ll come off looking like a fool—particularly if you’re someone with any type of clout. But for the sake of my own entertainment, I hope people keep doing it.
paras.zh: 说实话，我认为如果你在镜头前与巴特勒互动，你很有可能看起来像个傻瓜——特别是如果你是一个有影响力的人。但为了我自己的娱乐，我希望人们继续这样做。

paras.en: Styling by Ashley Jebran. Grooming by Jennifer Brent at Forward Artists using Aseop. Jewelry shop FraDia.
paras.zh: 造型由 Ashley Jebran 设计。由 Jennifer Brent 在 Forward Artists 使用 Aseop 进行美容。珠宝店 FraDia。

articles.title: They’re Young, Frustrated and Want France to Change. They Disagree on How.
articles.author: Ségolène Le Stradic

paras.en: Soumaya Sarré, 18, is a history and Arabic studies undergraduate who grew up in a working-class district on the edge of Paris. She is a voice of the youth-led protests that have spurred unrest across France since September. “I can carry our voices, the voices of young people from working-class neighborhoods,” she told me.
paras.zh: 18 岁的苏玛亚·萨雷 (Soumaya Sarré) 是一名历史和阿拉伯研究专业的本科生，在巴黎边缘的一个工人阶级地区长大。她是青年领导的抗议活动的代言人，这些抗议活动自九月以来引发了法国各地的骚乱。 “我可以传达我们的声音，来自工人阶级社区年轻人的声音，”她告诉我。

paras.en: Louise Montangon, 22, is a philosophy undergraduate from rural France. As the student protests gained momentum, she became one of their leading critics, regularly condemning the young demonstrators on television panels and social media. “The majority of university and high school students actually want to attend their classes,” she said in an interview.
paras.zh: 22 岁的路易丝·蒙坦贡 (Louise Montangon) 是一名来自法国农村的哲学本科生。随着学生抗议活动的势头增强，她成为主要批评者之一，经常在电视面板和社交媒体上谴责年轻的示威者。 “大多数大学生和高中生实际上都想参加他们的课程，”她在接受采访时说。

paras.en: Unknown to the public until this fall, these two women from opposite ends of the political spectrum have surfaced as emblems of the combustible French moment, which was set to intensify again on Tuesday with more strikes and protests.
paras.zh: 直到今年秋天，公众才知道，这两名来自政治光谱两端的女性已经成为法国易燃时刻的象征，周二，这一时刻将再次加剧，引发更多罢工和抗议活动。

paras.en: Ms. Sarré and Ms. Montangon aren’t formal leaders of their political camps, and their sudden prominence partly reflects society’s tendency to search for avatars for leaderless movements. Their simultaneous rise, and their divergent politics, nevertheless reflect the polarization of French society, and particularly its youth — five months from a presidential election dominated by candidates from the far-left and the far-right.
paras.zh: 萨雷女士和蒙坦贡女士并不是各自政治阵营的正式领导人，她们的突然崛起在一定程度上反映了社会寻找无领导运动的化身的倾向。然而，他们的同时崛起和政治分歧反映了法国社会，特别是年轻人的两极分化——距离由极左翼和极右翼候选人主导的总统选举还有五个月。

paras.en: Polls of people under 25 suggest that more than 40 percent support the main far-left candidate, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, while more than 20 percent back his far-right opponent, Marine Le Pen. In legislative elections in 2024, nearly half of voters from that age group voted for Mr. Mélenchon’s party, and a third voted for Ms. Le Pen’s.
paras.zh: 对 25 岁以下人群的民意调查显示，超过 40% 的人支持主要的极左翼候选人让-吕克·梅朗雄 (Jean-Luc Mélenchon)，而超过 20% 的人支持他的极右翼对手马琳·勒庞 (Marine Le Pen)。在 2024 年的立法选举中，该年龄段的近一半选民投票给梅朗雄的政党，三分之一的选民投票给勒庞的政党。

paras.en: Support for moderate solutions has plummeted after years of centrist governance under Emmanuel Macron, France’s term-limited president.
paras.zh: 在法国任期有限的总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 的多年中间派治理之后，对温和解决方案的支持大幅下降。

articles.title: Leaked Records Show Deutsche Bank Courting Russian Oligarchs
articles.author: Russ Buettner, Khadija Sharife, Brian Fitzpatrick, Frederik Obermaier, Bastian Obermayer and Sophia Baumann

paras.en: When Russian missiles began pummeling Ukraine in February 2022, executives at one of the world’s largest banks sensed trouble headed their way.
paras.zh: 2022 年 2 月，当俄罗斯导弹开始袭击乌克兰时，全球最大银行之一的高管意识到麻烦即将来临。

paras.en: Within hours of an invasion that set off a war that is now in its fifth year, Western governments issued new financial sanctions intended to further isolate Russia from the world economy.
paras.zh: 入侵引发的战争已进入第五个年头，在数小时内，西方政府发布了新的金融制裁，旨在进一步将俄罗斯与世界经济隔离。

paras.en: At Deutsche Bank, a longtime bank of Russian industry titans and oligarchs, officials scrambled to get ahead of the damage. “Russian Sanctions Urgent Request” read the subject line of an email sent by one of Deutsche’s anti-financial crime specialists to her colleagues.
paras.zh: 德意志银行是一家由俄罗斯工业巨头和寡头组成的长期银行，官员们争先恐后地应对损失。德意志银行的一位反金融犯罪专家向她的同事发送了一封电子邮件，其主题行是“俄罗斯制裁紧急请求”。

paras.en: “As you know we have a large Russian Oligarchs client population” and other clients with investments in Russian companies, she wrote. She asked which of those clients “we potentially could unwind and which not.” Should the bank advise them, she wondered, to withdraw their money “while they still can?”
paras.zh: 她写道，“如你所知，我们拥有大量俄罗斯寡头客户”以及对俄罗斯公司进行投资的其他客户。她询问哪些客户“我们可能可以放松，哪些不能”。她想知道，银行是否应该建议他们“趁他们还可以”提取资金？

paras.en: This email exchange was the beginning of a frenzied reckoning within the scandal-plagued bank over its long resistance to breaking with Russia’s most important business titans under Vladimir V. Putin, the Russian president. The bank’s clients included the Russian billionaires Oleg V. Deripaska and Viktor F. Vekselberg. Time and again over many years, records show, Deutsche Bank’s risk managers warned that such relationships were perilous.
paras.zh: 这次电子邮件往来是这家饱受丑闻困扰的银行内部疯狂清算的开始，该银行长期以来一直拒绝与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京(Vladimir V. Putin)领导下的俄罗斯最重要的商业巨头决裂。该银行的客户包括俄罗斯亿万富翁奥列格·V·德里帕斯卡（Oleg V. Deripaska）和维克托·F·维克塞尔伯格（Viktor F. Vekselberg）。记录显示，德意志银行的风险经理多年来一再警告这种关系是危险的。

paras.en: But profits associated with maintaining its Russian clients won out every time.
paras.zh: 但与维护俄罗斯客户相关的利润每次都会获胜。

paras.en: Russia’s war in Ukraine swept up Deutsche Bank in a larger shift. For decades, German politicians and business leaders believed that working with Russia and deepening economic ties between the two countries would discourage Russian aggression. That strategy collapsed after the invasion.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争给德意志银行带来了更大的转变。几十年来，德国政界人士和商界领袖相信，与俄罗斯合作并深化两国之间的经济联系将阻止俄罗斯的侵略。这一战略在入侵后崩溃了。

articles.title: Japan’s Suica Penguin Mascot Is Retiring. Fans Are Taking It Hard.
articles.author: Kiuko Notoya and Yan Zhuang

paras.en: For more than two decades, train commuters in Japan have had a faithful companion on their daily journeys: the Suica penguin. But the little black-and-white bird will soon take its last ride.
paras.zh: 二十多年来，日本的火车通勤者在日常旅途中都有一个忠实的伴侣：Suica 企鹅。但这只黑白相间的小鸟很快就要进行最后一次飞行了。

paras.en: One of Japan’s largest rail operators adopted the penguin as the mascot for its prepaid smart cards, known as Suica cards, in 2001. On the cards, the penguin is smiling and waving as it walks.
paras.zh: 日本最大的铁路运营商之一于 2001 年采用企鹅作为其预付费智能卡（称为 Suica 卡）的吉祥物。卡上的企鹅在行走时微笑并挥手。

paras.en: The East Japan Railway Company, or JR East, announced the character’s retirement last year, and in September the company held an international public vote to pick a new mascot.
paras.zh: 东日本旅客铁道公司（JR East）去年宣布该角色退役，并于 9 月举行了国际公众投票，选出了新的吉祥物。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the company will announce which new character will replace the penguin. And in a country that loves its mascots, many people have strong opinions.
paras.zh: 周三，该公司将宣布哪个新角色将取代企鹅。在一个热爱吉祥物的国家，很多人都有强烈的意见。

paras.en: On Monday afternoon, at Sakuragicho railway station, southwest of Tokyo, customers at a store selling merchandise featuring the Suica penguin lamented the loss of a familiar presence.
paras.zh: 周一下午，在东京西南部的樱木町火车站，一家出售 Suica 企鹅商品的商店里，顾客们对失去熟悉的形象感到遗憾。

paras.en: “I was really shocked when it was announced that the character would be ‘graduating,’” said Eriko Inoue, using JR East’s term for the outgoing penguin. Ms. Inoue, 50, a part-time nursery teacher, was stocking up on merchandise in case the company discontinued some of it after the penguin’s retirement.
paras.zh: “当宣布这个角色将‘毕业’时，我真的很震惊，”井上绘里子（Eriko Inoue）说道，她用的是 JR 东日本对即将离任的企鹅的称呼。 50 岁的井上女士是一名兼职托儿所老师，她正在储备商品，以防公司在企鹅退休后停产一些商品。

articles.title: Selena Gomez No Longer Facing Lawsuit Over Mental Health Startup Wondermind
articles.author: Rachel Scharf

paras.en: Investors in Selena Gomez’s mental health startup Wondermind have dropped their fraud lawsuit against the star and company.
paras.zh: 赛琳娜·戈麦斯 (Selena Gomez) 心理健康初创公司 Wondermind 的投资者已撤销对这位明星和公司的欺诈诉讼。

paras.en: A Monday (Nov. 16) court notice, obtained and first reported by Billboard, says that five investors are permanently dismissing the claims they brought in August against Wondermind, Gomez, her mother Mandy Teefey and former company executive Daniella Pierson. Gomez’s attorney, Mathew Rosengart, told Billboard on Monday, “Selena is pleased by the dismissal of the case on the heels of our motion to dismiss on her behalf, and looks forward to putting this matter behind her.”
paras.zh: Billboard 获得并首先报道的周一（11 月 16 日）法庭通知称，五名投资者将永久驳回他们在 8 月份对 Wondermind、Gomez、她的母亲 Mandy Teefey 和前公司高管 Daniella Pierson 提出的索赔。戈麦斯的律师马修·罗森加特 (Mathew Rosengart) 周一对《公告牌》表示，“在我们代表她提出驳回动议后，赛琳娜对案件被驳回感到高兴，并期待着把这件事抛在脑后。”

paras.en: A lawyer for Pierson, Scott Balber, told Billboard on Monday that they did not pay any settlement in the case. “Ms. Pierson did nothing wrong,” said Balber. “Apparently, the plaintiff recognized that and dismissed the complaint against her. Unfortunately, Ms. Pierson’s reputation has already been damaged by these false allegations. We are hopeful that the dismissal of the lawsuit will be the first step in restoring her good name.”
paras.zh: 皮尔森的律师斯科特·巴尔伯周一告诉《公告牌》，他们没有为此案支付任何和解金。 “皮尔森女士没有做错任何事，”巴尔伯说。 “显然，原告认识到了这一点，并驳回了对她的起诉。不幸的是，皮尔森女士的声誉已经因这些虚假指控而受损。我们希望驳回诉讼将成为恢复她名誉的第一步。”

paras.en: Teefey and the investors’ attorneys did not immediately return requests for comment.
paras.zh: 蒂菲和投资者律师没有立即回复置评请求。

paras.en: Wondermind launched in 2021 with Teefey and Pierson as co-CEOs and public support from Gomez. The plan was for the company to host a suite of mental health media initiatives, including a digital magazine, mobile app and podcast.
paras.zh: Wondermind 于 2021 年推出，Teefey 和 Pierson 担任联合首席执行官，并得到了 Gomez 的公众支持。该公司计划举办一系列心理健康媒体活动，包括数字杂志、移动应用程序和播客。

paras.en: An investment vehicle run by five men — Brent Saunders, Marc Roberts, EJ Solimine, Andrew Resnick and Mark Peikin — put $1.2 million into Wondermind in 2022. In the August lawsuit, the investors alleged they were duped by false promises that Gomez would be actively involved as Wondermind’s head of marketing, thus leveraging her huge fanbase and 400 million Instagram followers. They were also allegedly told that Wondermind had a “potential future valuation” of more than $4 billion and solid brand partnerships in place already.
paras.zh: 由布伦特·桑德斯 (Brent Saunders)、马克·罗伯茨 (Marc Roberts)、EJ Solimine、安德鲁·雷斯尼克 (Andrew Resnick) 和马克·佩金 (Mark Peikin) 等五人经营的投资机构于 2022 年向 Wondermind 投资了 120 万美元。在 8 月份的诉讼中，投资者声称他们被虚假承诺欺骗，戈麦斯将作为 Wondermind 的营销主管积极参与其中，从而利用她庞大的粉丝群和 4 亿 Instagram 粉丝。据称，他们还被告知 Wondermind 的“未来潜在估值”超过 40 亿美元，并且已经建立了稳固的品牌合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: Last year, The Cut published a bombshell investigation reporting that Gomez had distanced herself from Wondermind and that the company’s finances were in dire condition, due in part to Teefey’s alleged substance abuse issues and erratic behavior. According to the lawsuit, this article led the investors to believe they’d been defrauded. They asked for their money back and, when it didn’t come, resorted to litigation.
paras.zh: 去年，The Cut 发表了一份爆炸性的调查报告，称戈麦斯已与 Wondermind 保持距离，并且该公司的财务状况状况不佳，部分原因是蒂菲涉嫌滥用药物问题和不稳定的行为。根据诉讼称，这篇文章让投资者相信他们被骗了。他们要求退款，但没有收到退款，于是诉诸诉讼。

paras.en: Gomez’s team was quick to argue that she did not belong in the lawsuit. Rosengart called the case “absurd” in court papers, saying Gomez had no involvement in Wondermind’s fundraising operations and “should never have been dragged into this action.”
paras.zh: 戈麦斯的团队很快辩称她不属于这起诉讼。罗森加特在法庭文件中称此案“荒谬”，称戈麦斯没有参与 Wondermind 的筹款活动，“不应该被拖入这一行动”。

paras.en: The other defendants had not responded to the lawsuit in writing by the time of Monday’s dismissal. In the Cut article, Teefey denied allegations of company mismanagement and said Wondermind remained viable: “I started Wondermind because I wanted to help people with mental illness,” Teefey said in a statement to the magazine. “It’s unfortunate that a few disgruntled employees with an ax to grind can spread lies about me and distort the truth. Even more disappointing that the media is willing to amplify their lies.”
paras.zh: 截至周一驳回诉讼时，其他被告尚未对诉讼作出书面回应。在 Cut 文章中，蒂菲否认了有关公司管理不善的指控，并表示 Wondermind 仍然可行：“我创办 Wondermind 是因为我想帮助患有精神疾病的人，”蒂菲在给该杂志的一份声明中说。 “不幸的是，一些心存不满的员工怀揣着恶意，散布关于我的谎言，歪曲事实。更令人失望的是，媒体竟然愿意放大他们的谎言。”

articles.title: Kelly Clarkson Calls ‘The Voice’ Contestant Kyle Davis ‘a Born Storyteller’ After Keane Cover
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Kelly Clarkson delivered one of the biggest compliments of the season to her own team member during Monday night’s (Nov. 16) live episode of The Voice, telling 61-year-old Kyle Davis that his competition was in trouble.
paras.zh: 凯莉·克拉克森 (Kelly Clarkson) 在周一晚上（11 月 16 日）的《好声音》现场直播中向自己的团队成员表达了本赛季最大的赞美之一，她告诉 61 岁的凯尔·戴维斯 (Kyle Davis)，他的竞争对手遇到了麻烦。

paras.en: Davis took on Keane’s 2004 single “Somewhere Only We Know” for the second half of season 30’s Y2K-themed Top 13 showcase, and Clarkson couldn’t contain herself when it was time for feedback.
paras.zh: 戴维斯在第 30 季以千禧年为主题的 Top 13 展示会的后半部分中演唱了基恩 2004 年的单曲“Somewhere Only We Know”，而克拉克森在需要反馈时无法控制自己。

paras.en: “I actually feel sorry for everyone else in this competition,” she told him. “Your tone is so incredible! Like, you’re a born storyteller. I know you’ve been doing it for a minute, but there’s something so easy and effortless. I’m so proud I’m your coach. Well done.”
paras.zh: “我实际上为这场比赛中的其他人感到遗憾，”她告诉他。 “你的语气太不可思议了！就像，你是一个天生的讲故事的人。我知道你已经做了一分钟了，但有一些事情是如此简单和毫不费力。我很自豪我是你的教练。干得好。”

paras.en: The moment was a full-circle one for Davis, who wasn’t among Clarkson’s picks for the live shows. Each of the four coaches — Clarkson, Riley Green, Queen Latifah and Adam Levine — chose three of their artists to advance, with viewers handed one pick to round out the Top 13. America chose Davis, the season’s oldest contestant and a decades-long music industry veteran.
paras.zh: 对于戴维斯来说，这一刻是一个完整的循环，他并不在克拉克森的现场表演选择之列。四位教练——克拉克森、莱利·格林、奎因·拉蒂法和亚当·莱文——各自选择了三位艺术家晋级，观众们选出了一位进入前 13 名的选手。美国队选择了戴维斯，他是本赛季最年长的参赛者，也是数十年音乐界的资深人士。

paras.en: “I got a call that said I’d won America’s vote,” Davis said in a pre-performance package. “Thank you for voting for me. I couldn’t even process it. Totally shocked. I mean, it’s really an honor.” He also gifted Clarkson a mood ring during rehearsals.
paras.zh: “我接到电话说我赢得了美国人的选票，”戴维斯在演出前的一份文件中说道。 “谢谢你投票给我。我什至无法接受。完全震惊。我的意思是，这真的是一种荣幸。”他还在排练期间送给克拉克森一枚情绪戒指。

paras.en: With Team Queen and Team Adam having performed the previous week, Monday’s episode belonged to Team Kelly and Team Riley. The setlist pulled from Christina Aguilera’s “Reflection” and The Chicks’ “Cowboy Take Me Away,” among others, and the packed broadcast left the coaches little time for commentary.
paras.zh: 由于 Team Queen 和 Team Adam 上周已经表演过，周一的节目属于 Team Kelly 和 Team Riley。节目单取材于克里斯蒂娜·阿奎莱拉的《Reflection》和小鸡乐队的《Cowboy Take Me Away》等，而拥挤的转播让教练们几乎没有时间发表评论。

paras.en: Green did make room to praise Joe Henley, who covered Lee Ann Womack’s “I Hope You Dance.” “Joe, you crushed it, man,” the country star said. “You’re one of the most naturally talented people on this show, and how much better you continue to get and how much you continue to step up when you have an opportunity like you did tonight, I’m so impressed with it. I’m proud of you.”
paras.zh: 格林确实腾出了空间赞扬乔·亨利，他翻唱了李·安·沃马克的《我希望你跳舞》。 “乔，你粉碎了它，伙计，”这位乡村明星说。 “你是这个节目中最有天赋的人之一，当你有像今晚这样的机会时，你会继续进步，继续进步，我对此印象深刻。我为你感到骄傲。”

paras.en: By the end of the night, two artists were sent home: Team Kelly’s Anna McElroy, who sang Faith Hill’s “Breathe,” and Team Riley’s Cade Mower, who performed the Goo Goo Dolls’ “Iris.” They join Team Queen’s Lillie Kolich, who was eliminated last week after reworking Britney Spears’ “(You Drive Me) Crazy.”
paras.zh: 当晚结束时，两名艺术家被送回家：Kelly 队的 Anna McElroy 演唱了 Faith Hill 的《Breathe》，而 Riley 队的 Cade Mower 演唱了 Goo Goo Dolls 的《Iris》。他们加入了 Team Queen 的莉莉·科利奇 (Lillie Kolich) 行列，后者上周因改写布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 的《(You Drive Me) Crazy》而被淘汰。

paras.en: Season 30’s Top 10 is made up of Brianna Cameron, Kyle Davis and Koumba Diallo (Team Kelly); Ferryn and Brinkley and Joe Henley (Team Riley); Mia Knight and BigCountry (Team Queen); and Connor Closs, Lexi Stephens and Dakota Cohen (Team Adam).
paras.zh: 第 30 季的前 10 名由 Brianna Cameron、Kyle Davis 和 Koumba Diallo（凯利队）组成； Ferryn、Brinkley 和 Joe Henley（莱利队）； Mia Knight 和 BigCountry（Team Queen）；以及 Connor Closs、Lexi Stephens 和 Dakota Cohen（亚当团队）。

paras.en: The Voice airs Mondays at 9 p.m. ET on NBC and streams on Peacock.
paras.zh: 《好声音》每周一晚上 9 点播出。 ET 在 NBC 播出并在 Peacock 播出。

articles.title: Duetti Secures $665 Million Financing Round
articles.author: Elizabeth Dilts Marshall

paras.en: Catalog investment company Duetti has secured $665 million in financing following global investor Carlyle’s participation in its third asset-backed security (ABS) in two years, it announced Tuesday (Nov. 17).
paras.zh: 周二（11 月 17 日），目录投资公司 Duetti 宣布，继全球投资者凯雷投资公司两年内第三次参与其资产支持证券 (ABS) 后，该公司已获得 6.65 亿美元融资。

paras.en: The financing comes in the form of a $450 million ABS anchored by Carlyle, $165 million of additional credit from Duetti’s longtime bank, Viola Credit, and a $50 million side facility from Flexpoint Ford and Truist Bank. Flexpoint Ford is also an equity investor in Duetti.
paras.zh: 此次融资的形式包括凯雷 (Carlyle) 提供的 4.5 亿美元 ABS、Duetti 的长期合作银行 Viola Credit 提供的 1.65 亿美元额外信贷以及 Flexpoint Ford 和 Truist Bank 提供的 5,000 万美元附带贷款。 Flexpoint Ford 也是 Duetti 的股权投资者。

paras.en: Fast-growing Duetti has raised $1.3 billion since its launch in 2022 from equity investors like The Raine Group, Nyca Partners, Viola Ventures and ROC Nation, as well as from the debt markets. This securitization, worth more than three times Duetti’s last ABS of $125 million announced in January and issued with a higher rating, is a sign that institutional investors view Duetti as a maturing and stable business.
paras.zh: 快速增长的 Duetti 自 2022 年成立以来，已从 The Raine Group、Nyca Partners、Viola Ventures 和 ROC Nation 等股权投资者以及债务市场筹集了 13 亿美元。此次证券化的价值是 Duetti 在 1 月份宣布的上一次 ABS 1.25 亿美元的三倍多，并以更高的评级发行，这表明机构投资者认为 Duetti 是一家成熟且稳定的企业。

paras.en: “We anchored this securitization because independent music royalties can generate the kind of recurring, diversified cash flows that asset-backed finance is built around,” Akhil Bansal, Carlyle’s head of asset-backed finance, said in a statement. “Duetti pairs industry expertise with the data and technology to build and manage catalogs at scale, and that’s what gives us conviction in the platform.”
paras.zh: 凯雷资产支持融资主管阿基尔·班萨尔 (Akhil Bansal) 在一份声明中表示：“我们之所以支持这种证券化，是因为独立音乐版税可以产生资产支持融资所围绕的经常性、多元化的现金流。” “Duetti 将行业专业知识与数据和技术相结合，以大规模构建和管理目录，这让我们对该平台充满信心。”

paras.en: Carlyle’s asset-backed finance team sits within its global credit platform, which has deployed more than $17 billion into the sports, media and entertainment sectors since 2017.
paras.zh: 凯雷的资产支持金融团队隶属于其全球信贷平台，自 2017 年以来，该平台已向体育、媒体和娱乐领域投入了超过 170 亿美元。

paras.en: Duetti’s portfolio includes 50,000 master recordings and compositions by more than 3,000 recording artists, and the company continues to do around 80 transactions per month. The capital from this round of financing will be used to “significantly accelerate the pace and breadth of investment activities across genres and geographies, as well as different types of music rights,” the company said in a statement.
paras.zh: Duetti 的投资组合包括 3,000 多名唱片艺术家的 50,000 张母带唱片和作品，该公司每月继续进行约 80 笔交易。该公司在一份声明中表示，本轮融资的资金将用于“大幅加快跨流派、跨地区以及不同类型音乐版权的投资活动的步伐和广度”。

paras.en: “Our third ABS transaction in just two years is more than five times the size of our inaugural deal in 2024, demonstrating our rapid growth, strong track record and increasing institutional demand for our catalog and business model,” Duetti CEO and co-founder Lior Tibon said in a statement.
paras.zh: Duetti 首席执行官兼联合创始人 Lior Tibon 在一份声明中表示：“我们在短短两年内完成的第三笔 ABS 交易规模是 2024 年首笔交易规模的五倍多，这证明了我们的快速增长、良好的业绩记录以及机构对我们的目录和商业模式日益增长的需求。”

paras.en: Barclays, which handled both Duetti’s prior ABS transactions, led placement on this issuance.
paras.zh: 巴克莱银行曾负责Duetti的前两次资产支持证券交易，并牵头完成了此次发行的配售。

paras.en: “This latest transaction achieved a ratings upgrade and was placed with a broader group of institutional investors than the Company’s prior issuances, marking the continued expansion of its ABS program and investor base,” Salina Sabri, managing director at Barclays, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 巴克莱银行董事总经理萨利娜·萨布里(Salina Sabri)在一份声明中表示：“此次最新交易实现了评级升级，并获得了比该公司之前发行的更广泛的机构投资者群体，标志着其 ABS 计划和投资者基础的持续扩大。”

articles.title: Tallinn Market Debates Estonia’s Film Sector and How Foreign Shoots “Bring Both Value and Tension”
articles.author: Georg Szalai

paras.en: The Estonian film industry may be small but has big ambitions. And there is more that the Baltic country’s institutions can and must do to make the sector more sustainable as it balances big foreign productions visiting and local work. Those were key messages of an event at the 25th edition of the Industry@Tallinn & Baltic Event (ITBE) market, part of the 30th edition of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF).
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚电影业规模虽小，但雄心勃勃。这个波罗的海国家的机构可以而且必须做更多的事情来使该行业更具可持续性，因为它平衡了大型外国制作的访问和本地工作。这些是第 25 届 Industry@Tallinn & Baltic Event (ITBE) 市场活动的关键信息，该市场是第 30 届塔林黑夜电影节 (PÖFF) 的一部分。

paras.en: Lennart Mathias Männik and Kätlin Palm presented findings from their master’s theses. Among the data findings was that 74 Estonian films screened in the nation’s cinemas in 2025. “It’s not all new films. It’s films in general,” Männik shared. “And looking at our market and looking at our country size, it’s quite an achievement.”
paras.zh: Lennart Mathias Männik 和 Kätlin Palm 介绍了他们硕士论文的研究结果。数据显示，2025 年有 74 部爱沙尼亚电影在全国电影院上映。“这并不全是新电影。而是一般电影，”Männik 分享道。 “看看我们的市场和我们的国家规模，这是一项相当大的成就。”

paras.en: Admissions for Estonian films last year hit 334,471, making the domestic share of cinema admissions in Estonia account for 14 percent. The by far biggest public funding support came from the Estonian Film Institute at €10.9 million ($12.0 million), followed by the Cultural Endowment at €3.1 million ($3.4 million) and €1.7 million ($1.9 million).
paras.zh: 去年爱沙尼亚电影的观影人次达到334,471人次，占爱沙尼亚国内电影观影人次的14%。迄今为止最大的公共资金支持来自爱沙尼亚电影学院，提供 1,090 万欧元（1,200 万美元），其次是文化捐赠基金，提供 310 万欧元（340 万美元）和 170 万欧元（190 万美元）。

paras.en: Männik’s conclusion: Estonia has “a small domestic market, but a visible national cinema with an audience.” But he summarized what he sees as key for the future outlook this way: “building a stronger, more sustainable Estonian film industry.”
paras.zh: 曼尼克的结论是：爱沙尼亚“国内市场虽小，但全国电影院却拥有观众”。但他这样总结了他认为未来前景的关键：“建设一个更强大、更可持续的爱沙尼亚电影业。”

paras.en: Two key areas that need to be addressed: “underfunding limits production and creative freedom is under pressure” due to a lack of development resources and “rigid or unclear support expectations,” which can lead to creative caution.
paras.zh: 需要解决的两个关键领域是：由于缺乏开发资源，“资金不足限制了制作，创作自由受到压力”，以及“僵化或不明确的支持期望”，这可能会导致创作谨慎。

paras.en: Last but not least, foreign projects “bring both value and tension,” Männik highlighted. “Service productions [from abroad] bring investment, work and expertise but draw on the same limited workforce as domestic films. Without stronger local production capacity, international growth can leave Estonian films more vulnerable.”
paras.zh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，外国项目“既带来了价值，也带来了紧张感”，曼尼克强调。 “[来自国外的]服务制作带来了投资、工作和专业知识，但与国内电影一样，利用的劳动力也很有限。如果没有更强的本地制作能力，国际增长可能会让爱沙尼亚电影更加脆弱。”

paras.en: Among the foreign films and series shot in Estonia have been the likes of Paramount+ spy thriller series The Agency and Tenet.
paras.zh: 在爱沙尼亚拍摄的外国电影和连续剧包括派拉蒙+间谍惊悚片《特工》和《信条》等。

paras.en: His suggestions for the Estonian sector and its support: adopt a long-term audiovisual strategy, make funding more diverse and stable, and strengthen the whole production ecosystem.
paras.zh: 他对爱沙尼亚行业的建议及其支持：采取长期视听战略，使资金更加多样化和稳定，并加强整个制作生态系统。

paras.en: The big cutting-edge film studio complex Ida Hub just opened last month, with the goal of making Estonia’s Ida-Viru region a key production hub. But Männik highlighted: “Production conditions are only one part of how the ecosystem works.”
paras.zh: 大型尖端电影制片厂综合体 Ida Hub 于上个月刚刚开业，目标是使爱沙尼亚的 Ida-Viru 地区成为一个重要的制作中心。但曼尼克强调：“生产条件只是生态系统运作的一部分。”

articles.title: David Fincher’s ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’: First Reactions
articles.author: Abid Rahman

paras.en: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, the buzzy, David Fincher-directed standalone sequel to Quentin Tarantino‘s Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, held its premiere in Los Angeles on Monday evening and the first reactions have hit social media.
paras.zh: 大卫·芬奇执导的昆汀·塔伦蒂诺《好莱坞往事》的独立续集《克里夫·布斯的进一步错误冒险》于周一晚上在洛杉矶举行了首映，社交媒体上引起了第一反应。

paras.en: The embargo for full critics reviews for Cliff Booth is Nov. 19, but Netflix allowed some brief social media reaction to the film after its L.A. premiere. Cliff Booth is set to have a short, and very controversial, theatrical run, with the film being released exclusively in Imax cinemas on Nov. 25, before its Netflix streaming debut on Dec. 23.
paras.zh: 克里夫·布斯 (Cliff Booth) 的全面影评截止日期为 11 月 19 日，但 Netflix 允许社交媒体在洛杉矶首映后对这部电影做出一些简短的反应。克里夫·布斯 (Cliff Booth) 将于 11 月 25 日在 Imax 影院独家上映，并于 12 月 23 日在 Netflix 流媒体上首映，该片将在院线进行短暂且极具争议的放映。

paras.en: Cliff Booth sees Brad Pitt return as the titular character, the effortlessly cool veteran Hollywood stuntman we saw in Once Upon a Time. In the sequel, we see Pitt’s character as now more a part-time stuntman who seems to be doing odd, and sometimes dangerous, jobs in 1977 Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 克里夫·布斯 (Cliff Booth) 看到布拉德·皮特 (Brad Pitt) 回归，饰演主角，这位我们在《童话镇》中看到的毫不费力、酷炫的好莱坞老牌替身演员。在续集中，我们看到皮特的角色现在更像是一名兼职特技演员，他似乎在 1977 年的洛杉矶做着奇怪的、有时甚至是危险的工作。

paras.en: The ensemble cast includes Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Carla Gugino, Peter Weller, Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Corey Fogelmanis and Karren Karagulian.
paras.zh: 演员阵容包括伊丽莎白·德比茨基、斯科特·凯恩、叶海亚·阿卜杜勒-迈丁二世、卡拉·古奇诺、彼得·韦勒、马特·格罗夫、JB·塔德纳、科里·福格马尼斯和卡伦·卡拉古利安。

paras.en: Timothy Olyphant is the only other star from Once Upon a Time reprising his role, returning as Western actor James Stacy. At Monday evening’s premiere, Pitt explained why Once Upon a Time star Leonardo DiCaprio’s cameo as Rick Dalton in the sequel fell apart.
paras.zh: 蒂莫西·奥利芬特是《童话镇》中唯一一位再次出演该角色的明星，他以西部演员詹姆斯·史黛西的身份回归。在周一晚上的首映式上，皮特解释了为什么《童话镇》明星莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥在续集中客串瑞克·道尔顿失败了。

paras.en: Released by Sony Pictures in 2019, and written and directed by Tarantino, Once Upon a Time was a huge commercial and critical success. The film made $410 million at the box office and was nominated for 10 Oscars, winning two — Pitt for best supporting actor and Barbara Ling and Nancy Haigh for production design.
paras.zh: 《童话镇》由索尼影业于 2019 年发行，由塔伦蒂诺编剧和导演，取得了巨大的商业和评论成功。该片票房收入 4.1 亿美元，获得 10 项奥斯卡奖提名，并赢得两项奥斯卡奖：皮特获得最佳男配角奖，芭芭拉·林和南希·黑格获得最佳美术设计奖。

paras.en: Netflix purchased the script for Once Upon a Time‘s sequel from Tarantino in 2025 and engaged Fincher to direct. Fincher previously revealed that Cliff Booth was almost developed as a Netflix series instead of a movie, as Tarantino’s original script was 230 pages long. Fincher ended up cutting 60 pages.
paras.zh: Netflix 于 2025 年从塔伦蒂诺手中购买了《童话镇》续集的剧本，并聘请芬奇执导。芬奇此前透露，《克里夫·布斯》几乎是作为 Netflix 剧集而不是电影来开发的，因为塔伦蒂诺的原始剧本长达 230 页。芬奇最终剪掉了 60 页。

paras.en: Despite handing over the directing duties to his friend Fincher, Tarantino has been involved in the promo for Cliff Booth. The Pulp Fiction filmmaker presented 17-minutes of the finished Cliff Booth at AFI Fest in late October and also explained his reasons for reviving Pitt’s character. Tarantino will also pen and release the novel, The Adventures of Cliff Booth, for Harper this December.
paras.zh: 尽管塔伦蒂诺将导演职责移交给了他的朋友芬奇，但他仍然参与了克里夫·布斯的宣传片。这位《低俗小说》电影制片人在 10 月底的 AFI 电影节上展示了 17 分钟的《克里夫·布斯》成品，并解释了他复活皮特这个角色的原因。塔伦蒂诺还将为哈珀撰写并于今年 12 月发行小说《克里夫·布斯历险记》。

paras.en: See social media reaction to The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth below.
paras.zh: 请参阅下面社交媒体对《悬崖布斯的进一步错误冒险》的反应。

articles.title: Over 400 U.K. Industry Figures Demand End to “Culture of Open Secrets” After Russell Brand Trial
articles.author: Kevin Dolak

paras.en: More than 400 U.K. entertainment industry professionals have signed an open letter, released Monday, calling on leaders at studios, broadcasters and unions to end the culture of silence and secrecy that the signatories say allowed Russell Brand’s abuse to go unchecked. Brand was sentenced last week to 10 and a half years in prison for rape and sexual assault.
paras.zh: 超过 400 名英国娱乐业专业人士签署了一封周一发布的公开信，呼吁工作室、广播公司和工会的领导人结束沉默和保密的文化，签名者称这种文化让拉塞尔·布兰德的虐待行为不受制止。布兰德上周因强奸和性侵犯被判处 10 年半监禁。

paras.en: The letter, billed as an “open letter to the creative industry, from the creative industry,” comes as Little Britain star David Walliams faces allegations of sexual misconduct. A joint investigation by The Guardian and ITV News includes accounts from two women who say Walliams groomed them after meeting them when they were 15. Walliams denies wrongdoing. The letter asks those in power to “review your processes, protect those who speak out and become less offended by your inaction being named than you are by the actions you are being asked to recognize.”
paras.zh: 这封信被称为“来自创意产业、给创意产业的公开信”，正值《小不列颠》明星大卫·威廉姆斯面临不当性行为指控之际。 《卫报》和英国独立电视台新闻进行的一项联合调查包括两名女性的叙述，她们称沃利亚姆斯在她们 15 岁时与她们见面后为她们打扮。沃利亚姆斯否认有不当行为。这封信要求当权者“审查你的流程，保护那些敢于发声的人，不要因为你的不作为被点名而感到冒犯，而不要因为你被要求承认的行为而感到冒犯。”

paras.en: The letter was written by writer-actor-producer Ben Fletcher, co-organized by Alexa Morden and published on a dedicated website, makethisaturningpoint.com. Signatories include actors, directors and producers such as Natalie Dormer (Game of Thrones, The Hunger Games) and Richard Armitage (The Hobbit). The letter calls on the government to “act, not debate” by “increasing support for victims, ensuring police forces are fully resourced, and forcing accountability for those who know but choose convenient ignorance.”
paras.zh: 这封信由作家兼演员兼制片人本·弗莱彻 (Ben Fletcher) 撰写，由 Alexa Morden 联合组织，并发布在专门网站 makethisaturningpoint.com 上。签名者包括演员、导演和制片人，如娜塔莉·多默尔（《权力的游戏》、《饥饿游戏》）和理查德·阿米蒂奇（《霍比特人》）。这封信呼吁政府“采取行动，而不是辩论”，“增加对受害者的支持，确保警察部队资源充足，并迫使那些知道但选择无知的人承担责任”。

paras.en: Brand’s sentencing on Nov. 9, after a high-profile London trial in which he testified in his own defense, is a major catalyst for the letter. But the letter opens with a warning against calling this moment a turning point for a problem that has plagued the entertainment industry for decades.
paras.zh: 布兰德在伦敦一次备受瞩目的审判中为自己辩护作证后，于 11 月 9 日被判刑，这是这封信的主要催化剂。但这封信开头警告说，不要将这一时刻称为困扰娱乐业数十年的问题的转折点。

paras.en: “To afford such a label would be to ignore that it has taken some 17 years for justice,” it reads. The letter adds that one witness in Brand’s trial received death threats online, and that during the trial his lawyer threatened the reporter who uncovered his crimes.
paras.zh: 信中写道：“贴上这样的标签就等于忽视了正义花了大约 17 年的时间。”信中补充说，布兰德审判中的一名证人在网上收到死亡威胁，在审判期间，他的律师威胁了揭露他罪行的记者。

paras.en: On Monday, Brand released a statement through his wife, Laura Brand, who appeared to hold back tears as she read his claim of innocence in a video posted to YouTube. Britain’s Justice Secretary Alex Norris called the broadcast of a statement from Brand while in prison “completely unacceptable.”
paras.zh: 周一，布兰德通过他的妻子劳拉·布兰德发表了一份声明，当她在 YouTube 上发布的一段视频中读到他声称自己无罪时，她似乎忍住了泪水。英国司法大臣亚历克斯·诺里斯称布兰德在狱中发表的声明“完全不可接受”。

paras.en: “Prisoners are rightly banned from making statements that cause distress to victims,” Norris wrote on X. “This is being urgently investigated, and I expect action to be taken if he is found to have broken the rules.”
paras.zh: 诺里斯在 X 上写道：“囚犯被禁止发表会给受害者带来痛苦的言论，这是正确的。”“这件事正在紧急调查中，如果发现他违反了规定，我预计将采取行动。”

paras.en: “For this to be a turning point, the creative and entertainment industries must first acknowledge the role they play in enabling the behaviour on trial and at the centre of these convictions,” the letter reads. “Not through PR-drafted statements, vague promises or weak admissions that more could be done. But by accepting what was missed and that, collectively, the sector operates with a culture of open secrets and a belief that fame is a shield and status is a reason to look the other way.
paras.zh: 信中写道：“要想成为一个转折点，创意和娱乐行业必须首先承认它们在审判行为中所发挥的作用以及这些定罪的核心。” “不是通过公关起草的声明、含糊的承诺或软弱的承认可以做更多的事情。而是通过接受错过的东西，以及整体上，该行业以公开秘密的文化运作，并相信名声是盾牌，地位是忽视的理由。

paras.en: “This cannot be dismissed as a one-off. Not when, this very week, allegations against another have been made public. Not when open secrets persist and the next documentary is already in pre-production. And the industry cannot mistake the lack of formal reporting for the absence of systemic abuse when many victims feel able to share their stories only quietly, too often prefixed with ‘I have nowhere else to go,’ and the name of the union or organisation that failed them.”
paras.zh: “这不能被认为是一次性事件。就在本周，针对他人的指控被公开时。当公开的秘密持续存在且下一部纪录片已经在预制作中时，就不能被忽视。行业不能将缺乏正式报告误认为没有系统性虐待，因为许多受害者觉得只能安静地分享他们的故事，而且常常加上“我无处可去”以及让他们失望的工会或组织的名字。”

paras.en: Fletcher writes that the fear of losing work or other opportunities is “a tool of control to shape narrative, maintain perceptions and discredit victims.”
paras.zh: 弗莱彻写道，对失去工作或其他机会的恐惧是“塑造叙事、维持看法和抹黑受害者的控制工具”。

paras.en: “And a person’s credits and notoriety cannot and must not excuse their actions or attacks on those whose voices they believe beneath them,” the letter states.
paras.zh: 信中指出：“一个人的信誉和恶名不能也不能成为他们对那些他们认为声音低下的人的行为或攻击的借口。”

paras.en: The signatories call on “every union, every company and every industry organisation” to stop allowing and perpetuating a “systemic cycle of abuse, whether through unconscious inaction or deliberate distraction.”
paras.zh: 签署者呼吁“每个工会、每个公司和每个行业组织”停止允许和延续“系统性的虐待循环，无论是通过无意识的不作为还是故意的分心”。

articles.title: U.S. agencies say they initiated investigation into Nvidia partner Megaspeed in 2024

paras.en: The U.S. Commerce and Justice Department on Monday stateside said they had initiated an investigation into Singapore-based company Megaspeed in 2024 to "address inaccurate information circulating in public reporting."
paras.zh: 美国商务和司法部周一表示，他们已于 2024 年对新加坡公司 Megaspeed 展开调查，以“解决公开报道中流传的不准确信息”。

paras.en: Megaspeed International, a cloud computing firm that operates data centers across Southeast Asia, has been drawn into the fallout surrounding the leadership shake-up at chip giant Nvidia.
paras.zh: Megaspeed International 是一家在东南亚运营数据中心的云计算公司，该公司已被卷入芯片巨头英伟达领导层变动的影响之中。

paras.en: In a joint release, the departments outlined a timeline of their investigations into Megaspeed, saying the probes began in 2024 over potential export-control violations.
paras.zh: 在一份联合新闻稿中，这些部门概述了对 Megaspeed 的调查时间表，称调查于 2024 年开始，针对潜在的出口管制违规行为。

paras.en: In June 2025, Nvidia placed Megaspeed on its "no sell" list, after Commerce Department investigators requested records from Nvidia concerning direct or indirect sales to the company.
paras.zh: 2025 年 6 月，商务部调查人员要求 Nvidia 提供有关直接或间接向该公司销售的记录后，Nvidia 将 Megaspeed 列入“禁止销售”名单。

paras.en: In the same month, U.S. officials and Singapore police conducted an in-person inspection of Megaspeed and interviewed Alice Huang, who was allegedly involved in a relationship with Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang.
paras.zh: 同月，美国官员和新加坡警方对 Megaspeed 进行了现场检查，并约谈了 Alice Huang，据称她与 Nvidia 联合创始人 Jensen Huang 有关系。

paras.en: "Following this enforcement action, the Department of Justice took the lead role in the criminal investigation of Megaspeed," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“在此次执法行动之后，司法部牵头对 Megaspeed 进行刑事调查。”

paras.en: On Wednesday, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick also reposted the statement, adding, "The Department of Commerce works to protect the U.S. economy and our critical industries every day. We are very proud of the work of the Bureau of Industry and Security."
paras.zh: 周三，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克也转发了该声明，并补充道：“商务部每天都致力于保护美国经济和我们的关键行业。我们对工业与安全局的工作感到非常自豪。”

paras.en: In response to the statement, Chris McGuire, senior fellow for China and emerging technologies at the Council of Foreign Relations wrote on X, "Very, very strange statement tonight... about Megaspeed. The facts here just don't add up, and this does nothing to explain why Commerce did not cut Megaspeed off from chips."
paras.zh: 针对这一声明，外交关系委员会中国和新兴技术高级研究员 Chris McGuire 在 X 上写道：“今晚关于 Megaspeed 的声明非常非常奇怪。这里的事实根本不符合事实，这并不能解释为什么商务部没有切断 Megaspeed 的芯片供应。”

paras.en: McGuire said that Megaspeed kept buying chips after Nvidia put them on their no-trade list, and asked if Nvidia also blacklisted Megaspeed's subsidaries Speedmatrix and PT Megaspeed International.
paras.zh: McGuire表示，在Nvidia将Megaspeed列入禁止贸易名单后，Megaspeed继续购买芯片，并询问Nvidia是否也将Megaspeed的子公司Speedmatrix和PT Megaspeed International列入黑名单。

paras.en: "I would bet they did not! If they kept shipping to them after blacklisting Megaspeed, that would be very concerning," McGuire added.
paras.zh: “我敢打赌他们没有！如果他们在将 Megaspeed 列入黑名单后继续向他们发货，那将非常令人担忧，”麦奎尔补充道。

paras.en: The statement comes after Singapore's Ministry of Home Affairs said the first time authorities there learned of U.S. interest in Megaspeed and Alice Huang was in June. Singapore had already been conducting its own independent investigation and said she was not investigated for espionage.
paras.zh: 新加坡内政部表示，该国当局于 6 月份首次获悉美国对 Megaspeed 和 Alice Huang 感兴趣。新加坡已经在进行自己的独立调查，并表示她没有因间谍活动而受到调查。

paras.en: The city-state barred Alice Huang from re-entering the country in February 2026 after authorities found that she had knowingly provided inaccurate information about her role at Megaspeed.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月，当局发现 Alice Huang 故意提供了有关其在 Megaspeed 职位的不准确信息，该城邦禁止她再次入境。

paras.en: Alice Huang was reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to gather information on Jensen Huang. The Justice Department has not reached a conclusion on whether she was a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 据报道，爱丽丝黄被中国国家安全部招募来收集有关黄仁勋的信息。司法部尚未就她是否是中国间谍得出结论。

paras.en: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO last week after revelations about multiple extramarital relationships, including with two Nvidia employees. The tech giant has appointed Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋上周辞去了首席执行官一职，此前他的多起婚外情被曝光，其中包括与两名英伟达员工的婚外情。这家科技巨头已任命首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 为临时首席执行官。

paras.en: The agencies' statement also comes as Nvidia prepares to report its third-quarter results Tuesday afternoon U.S. time, with Kress set to lead her first earnings call.
paras.zh: 这些机构发表声明之际，英伟达正准备在美国时间周二下午公布第三季度业绩，克雷斯将主持她的第一次财报电话会议。

paras.en: Earlier on Monday in the U.S., the Commerce Department moved to close a loophole that has allowed Chinese companies to access Nvidia's advanced computing power through data centers in third countries.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，美国商务部采取行动堵住了一个漏洞，该漏洞允许中国公司通过第三国的数据中心访问英伟达的先进计算能力。

paras.en: The interim final rule from the department's Bureau of Industry and Security is aimed at restricting remote access to advanced U.S. computing technology.
paras.zh: 该部门工业和安全局的临时最终规则旨在限制远程访问先进的美国计算技术。

paras.en: It also comes amid growing scrutiny of Lutnick for not having done enough to prevent restricted Nvidia chips and computing capacity from reaching Chinese companies.
paras.zh: 与此同时，卢特尼克受到越来越多的审查，因为他没有采取足够措施阻止受限制的英伟达芯片和计算能力进入中国公司。

paras.en: — CNBC's Anniek Bao and Dan Mangan contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Anniek Bao 和 Dan Mangan 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Nvidia warns chip buyers of legal risks tied to China AI access, sources tell CNBC

paras.en: Nvidia warned its customers that new legislation on Chinese companies remotely accessing its artificial-intelligence chips could expose it and them to U.S. "legal action," sources told CNBC.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉 CNBC，英伟达警告其客户，有关中国公司远程访问其人工智能芯片的新立法可能会让该公司和他们面临美国的“法律行动”。

paras.en: The chip giant is facing increasing scrutiny from U.S. lawmakers over Chinese companies' access to its advanced chips, which U.S. export controls restrict from going to China.
paras.zh: 这家芯片巨头正面临美国立法者对中国公司获取其先进芯片的越来越严格的审查，美国出口管制限制这些芯片无法进入中国。

paras.en: Nvidia messaged chip buyers in recent months to caution that the proposed Remote Access Security Act, or RASA, would give the U.S. government broader authority to control access to cloud services in the same way as physical hardware, potentially exposing both parties to legal risk, according to two people with direct knowledge of the matter. The people asked not to be named while discussing private communications.
paras.zh: 据两位直接了解此事的人士透露，近几个月来，英伟达向芯片买家发出信息，提醒他们拟议的远程访问安全法案（RASA）将赋予美国政府更广泛的权力，以与物理硬件相同的方式控制对云服务的访问，这可能使双方面临法律风险。人们在讨论私人通讯时要求不透露姓名。

paras.en: It also said that, for now, it would not sell its chips to customers who rent more than 50% of the graphics processing units, or GPUs, to Chinese companies, the people said.
paras.zh: 知情人士称，该公司还表示，目前不会向向中国公司租用 50% 以上图形处理单元 (GPU) 的客户出售其芯片。

paras.en: Separately, the Financial Times reported earlier this month that Nvidia verbally told data-center clients to direct at least 51% of their services to non-Chinese customers under future contracts.
paras.zh: 另外，英国《金融时报》本月早些时候报道称，英伟达口头告知数据中心客户，根据未来合同，将至少 51% 的服务提供给非中国客户。

paras.en: Regulators have had limited powers to control companies' access to those chips through cloud services hosted overseas.
paras.zh: 监管机构在控制公司通过海外托管的云服务访问这些芯片方面的权力有限。

paras.en: RASA passed the House of Representatives in January but has not yet passed the Senate. Remote access to the chips has provoked the ire of President Donald Trump's administration, which has sought to keep the chips out of China to maintain the U.S. lead in the AI race.
paras.zh: RASA 一月份在众议院获得通过，但尚未在参议院获得通过。远程访问芯片激怒了唐纳德·特朗普总统政府，该政府试图将这些芯片排除在中国之外，以保持美国在人工智能竞赛中的领先地位。

paras.en: CNBC reported on Nov. 5 that Chinese lab Moonshot AI sought access to Nvidia chips through data centers in Europe. The Trump administration previously singled the company out, accusing it in July of accessing the chips through centers in East Asia.
paras.zh: CNBC 11 月 5 日报道称，中国实验室 Moonshot AI 寻求通过欧洲数据中心访问 Nvidia 芯片。特朗普政府此前曾点名该公司，并于 7 月份指责该公司通过东亚中心获取芯片。

paras.en: The U.S. Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security, or BIS, announced on Monday an interim final rule designed to prevent Chinese companies' remote access to AI chips.
paras.zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）周一宣布了一项临时最终规则，旨在阻止中国公司远程访问人工智能芯片。

paras.en: Nvidia and BIS did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 英伟达和 BIS 没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: On Sunday, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called for a "dramatic shakeup" at Nvidia after Jensen Huang's shock departure as CEO, amid reports of an extramarital affair with a woman U.S. authorities reportedly suspect of spying for China.
paras.zh: 周日，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 呼吁对英伟达进行“戏剧性改组”，原因是黄仁勋因与美国当局涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动的一名女性发生婚外情而令人震惊地辞去首席执行官职务。

paras.en: Bessent suggested other Nvidia executives should face scrutiny over the chip giant's compliance with export controls.
paras.zh: 贝森特建议英伟达的其他高管应因这家芯片巨头遵守出口管制的情况而面临审查。

paras.en: "I want to keep coming back to what was the culture at Nvidia, and were they pressing these seemingly illicit sales to goose their revenues and their earnings?" Bessent told Fox News.
paras.zh: “我想继续回到英伟达的文化，他们是否通过这些看似非法的销售来增加收入和利润？”贝森特告诉福克斯新闻。

paras.en: In an August securities filing, Nvidia said it sought to "strictly comply with all applicable export control regulators" but did not have "physical control of our products after sale" and relied on its customers' and partners' compliance programs.
paras.zh: 在 8 月份的一份证券备案文件中，英伟达表示，它寻求“严格遵守所有适用的出口管制监管机构”，但没有“对我们的产品售后进行实际控制”，并依赖于其客户和合作伙伴的合规计划。

paras.en: Huang has been asked to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on Dec. 3.
paras.zh: 黄先生已被要求于 12 月 3 日在参议院银行委员会作证。

articles.title: Treasury yields are broadly flat as investors await retail sales data

paras.en: U.S. Treasury yields were little changed on Tuesday morning as investors awaited economic data and comments from Federal Reserve officials later in the session.
paras.zh: 周二上午，美国国债收益率几乎没有变化，投资者等待经济数据和美联储官员稍后的评论。

paras.en: The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield was broadly flat at 5.118%, while the long-dated 30-year Treasury bond was up just above the flatline to 5.472%. Meanwhile, the 2-year Treasury note yield was down 2 basis points to 4.806%.
paras.zh: 基准 10 年期国债收益率基本持平，为 5.118%，而长期 30 年期国债收益率略高于持平线，达到 5.472%。与此同时，2年期国债收益率下跌2个基点至4.806%。

paras.en: One basis point is equal to 0.01%, and yields and prices move in opposite directions.
paras.zh: 1个基点等于0.01%，收益率和价格走势相反。

paras.en: October's retail sales data is due later on Tuesday morning, with economists forecasting retail sales to grow 0.6% on the month, down from 0.8% in September. A stronger-than-expected reading could reinforce the case for higher Fed interest rates.
paras.zh: 10 月份零售销售数据将于周二上午晚些时候公布，经济学家预测当月零售销售将增长 0.6%，低于 9 月份的 0.8%。强于预期的数据可能会强化美联储加息的理由。

paras.en: Investors will also parse comments from the Fed's Alberto Musalem, Christopher Waller and John Williams, who are all due to speak publicly at separate engagements on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 投资者还将分析美联储阿尔贝托·穆萨勒姆(Alberto Musalem)、克里斯托弗·沃勒(Christopher Waller)和约翰·威廉姆斯(John Williams)的评论，他们都将于周二在单独的会议上公开发表讲话。

paras.en: The latest FOMC meeting minutes are due on Wednesday, with investors watching for insights on the Fed's October decision to leave interest rates unchanged. Traders are currently pricing in a 95% chance of a quarter-percentage-point hike in December, per the CME Group's FedWatch tool.
paras.zh: 最新的 FOMC 会议纪要将于周三公布，投资者关注美联储 10 月份维持利率不变的决定的见解。根据 CME 集团的 FedWatch 工具，交易员目前预计 12 月份加息 25 个百分点的可能性为 95%。

paras.en: Elsewhere in the market, a selloff in key technology and AI stocks continued on Monday amid growing calls to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO. A source familiar with the matter told CNBC on Monday that Nvidia's board of directors is not discussing bringing back the founder.
paras.zh: 在市场其他地方，由于要求恢复黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官的呼声越来越高，关键技术和人工智能股票周一继续遭到抛售。一位知情人士周一告诉 CNBC，英伟达董事会并未讨论召回创始人。

paras.en: Additionally, the Commerce Department on Monday moved to close a loophole that let Chinese firms lease Nvidia's computing power from locations in other countries.
paras.zh: 此外，美国商务部周一采取行动，堵住了一个漏洞，该漏洞允许中国公司从其他国家/地区租赁英伟达的计算能力。

paras.en: Also on the schedule are the weekly initial jobless claims on Thursday and the preliminary Michigan consumer sentiment on Friday.
paras.zh: 周四公布的每周初请失业金人数和周五密歇根州消费者信心指数初值也在日程表上。

articles.title: Can the Amazon rainforest survive the largest El Niño in living memory?

paras.en: For weeks now, smoke has hung over the Brazilian city of Manaus, the largest in the Amazon rainforest. On October 17 it had the worst air quality in the world on that day, with fine particulate matter concentrations of nearly 30 times the World Health Organization’s safe daily limit. The country’s civil defense agency has advised residents to wear N95 masks, and schools and universities temporarily suspended in-person classes.
paras.zh: 几周来，烟雾一直笼罩在亚马逊雨林最大的巴西城市马瑙斯上空。 10月17日，该日空气质量为全球最差，细颗粒物浓度接近世界卫生组织每日安全限值的30倍。该国民防机构已建议居民佩戴 N95 口罩，学校和大学暂时停止了面授课程。

paras.en: “What’s burning around Manaus is forest,” says Bernardo Flores, an ecologist at the Juruá Institute in Manaus, who studies the Amazon rainforest’s resilience.
paras.zh: “马瑙斯周围燃烧的是森林，”马瑙斯 Juruá 研究所的生态学家贝尔纳多·弗洛雷斯 (Bernardo Flores) 说，他研究亚马逊雨林的恢复力。

paras.en: In October Brazil’s National Institute for Space Research (INPE) registered 2,271 fire hotspots in the state of Amazonas alone—a 160 percent increase over the same month last year. The blazes mark the beginning of what scientists suspect will be a long and severe fire season—“a year of fires,” Flores says—spurred by a record-smashing El Niño that’s on track to become the largest in living memory. And that has scientists worried for the rainforest’s long-term survival.
paras.zh: 10 月份，巴西国家空间研究所 (INPE) 仅在亚马逊州就记录了 2,271 个火灾热点，比去年同月增加了 160%。这场大火标志着科学家们怀疑将是一个漫长而严重的火灾季节的开始——弗洛雷斯说，这是“火灾之年”——受到破纪录的厄尔尼诺现象的推动，而厄尔尼诺现象有望成为人们记忆中最大的一次。这让科学家们担心雨林的长期生存。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The Amazon is still recovering from drought and fires linked to a strong El Niño in 2023 and 2024, and it has been weakened by decades of global warming and deforestation. Some researchers fear the rainforest could soon reach a “tipping point”—the threshold beyond which a self-reinforcing, runaway cascade of drying, tree death and wildfire would begin to spread across the Amazon basin, irreversibly. In just decades, that cascade could turn rainforest to savanna, releasing into the atmosphere tens of billions of tons of carbon and altering global rain and snowfall patterns.
paras.zh: 亚马逊地区仍在从 2023 年和 2024 年强厄尔尼诺现象引发的干旱和火灾中恢复，并且由于数十年的全球变暖和森林砍伐而受到削弱。一些研究人员担心雨林可能很快就会达到一个“临界点”——一旦超过这个临界点，自我强化、失控的干燥、树木死亡和野火就会开始在亚马逊盆地蔓延，不可逆转。在短短几十年内，这种级联可能会将雨林变成稀树草原，向大气中释放数百亿吨碳，并改变全球降雨和降雪模式。

paras.en: El Niño events—periodic warmings of the eastern Pacific that recur every two to seven years—disrupt weather patterns around the world. As warm water shifts eastward in the tropical Pacific, so does the zone of rising air above it. A corresponding area of sinking air then settles over northern South America, suppressing clouds and rainfall, typically bringing severe droughts to the Amazon basin.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺事件——东太平洋周期性变暖，每两到七年发生一次——扰乱了世界各地的天气模式。当热带太平洋的暖水向东移动时，其上方的上升空气区也会向东移动。然后，相应的下沉空气区域沉降在南美洲北部，抑制了云层和降雨，通常会给亚马逊盆地带来严重的干旱。

paras.en: The rainforest has long been able to withstand and recover from a single dry year on its own. But at the same time this El Niño of unprecedented strength is taking shape, the forest is reeling from unprecedented damage caused by the last event, when major rivers reached historic lows and some 15.8 million hectares of the Amazon—an area larger than England—went up in flames. A study published earlier this year projected that more than half of the affected forest will not recover within seven years, a larger share than after any previous drought in the satellite record.
paras.zh: 雨林长期以来能够自行承受干旱年份并从中恢复。但与此同时，前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象正在形成，森林也因上次事件造成的前所未有的破坏而摇摇欲坠，当时主要河流的水位达到了历史最低点，亚马逊河流域约1580万公顷的土地（面积比英格兰还大）起火。今年早些时候发表的一项研究预测，超过一半的受影响森林将在七年内无法恢复，这一比例比卫星记录中以往任何一次干旱之后的比例都要大。

paras.en: Then there’s deforestation. Like all rainforests, the Amazon generates much of its own rainfall: its trees draw water from the soil and release it as vapor, which gathers into clouds and falls again as rain, often recycling across the basin several times before reaching the Andes. Lost trees can disrupt that natural feedback. In another study, Nico Wunderling, an Earth system modeler at Goethe University Frankfurt and the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research, both in Germany, and his colleagues built a computer model of this “atmospheric moisture recycling” system and ran it through a gauntlet of global warming and deforestation scenarios.
paras.zh: 然后是森林砍伐。与所有雨林一样，亚马逊雨林的大部分降雨都是自己产生的：树木从土壤中吸收水分，并以水蒸气的形式释放出来，这些水蒸气聚集成云，再次以雨水的形式落下，在到达安第斯山脉之前，通常会在整个盆地循环几次。失去树木会破坏这种自然反馈。在另一项研究中，德国法兰克福歌德大学和波茨坦气候影响研究所的地球系统建模师 Nico Wunderling 和他的同事建立了这个“大气水分回收”系统的计算机模型，并通过全球变暖和森林砍伐场景的挑战来运行它。

paras.en: They found that deforestation drastically lowers the temperature at which a collapse becomes possible. Left intact, the Amazon is relatively resilient up to about 3.7 to four degrees Celsius of temperature rise above preindustrial levels. But if 22 to 28 percent of the rainforest were deforested, warming of just 1.5 to 1.9 degrees C could be enough to trigger a near-basin-wide collapse. The world is rapidly approaching 1.5 degrees C of warming, and roughly 17 percent of the Amazon has already been deforested between the 1970s and now.
paras.zh: 他们发现森林砍伐大大降低了可能发生崩溃的温度。如果保持完好无损，亚马逊地区相对能承受比工业化前水平高出约 3.7 至 4 摄氏度的气温。但如果 22% 至 28% 的雨林被砍伐，仅升温 1.5 至 1.9 摄氏度就足以引发近乎盆地范围的崩溃。全球变暖正在迅速接近 1.5 摄氏度，从 20 世纪 70 年代至今，亚马逊地区约 17% 的森林已被砍伐。

paras.en: “We might not be too far away anymore,” Wunderling says. Another tenth of a degree of warming and another five percentage points of forest loss would put the Amazon in what he calls “a really high-risk zone.”
paras.zh: “我们可能不会再离太远了，”万德林说。再变暖十分之一度和森林再减少五个百分点将使亚马逊地区进入他所说的“真正的高风险区”。

paras.en: There is some hope that deforestation rates can continue to decline with the recent reelection of Brazilian president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to a fourth term. After returning to office in 2023, he reversed forest clearing—largely for cattle pasture and cropland—to its lowest level since 1988 after it reached a 15-year high under his predecessor, Jair Bolsonaro. But it’s unclear if it will be enough. “Brazil has roughly halved its deforestation since 2022, but fire did not follow it down,” says Dolors Armenteras, a fire ecologist at the Institute of Forest Science of the Spanish National Research Council, who studies fire regimes in the Amazon. “Less clearing is very good news, but it cannot protect a forest that has dried out this much.”
paras.zh: 随着巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦最近连任第四个任期，森林砍伐率有望继续下降。 2023 年重新上任后，他将森林砍伐（主要用于牛牧场和农田）扭转至 1988 年以来的最低水平，此前森林砍伐达到了前任雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 领导下 15 年来的最高水平。但尚不清楚这是否足够。 “自 2022 年以来，巴西的森林砍伐量大约减少了一半，但火灾并没有随之减少，”西班牙国家研究委员会森林科学研究所的火灾生态学家多洛尔斯·阿门特拉斯 (Dolors Armenteras) 说，他研究亚马逊地区的火灾状况。 “减少砍伐是个好消息，但它无法保护已经严重干燥的森林。”

paras.en: Once a patch of the rainforest burns, Flores says, it remains more flammable for at least a decade—a factor Wunderling’s study, which Flores co-authored, didn’t account for. Fire kills trees, opens the canopy and dries the forest floor—and the dead wood left behind becomes fuel for the next blaze. In a September study of forests in the Colombian Amazon and Orinoco basins, Armenteras and a colleague found that of the areas that burned three or more times since 2001, only 37 percent were still intact by 2024; 35 percent had been deforested—the canopy permanently lost in a cascade that began with the fires. Ultimately the land was converted, mostly to cattle pasture.
paras.zh: 弗洛雷斯说，一旦雨林的一小片区域着火，至少在十年内它的易燃性仍然会更高，而弗洛雷斯与人合着的旺德林研究并未考虑到这一因素。火灾会杀死树木，打开树冠，使森林地面变干，留下的枯木会成为下一次火灾的燃料。在 9 月份对哥伦比亚亚马逊和奥里诺科河流域的森林进行的一项研究中，阿尔门特拉斯和一位同事发现，自 2001 年以来发生过 3 次或以上火灾的地区，到 2024 年，只有 37% 仍然完好无损； 35% 的森林被砍伐——树冠在火灾引发的连锁反应中永久消失。最终，土地被转变，大部分被改造成牧场。

paras.en: Many of the forests currently burning around Manaus and elsewhere across the Amazon have burned before, during the El Niño-driven droughts of 2015–2016 and 2023–2024. “Every severe fire season makes the next one more likely and more damaging. Repeated fire is really what makes the difference,” Armenteras says.
paras.zh: 目前马瑙斯周围和亚马逊其他地区正在燃烧的许多森林以前曾在2015-2016年和2023-2024年厄尔尼诺现象引发的干旱期间被烧过。 “每一次严重的火灾季节都会使下一次发生火灾的可能性更大、破坏性更大。反复发生的火灾确实会造成影响，”阿门特拉斯说。

paras.en: The worst is still to come, the experts suspect. The El Niño’s projected peak in the next month or so will likely coincide with the height of the dry season in the northern Amazon. And the worst recent fire seasons, in 2016 and 2024, each came in the year after a previous El Niño had peaked. “I would watch the 2027 dry season very closely,” Armenteras says.
paras.zh: 专家怀疑，最糟糕的情况尚未到来。厄尔尼诺现象预计在下个月左右达到峰值，很可能与亚马逊北部旱季的高峰期同时发生。最近最严重的火灾季节分别是 2016 年和 2024 年，均发生在上一次厄尔尼诺现象达到顶峰之后的一年。 “我会密切关注 2027 年旱季，”阿门特拉斯说。

paras.en: “If we continue to have these escalating El Niños—these El Niños that get stronger and stronger—then it’s very concerning,” Flores says. “The area of flammable forest just increases and increases, and it can become exponential.”
paras.zh: “如果厄尔尼诺现象继续升级——这些厄尔尼诺现象变得越来越强——那就非常令人担忧了，”弗洛雷斯说。 “易燃森林的面积只会不断增加，并且可能呈指数级增长。”

paras.en: “And that’s when you have the risk of a tipping point,” he adds. “That’s how the system collapses.”
paras.zh: “那就是你面临临界点风险的时候，”他补充道。 “系统就是这样崩溃的。”

articles.title: Math students fear AI will take their jobs—they’re using it anyway

paras.en: Everyone has heard what the giants of mathematics think about artificial intelligence—the open letters, the op-eds, the predictions from laureates who have already cemented their reputation. Almost no one has asked the people whose future is less secure—the graduate students and postdoctoral researchers left to pick up the pieces after AI continues to plough through the field of math.
paras.zh: 每个人都听说过数学巨头对人工智能的看法——公开信、专栏、已经巩固了声誉的获奖者的预测。几乎没有人问过那些未来不太安全的人——在人工智能继续深入数学领域后，研究生和博士后研究人员离开去收拾残局。

paras.en: To take the field’s pulse, three math Ph.D. students—Anna Brandenberger, Hanna Mularczyk and Dora Woodruff—launched an online Google Forms survey in the wake of AI cracking problems that mathematicians had chased for decades. The survey quickly spread through word of mouth and department mailing lists: “We needed something that features the voices of grad students and postdocs as well,” Woodruff says.
paras.zh: 为了把握该领域的脉搏，三位数学博士。在人工智能解决数学家数十年来所追求的问题之后，安娜·布兰登伯格 (Anna Brandenberger)、汉娜·穆拉奇克 (Hanna Mularczyk) 和多拉·伍德拉夫 (Dora Woodruff) 等学生发起了一项在线 Google Forms 调查。这项调查很快通过口碑和部门邮件列表传播开来：“我们还需要一些能够反映研究生和博士后声音的调查，”伍德拉夫说。

paras.en: Described in a preprint paper, the 268 responses from nearly 60 institutions paint a stark picture of a community in limbo: largely frustrated and anxious that AI is taking this field for a ride yet divided on what to do about it.
paras.zh: 预印本论文中描述了来自近 60 个机构的 268 条回复，描绘了一个陷入困境的社区的鲜明景象：大部分人对人工智能在这一领域的发展感到沮丧和焦虑，但在如何应对这一问题上存在分歧。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Seven in 10 respondents say they’re now less likely to remain in math, with broad consensus that AI will make tenure-track jobs harder to get. Two-thirds report feeling less motivated to work on their research, with the growing possibility of a large language model (LLM) beating them to their goals.
paras.zh: 十分之七的受访者表示，他们现在不太可能继续从事数学工作，因为人们普遍认为人工智能将使终身职位变得更难获得。三分之二的人表示，随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 击败他们实现目标的可能性越来越大，他们感觉自己的研究动力减弱。

paras.en: “People have said things to me like, ‘I feel useless,’” Woodruff says. “It’s not just people’s jobs—math is a lot of people’s identities.” Some, she says, feel that “not only does their work not matter, but their minds and their creativity don’t matter.”
paras.zh: “人们对我说过，‘我觉得自己一无是处’，”伍德拉夫说。 “这不仅仅是人们的工作——数学是很多人的身份。”她说，有些人觉得“不仅他们的工作不重要，而且他们的思想和创造力也不重要。”

paras.en: While senior mathematicians debate what the field might look like in 20 years, her and her colleagues’ respondents are worried about the immediate future. Woodruff sums up what many of her early-career colleagues are thinking: “In one year or two years,” as she puts it, “I don’t know if I’m going to have a job or funding,” she says.
paras.zh: 当资深数学家们争论这个领域 20 年后会是什么样子时，她和她同事的受访者却对不久的将来感到担忧。伍德拉夫总结了她许多职业生涯早期同事的想法：“一年或两年后”，正如她所说，“我不知道我是否会找到工作或资金，”她说。

paras.en: But in spite of this universal malaise, young mathematicians are split roughly down the middle on the technology itself: about half are optimistic about AI’s potential for mathematics, while a third oppose its use—either outright or for creative mathematical work. The optimists come with an asterisk, though: among them, four out of five say they’re excited about AI in theory but strongly opposed to how things are unfolding in practice. Just 13 percent of all respondents are happy with the current trajectory.
paras.zh: 但尽管存在这种普遍的不适，年轻的数学家对技术本身的看法大致分为两派：大约一半的人对人工智能在数学方面的潜力持乐观态度，而三分之一的人反对将其直接使用或用于创造性的数学工作。不过，乐观主义者却带有星号：其中，五分之四的人表示，他们在理论上对人工智能感到兴奋，但强烈反对事情在实践中的发展。只有 13% 的受访者对当前的发展轨迹感到满意。

paras.en: Even among the respondents who do use AI—which is nearly all of them—not many seem to actually enjoy it. In written responses, many describe feeling pressured to use AI to keep pace, resulting in a generation of mathematicians who have been reluctantly mastering the very technology they fear could make them obsolete.
paras.zh: 即使在确实使用人工智能的受访者中（几乎是全部），似乎也没有多少人真正喜欢它。在书面回复中，许多人描述了使用人工智能跟上时代步伐的压力，导致一代数学家一直不情愿地掌握他们担心可能会让自己过时的技术。

paras.en: Woodruff cautions that the voluntary survey isn’t representative of all young mathematicians, and nearly all of its responses arrived before OpenAI published AI-assisted solutions to hundreds of open problems in October. But it shows that this headline-making year for math has come at a huge cost.
paras.zh: 伍德拉夫警告说，这项自愿调查并不能代表所有年轻数学家，而且几乎所有的回复都是在 OpenAI 于 10 月份发布针对数百个开放问题的人工智能辅助解决方案之前到达的。但它表明，今年数学界的头条新闻已经付出了巨大的代价。

paras.en: “A lot of people outside of math are looking at what’s happening in math now,” Woodruff says. “So far, we’re not doing a particularly inspiring job.”
paras.zh: “数学之外的很多人都在关注数学领域现在正在发生的事情，”伍德拉夫说。 “到目前为止，我们还没有做一项特别鼓舞人心的工作。”

articles.title: "It runs Doom" is more than a meme. The reason lies in its engineering

paras.en: In a building in downtown Manhattan, about 50 artists and programmers sat on the floor like kindergartners during show-and-tell, staring at a wall-sized projection of the 1993 videogame Doom. The original 1993 game is set in space and, eventually, hell and an Earth invaded by demons. The version that was seen on the wall takes place somewhere arguably scarier: an apartment in Brooklyn.
paras.zh: 在曼哈顿市中心的一栋大楼里，大约 50 名艺术家和程序员在表演和讲述中像幼儿园孩子一样坐在地板上，盯着 1993 年电子游戏《毁灭战士》的墙壁大小的投影。最初的 1993 年游戏以太空为背景，最终进入地狱和被恶魔入侵的地球。墙上看到的版本发生在一个可以说更可怕的地方：布鲁克林的一间公寓。

paras.en: At the controls was Rae Kelly (also known as wallh4x), an artist with curly elbow-length hair and wire-frame glasses, who was walking the audience through their Doom mod, “Arlington.” Doom mods alter, or modify, the original game by changing its raw materials, such as the environmental textures or enemies, into anything the modder wants.
paras.zh: 操控台的是雷·凯利（Rae Kelly）（又名 wallh4x），他是一位留着齐肘长卷发、戴着金属框眼镜的艺术家，正在带领观众体验他们的《毁灭战士》模组“阿灵顿”。 《毁灭战士》模组通过将原始游戏的原材料（例如环境纹理或敌人）更改为模组制作者想要的任何内容来改变或修改原始游戏。

paras.en: “There is something timeless about [Doom],” Kelly says. “It’s a really clean piece of programming that accomplishes something fundamental…, this abstract sensation of being somewhere.”
paras.zh: “《毁灭战士》有一些永恒的东西，”凯利说。 “这是一个非常干净的编程，它完成了一些基本的事情……，这种抽象的存在于某个地方的感觉。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Most 1990s video games are relics, yet Doom keeps respawning. The game’s aesthetics are iconic: a moody, rock ’n’ roll demon world that totally shreds. But much of the credit goes to that clean programming, which has allowed tinkerers to put the game on nearly any machine with a chip for more than three decades.
paras.zh: 大多数 20 世纪 90 年代的电子游戏都已经过时了，但《毁灭战士》却不断重生。游戏的美学是标志性的：一个喜怒无常、摇滚的恶魔世界，完全被粉碎。但这很大程度上要归功于干净的编程，三十多年来，它使得修补匠们可以将游戏移植到几乎任何带有芯片的机器上。

paras.en: It was designed for the Intel 486 processor, which was state-of-the-art at the time. The developers also used a technique called binary space partitioning (BSP), which let the game sort polygons in near-to-far order from only the player’s point of view. This technique stores partially sorted polygons when rendering a frame, avoiding what would normally be repeated sorting that slows things down. Because the game’s code does that sorting in advance, when each level is rendered the game can quickly work out what to draw regardless of where the player stands. Doom was one of the first games to bring BSP to consumer hardware, and it popularized the technique for future developers.
paras.zh: 它是为当时最先进的 Intel 486 处理器而设计的。开发人员还使用了一种称为二进制空间分区 (BSP) 的技术，该技术让游戏仅从玩家的角度按由近到远的顺序对多边形进行排序。该技术在渲染帧时存储部分排序的多边形，避免了通常会导致速度减慢的重复排序。因为游戏的代码会提前进行排序，所以当渲染每个关卡时，无论玩家站在哪里，游戏都可以快速计算出要绘制的内容。 Doom 是首批将 BSP 引入消费级硬件的游戏之一，它为未来的开发人员普及了该技术。

paras.en: “What made or broke a game back then was the frame rate,” says Fabien Sanglard, an independent software engineer, who wrote a book dissecting Doom’s engineering in the context of its time. “The BSP is what cracked the frame rate.”
paras.zh: “当时游戏的成败在于帧率，”独立软件工程师法比安·桑格拉德 (Fabien Sanglard) 说道，他写了一本书，在当时的背景下剖析了《毁灭战士》的工程设计。 “BSP 是破解帧速率的关键。”

paras.en: Doom has also been easy to add to. The game’s file architecture made it so that players have been able to swap assets such as map data, sounds and characters for their own creations. That sparked a movement to build new mods of it—for gamers at home and even the U.S. Marines. In 1997 id Software, the company behind Doom, made the game’s source code open-access, so anyone could tinker with the engine itself.
paras.zh: 《毁灭战士》也很容易添加。游戏的文件架构使得玩家能够将地图数据、声音和角色等资产交换为自己的创作。这引发了一场为国内游戏玩家甚至美国海军陆战队打造新模组的运动。 1997 年，《Doom》背后的公司 id Software 开放了游戏的源代码，因此任何人都可以修改引擎本身。

paras.en: And Doom will run on pretty much anything.
paras.zh: 《毁灭战士》几乎可以在任何东西上运行。

paras.en: From the very beginning, the team designed Doom’s code to port easily to other systems, says co-creator John Romero. The developers wrote the game on Steve Jobs’s NeXTSTEP operating system, then ported it to Microsoft’s MS-DOS, which was the operating system for most personal computers at the time.
paras.zh: 联合创始人约翰·罗梅罗 (John Romero) 表示，从一开始，团队就设计了《Doom》的代码，以便轻松移植到其他系统。开发人员在史蒂夫·乔布斯的 NeXTSTEP 操作系统上编写了游戏，然后将其移植到微软的 MS-DOS，这是当时大多数个人电脑的操作系统。

paras.en: Romero and fellow cocreator John Carmack chose to write much of the game in C, a programming language that works on essentially any computer. “C is a very portable language,” Romero says. “If you’re taking damage in lava or if a switch flips and does something—all that stuff has nothing to do with the machine that’s on at all [because it’s] pure logic code.”
paras.zh: 罗梅罗和共同创作者约翰·卡马克选择用 C 语言编写游戏的大部分内容，C 语言是一种基本上可以在任何计算机上运行的编程语言。 “C 是一种非常可移植的语言，”Romero 说。 “如果你在熔岩中受到伤害，或者开关翻转并执行某些操作，那么所有这些东西都与正在运行的机器无关，[因为它是]纯逻辑代码。”

paras.en: The only code a person needs to change when porting the game is the part that handles input and output on the new device—typically 10 percent of it, according to Sanglard. That made it easy to port and sparked the “It Runs Doom” meme, in which people show off some of the wackiest devices they’ve gotten the game to run on, such as an ATM, a flash drive, a toaster or a pregnancy test.
paras.zh: 桑格拉德表示，移植游戏时唯一需要更改的代码是处理新设备上的输入和输出的部分，通常是其中的 10%。这使得移植变得很容易，并引发了“It Runs Doom”模因，人们展示了他们运行游戏的一些最古怪的设备，例如 ATM、闪存驱动器、烤面包机或妊娠测试。

paras.en: Scientists have joined in, designing a Doom display made of Escherichia coli in 2024 and, earlier this year, getting living human neurons—and a simulated fruit fly brain—to “play Doom.”
paras.zh: 科学家们也加入进来，于 2024 年设计了一款由大肠杆菌制成的《毁灭战士》显示器，并在今年早些时候让活的人类神经元和模拟果蝇大脑来“玩《毁灭战士》”。

paras.en: Georges Labrèche, an onboard machine-learning researcher for the European Space Agency’s (ESA’s) OPS-SAT Space Lab, has helped run Doom on two ESA satellites. He did it first to test machine-learning algorithms and then, this past summer, to test a new voice-command system. “It unlocked a lot of innovation,” he says.
paras.zh: Georges Labrèche 是欧洲航天局 (ESA) OPS-SAT 太空实验室的机上机器学习研究员，他帮助在两颗 ESA 卫星上运行《毁灭战士》。他首先这样做是为了测试机器学习算法，然后在去年夏天测试一种新的语音命令系统。 “它开启了很多创新，”他说。

paras.en: Portability runs through Doom’s mod culture, too. Modders can choose from dozens of “source ports,” which are changed versions of the source code that fans have adapted from id’s original code.
paras.zh: 可移植性也贯穿于《毁灭战士》的 mod 文化中。模组制作者可以从数十个“源端口”中进行选择，这些“源端口”是粉丝根据 id 的原始代码改编的源代码的更改版本。

paras.en: “The source code took on a life of its own. And that was not something that id [Software] did. That was something that the community did,” Kelly says. “And the Doom community, uniquely, has been this long-standing example of how individuals can keep something alive and continue to innovate it.”
paras.zh: “源代码有了自己的生命。这不是 id [Software] 所做的事情。这是社区所做的事情，”Kelly 说。 “而《毁灭战士》社区是独一无二的，它长期以来一直是个人如何让某些东西保持活力并继续创新的典范。”

paras.en: Doom’s fan base is “one of the first game communities that spread predominantly online, as opposed to in person,” Kelly adds. Whatever keeps pulling people in—the memes, the game’s design, its resurgence during the pandemic or childhood nostalgia—the community has never really logged off.
paras.zh: 《毁灭战士》的粉丝群是“最早主要在网上传播的游戏社区之一，而不是面对面传播，”凯利补充道。无论是什么吸引着人们——模因、游戏的设计、疫情期间的复兴或童年的怀旧——社区从未真正退出。

paras.en: Back in Manhattan, the event was also a pop-up arcade, with several Doom mods set up on computers for attendees to try. (A nearby LaCroix station kept players hydrated.) My favorite mod had a mini art museum inside, where I viewed Pablo Picasso’s antiwar painting Guernica with a gun in my character’s hand, presumably to shoot monsters that—in this mod of the game—never came.
paras.zh: 回到曼哈顿，这次活动也是一个弹出式游戏机，在计算机上设置了几个《毁灭战士》模组，供与会者尝试。 （附近的拉克鲁瓦站让玩家保持水分。）我最喜欢的模组里面有一个迷你艺术博物馆，在那里我拿着枪观看巴勃罗·毕加索的反战画作《格尔尼卡》，大概是为了射击在这个游戏模组中从未出现过的怪物。

paras.en: “Anybody can sit down and get [Doom] within, I think, the first five minutes. And then maybe they get fascinated by it,” Kelly says. “It’s as shallow as a puddle and as deep as an ocean.”
paras.zh: “我认为，任何人都可以坐下来，在前五分钟内获得《毁灭战士》。然后也许他们会对此着迷，”凯利说。 “它浅如水坑，深如海。”

articles.title: Science to restore speech is moving fast. Here’s what’s next
articles.author: Laura Sanders

paras.en: Scientists are racing to restore people’s ability to communicate. Powerful AI-based methods to decode speech signals and predict words, along with advances in technology, promise success.
paras.zh: 科学家们正在竞相恢复人们的沟通能力。强大的基于人工智能的方法来解码语音信号和预测单词，加上技术的进步，有望取得成功。

paras.en: This episode of The Deep End: Talk to Me takes listeners through the breadth of scientific efforts to restore words, emotions and even gestures to people who can’t move or talk.
paras.zh: 这一集《深渊：对我说话》将带领听众了解科学努力的广度，以帮助无法移动或说话的人恢复言语、情感甚至手势。

paras.en: We’ll hear from Casey Harrell, a man with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis who can no longer talk. A user of today’s technology, Harrell has a unique perspective on what he’d like to see improved for the technology of tomorrow.
paras.zh: 我们将听到凯西·哈勒尔 (Casey Harrell) 的来信，他患有肌萎缩侧索硬化症，无法说话。作为当今技术的用户，哈雷尔对于他希望看到未来技术的改进有着独特的视角。

paras.en: And as season two wraps up, listeners will be left with a reminder of the power of a voice: a piece of comedy from Jules Rodriguez, performed with his voice clone in front of a live crowd.
paras.zh: 随着第二季的结束，听众将记住声音的力量：朱尔斯·罗德里格斯的一部喜剧，在现场观众面前用他的声音克隆表演。

paras.en: “Being backstage and then seeing him come out, like, roll out his wheelchair, and everybody goes nuts because they’re like, ‘What is going on here? This doesn’t make sense,’” says Jules’ wife, Maria Aleandra Fernandez. “And every time I was like, ‘This is life. This is love. This is passion. What else is there?’ I don’t know that there’s anything else more powerful than what this guy is doing here.”
paras.zh: “在后台，然后看到他出来，就像推出轮椅一样，每个人都疯了，因为他们会说，‘这里发生了什么事？这没有道理，’”朱尔斯的妻子玛丽亚·阿利安德拉·费尔南德斯 (Maria Aleandra Fernandez) 说道。 “每次我都会想，‘这就是生活。这就是爱。这就是激情。还有什么？’我不知道还有什么比这个家伙在这里所做的事情更强大的了。”

paras.en: Laura Sanders: OK, I want to ask who your favorite comedians are and why. Who makes you all laugh?
paras.zh: 劳拉·桑德斯：好的，我想问你最喜欢的喜剧演员是谁以及为什么。谁让大家笑了？

paras.en: Jules Rodriguez: Pete Holmes and Mike Birbiglia are some of my favorites.
paras.zh: 朱尔斯·罗德里格斯：皮特·霍尔姆斯和迈克·比尔比利亚是我的最爱。

paras.en: [Audio] He was just like, I’m a bear, et cetera.
paras.zh: [音频]他就像，我是一只熊，等等。

paras.en: [Audio] The best part of sleep is falling asleep. That’s the only part you’re there for.
paras.zh: [音频] 睡眠最好的部分就是入睡。这是你唯一要做的事情。

paras.en: Jules: Their styles are different, but I have always gravitated towards their authenticity.
paras.zh: Jules：他们的风格不同，但我一直偏向于他们的真实性。

paras.en: Sanders: There’s another comedian who is extra meaningful for Jules: Conan O’Brien.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：还有一位喜剧演员对朱尔斯来说特别有意义：柯南·奥布莱恩。

paras.en: [Audio] Today is a bit of a different sort of episode. I’ll be talking to Jules and Maria.
paras.zh: [音频] 今天的情节有点不同。我要和朱尔斯和玛丽亚说话。

paras.en: Sanders: After MA had reached out, Conan invited the couple onto his podcast, where they connected about comedy. Conan still checks in on Jules every so often.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：MA 联系后，柯南邀请这对夫妇加入他的播客，他们在那里谈论喜剧。柯南仍然时不时地来看望朱尔斯。

paras.en: [Audio] It’s incredible to me that in our conversations, you’re very frank about the pain that you go through, and how intense it is. But you’re also always so positive and funny and, frankly, you give me a lot of [beep]. Which I find to be, well I hate it, by the way, first of all. Oh, get over it, Conan.
paras.zh: [音频]令我难以置信的是，在我们的谈话中，你非常坦率地讲述了你所经历的痛苦，以及它有多么强烈。但你也总是那么积极、有趣，坦率地说，你给了我很多[嘟嘟]。我发现，顺便说一句，首先，我讨厌它。哦，克服它，柯南。

paras.en: Jules: Conan is very special to me. Watching and listening to him helped me disconnect from the harsh reality of my life. And when I got to meet him and chat with him, it meant the world to me.
paras.zh: 朱尔斯：柯南对我来说很特别。观看和聆听他的讲话帮助我摆脱了生活中严酷的现实。当我见到他并与他聊天时，这对我来说意味着整个世界。

paras.en: Maria Aleandra Fernandez: Having the most normal conversation with Conan O’Brien is something I will never get over.
paras.zh: 玛丽亚·阿利安德拉·费尔南德斯：与柯南·奥布莱恩进行最正常的对话是我永远无法克服的事情。

paras.en: [Audio] So he has a bunch of banked phrases. He’s going to play a few of our favorites. OK. I’m fine. I’m perfectly [beep] fine. [laughter] Come on man, are we doing this or not? Oh my God, oh my God. I’m destroying this marriage.
paras.zh: [音频]所以他有一堆储存的短语。他将演奏一些我们最喜欢的曲目。好的。我很好。我很好[哔]很好。 [笑声]来吧伙计，我们到底要不要这样做？天啊，天啊。我正在毁掉这段婚姻。

paras.en: MA: He really is so genuine and like, not only willing to talk to us, but really looks forward to talking. Like, I love talking to you guys. I’m not just doing it to be a nice person, which feels, you know, feels wonderful.
paras.zh: MA：他真的很真诚，很喜欢，不仅愿意和我们交谈，而且真的很期待交谈。就像，我喜欢和你们聊天。我这样做不仅仅是为了成为一个好人，这感觉，你知道，感觉很棒。

paras.en: [Audio] You have my love, my respect and we’re thinking about you guys all the time.
paras.zh: [音频]你们拥有我的爱、我的尊重，我们一直在想着你们。

paras.en: Sanders: As you were talking earlier, it made me think about what it means to make somebody laugh and to entertain them, and like how actually very, very special that must be. Just kind of, at its heart, it’s, it is joy and humans connecting. And so, extra special.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：正如你之前所说，这让我思考让别人发笑并娱乐他们意味着什么，并且喜欢这实际上是非常非常特别的。从本质上讲，它是快乐和人类的联系。所以，格外特别。

paras.en: MA: That’s the other thing I’ve learned mainly through Jules, about humor and comedy. And who were we watching yesterday? The NPR interview with Dave Chappelle.
paras.zh: MA：这是我主要通过朱尔斯学到的另一件事，关于幽默和喜剧。昨天我们看谁了？美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 采访戴夫·查佩尔 (Dave Chappelle)。

paras.en: [Audio] Dave Chappelle says he is very clear about his role as a comedian.
paras.zh: [音频]戴夫·查普尔说他非常清楚自己作为喜剧演员的角色。

paras.en: MA: And Dave Chappelle said something that is so spot-on. He said that comedians are how people metabolize things.
paras.zh: MA：戴夫·查佩尔（Dave Chappelle）说了一些非常准确的话。他说喜剧演员就是人们代谢事物的方式。

paras.en: [Audio] We’re like the nation’s kidney. We help everyone metabolize not just facts, but feelings around facts, or ideas. And jokes are just a shorthand for all of that.
paras.zh: [音频]我们就像国家的肾脏。我们不仅帮助每个人代谢事实，还帮助每个人代谢事实或想法的感受。笑话只是所有这一切的简写。

paras.en: MA: And I’m also a nerd and I’ve been reading some Greek tragedies and studying about how, you know, that’s also like the artists that help people metabolize feelings and emotions. And when he said that, I was like, that’s exactly it. And that’s what Jules has done.
paras.zh: MA：我也是一个书呆子，我一直在读一些希腊悲剧，并研究如何，你知道，这也像艺术家一样帮助人们代谢感觉和情绪。当他这么说时，我想，就是这样。这就是朱尔斯所做的。

paras.en: It’s something that heals. And it’s not even like it’s self-deprecating. It’s not like, oh, let’s make fun. And the way he does it is so smart and genuine, but also not taking himself seriously. It just disarms everything. You’re just like, oh, OK. And that idea of metabolizing the really hard feelings that come around grief, mortality, losing a person, seeing how he’s trapped in his body, but he chooses not to be trapped in that really big way is so profound.
paras.zh: 这是一种可以治愈的东西。而且这甚至不像是自嘲。这不像是，哦，让我们开玩笑吧。他的做法是如此聪明和真诚，但也不把自己当回事。它只会解除一切武装。你就像，哦，好吧。代谢掉悲伤、死亡、失去一个人所带来的真正痛苦的感觉，看到他如何被困在自己的身体里，但他选择不被困在那个真正的大方式中，这种想法是如此深刻。

paras.en: Sanders: Science is iterative. It builds. It may take a wrong turn or two, but overall, it’s moving toward a deeper understanding of our world and of ourselves.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：科学是迭代的。它建立了。它可能会走一两个错误的弯路，但总的来说，它正在朝着对我们的世界和我们自己有更深入的了解的方向发展。

paras.en: By using their voices, by telling their stories, by telling their jokes, Jules and MA are helping me, and maybe you too, metabolize the pain – and the joy – of living. Welcome to The Deep End, Talk to Me.
paras.zh: 通过使用他们的声音，通过讲述他们的故事，通过讲他们的笑话，朱尔斯和马正在帮助我，也许你也是，代谢生活中的痛苦和快乐。欢迎来到深渊，跟我说话。

paras.en: [Voices] Hey mom, can I tell you something? Hi. Do you want to talk? That added layer of it being you. Hello? Your voice. Hi.
paras.zh: [声音] 嘿妈妈，我可以告诉你一件事吗？你好。你想说话吗？那增加的一层就是你。你好？你的声音。你好。

paras.en: Sanders: I’m Laura Sanders and today, we’re going to look ahead to what’s coming next for the human voice and efforts to restore it.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：我是劳拉·桑德斯，今天，我们将展望人类声音的下一步发展以及恢复它的努力。

paras.en: Sanders: In some ways, this podcast is a story of progress, of figuring out, little by little, more about the brain, and more about technology and more about people. Today, Jules can type with his eyes, and his son can hear his dad’s voice say I love you. In earlier episodes, you heard from Casey Harrell.
