paras.en: The newly revealed terrain raises intriguing questions about how the asteroid's surface developed and whether NASA's collision with Dimorphos may have left traces on its larger neighbor.
paras.zh: 新发现的地形提出了一些有趣的问题：这颗小行星的表面是如何发育的，以及美国宇航局与迪莫弗斯的碰撞是否可能在它更大的邻居身上留下了痕迹。

paras.en: When DART struck Dimorphos, the impact sent material flying into space. Scientists believe some of that debris may have traveled across the roughly 1 km separating the two asteroids and reached Didymos. Determining whether this material contributed to the features now visible on its surface will be an important part of Hera's investigation.
paras.zh: 当 DART 击中 Dimorphos 时，撞击使物质飞入太空。科学家认为，其中一些碎片可能已经穿越了两颗小行星之间约 1 公里的距离，到达了迪迪莫斯。确定这种材料是否促成了其表面现在可见的特征将是赫拉调查的重要组成部分。

paras.en: ESA's Hera mission scientist Michael Kueppers adds: "Since we expect a lot of impact-ejected material to have made it across the approximately 1 km of space from Dimorphos to Didymos, it may be that some of these characteristics originate from this transport of material, and we have exciting work ahead of us to sort it out. We look forward to seeing much more of both bodies and systemically mapping all the changes we identify."
paras.zh: 欧空局赫拉任务科学家迈克尔·库珀斯补充道：“由于我们预计大量撞击抛射物质会穿过从 Dimorphos 到 Didymos 大约 1 公里的空间，因此其中一些特征可能源于这种物质传输，我们需要开展令人兴奋的工作来解决这个问题。我们期待看到更多的这两个天体，并系统地绘制出我们发现的所有变化。”

paras.en: NASA's DART Mission Changed an Asteroid's Orbit
paras.zh: NASA 的 DART 任务改变了小行星的轨道

paras.en: Although Dimorphos is largely obscured in Hera's new image, it holds a remarkable place in space exploration history. It became the first object in the Solar System to have its orbit measurably altered by human activity.
paras.zh: 尽管狄莫佛斯在赫拉的新形象中很大程度上被掩盖了，但它在太空探索史上占有重要的地位。它成为太阳系中第一个其轨道因人类活动而发生可测量改变的天体。

paras.en: NASA achieved this milestone by sending the 580 kg DART spacecraft into Dimorphos at approximately 6.1 km/s. The collision reduced the time the smaller asteroid takes to complete an orbit around Didymos by about 33 minutes, give or take a minute. That change was substantially greater than scientists had anticipated.
paras.zh: NASA 通过将 580 公斤重的 DART 航天器以大约 6.1 公里/秒的速度送入 Dimorphos 实现了这一里程碑。这次碰撞使这颗较小的小行星绕 Didymos 绕一圈的时间缩短了约 33 分钟（相差一分钟）。这种变化远远大于科学家的预期。

paras.en: The experiment demonstrated that striking an asteroid with a spacecraft can change its motion through space. This approach, known as kinetic impact deflection, could potentially be used to redirect a dangerous asteroid before it reaches Earth.
paras.zh: 该实验表明，用航天器撞击小行星可以改变其在太空中的运动。这种方法被称为动能撞击偏转，有可能用于在危险的小行星到达地球之前改变其方向。

paras.en: Hera Begins Its Investigation of NASA's Asteroid Impact
paras.zh: 赫拉开始调查美国宇航局小行星撞击事件

paras.en: After a two-year journey, Hera has reached the double asteroid system, located 196.8 million km from Earth. The spacecraft is now preparing for a detailed 'crash site investigation' to examine the consequences of NASA's groundbreaking experiment.
paras.zh: 经过两年的旅程，赫拉到达了距离地球 1.968 亿公里的双小行星系统。该航天器目前正在准备进行详细的“坠机现场调查”，以检查美国宇航局开创性实验的后果。

paras.en: While DART demonstrated that an asteroid's orbit could be changed through a deliberate collision, Hera will help scientists understand the physical processes behind the result. By examining both asteroids and documenting their characteristics, researchers hope to improve their ability to predict how future asteroid deflection attempts might work.
paras.zh: 虽然 DART 证明小行星的轨道可以通过故意碰撞而改变，但赫拉将帮助科学家了解结果背后的物理过程。通过检查这两颗小行星并记录它们的特征，研究人员希望提高他们预测未来小行星偏转尝试可能如何进行的能力。

paras.en: The findings could help transform kinetic impact deflection from a successful one-time demonstration into a dependable, repeatable planetary defense technique. Such a capability could prove critical if an asteroid were ever discovered on a collision course with Earth.
paras.zh: 这些发现有助于将动能撞击偏转从一次成功的一次性演示转变为一种可靠、可重复的行星防御技术。如果在与地球相撞的过程中发现小行星，这种能力可能至关重要。

paras.en: "Seeing this image is a hugely exciting moment for the whole Hera family," comments Hera mission manager Ian Carnelli. "It has taken years of hard work and dedication to reach this point - but we're motivated to know that the adventure is only beginning!"
paras.zh: “看到这张照片对于整个 Hera 家族来说是一个非常激动人心的时刻，”Hera 任务经理 Ian Carnelli 评论道。 “我们经过多年的努力和奉献才达到这一点 - 但我们很高兴知道冒险才刚刚开始！”

paras.en: The mission's next major reveal is scheduled for November 25, when detailed images of both Didymos and Dimorphos will be unveiled, giving scientists and the public a closer look at the asteroids involved in humanity's first successful asteroid deflection experiment.
paras.zh: 该任务的下一次重大揭示定于 11 月 25 日进行，届时将公布 Didymos 和 Dimorphos 的详细图像，让科学家和公众能够更近距离地观察人类首次成功的小行星偏转实验中涉及的小行星。

paras.en: Materials provided by European Space Agency (ESA). Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由欧洲航天局 (ESA) 提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: The Leonid meteor shower peaks Nov. 17-18! Here's what you need to know
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: The Leonid meteor shower peaks Nov. 17-18 sending shooting stars and fireballs across the autumn sky as Earth passes through a stream of debris left by Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle.
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨于 11 月 17 日至 18 日达到顶峰，当地球穿过 55P/坦普尔-塔特尔彗星留下的碎片流时，流星和火球划过秋季的天空。

paras.en: Up to 15 meteors could be spotted per hour under perfect dark sky conditions on the night of Nov. 17-18, according to the International Meteor Organisation. NASA, meanwhile, has given a more conservative rate of less than three meteors per hour — time will tell.
paras.zh: 据国际流星组织称，11 月 17 日至 18 日夜间，在完美的黑暗天空条件下，每小时可以发现多达 15 颗流星。与此同时，美国宇航局给出了一个更保守的速率，每小时少于三颗流星——时间会证明一切。

paras.en: Leonid meteors appear to race away from a point of origin, or radiant, in the constellation Leo, which glistens high above the southeastern horizon in the hours before dawn in mid-November. Both Jupiter and Mars will be separated by just a few degrees in the constellation Leo on the night of the peak, making it particularly easy to find in 2026!
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨似乎从狮子座的起源点或辐射点飞驰而去，11 月中旬黎明前的几个小时，狮子座在东南地平线上空闪闪发光。木星和火星在峰值之夜都将在狮子座相距几度，这使得 2026 年特别容易找到！

paras.en: When is the best time to look for Leonid meteors?
paras.zh: 什么时候是寻找狮子座流星的最佳时间？

paras.en: The best time to spot Leonids is in the hours before dawn on Nov. 18, when the radiant will reach its highest point in the southeastern sky, maximizing the amount of meteors that may be seen skimming through Earth's atmosphere. By then, the waxing moon will have set, leaving darker skies and a better chance of spotting fainter meteors.
paras.zh: 观测狮子座流星雨的最佳时间是 11 月 18 日黎明前的几个小时，届时辐射点将达到东南天空的最高点，从而使掠过地球大气层的流星数量最大化。到那时，盈月将会落下，天空变得更加黑暗，并且更有机会发现较暗的流星。

paras.en: Shooting stars that appear close to the radiant will strike Earth almost head-on, leaving the shortest trails. Instead, find a patch of sky a short distance away from the constellation Leo, where the meteors will be at their most impressive, and give your eyes 20-30 minutes to fully adapt to the dark.
paras.zh: 靠近辐射点的流星几乎会正面撞击地球，留下最短的轨迹。相反，请在距离狮子座不远的地方找到一块天空，那里的流星最为令人印象深刻，然后让您的眼睛有 20 到 30 分钟的时间来完全适应黑暗。

paras.en: As if shooting stars weren't enough, the Leonid shower is also known for spawning dazzling fireballs and long-lasting Earth-grazing meteors, which strike our atmosphere at an oblique angle, leaving long trains as they skim through before passing back out into space.
paras.zh: 似乎流星还不够，狮子座流星雨还因产生耀眼的火球和持久的掠地流星而闻名，它们以倾斜的角度撞击我们的大气层，在飞回太空之前留下长长的列车。

paras.en: The shower is also capable of producing magnificent meteor storms when Earth passes through particularly dense trails of debris left behind by Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle, which orbits the sun approximately every 33 years. Sadly, we'll have to wait a bit for the next big show. According to the Planetary Society, another Leonid meteor storm could occur as early as 2031, while a study released in August 2026 predicts potentially spectacular displays in 2033 and 2034.
paras.zh: 当地球经过 55P/坦普尔-塔特尔彗星留下的特别密集的碎片轨迹时，流星雨还能够产生壮观的流星风暴，彗星大约每 33 年绕太阳运行一次。遗憾的是，我们还得等待下一场大型演出。据行星协会称，另一场狮子座流星雨最早可能在 2031 年发生，而 2026 年 8 月发布的一项研究预测，2033 年和 2034 年可能会出现壮观的景象。

paras.en: Want to photograph a shooting star? Then be sure to read our guide to imaging shooting stars, along with our selections of the best lenses and cameras for astrophotography on the market in 2026.
paras.zh: 想拍摄流星吗？那么请务必阅读我们的流星成像指南，以及我们精选的 2026 年市场上用于天文摄影的最佳镜头和相机。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you would like to share your Leonid photos with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享您的狮子座照片，请将您的照片、评论以及您的姓名和位置发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: 'Maybe the scariest thing I've heard in my life': Artemis II astronaut Victor Glover reveals his toughest challenge before flying to the moon
articles.author: Daisy Dobrijevic

paras.en: TENERIFE, Canary Islands — Former NASA astronaut Victor Glover has flown in combat, performed four spacewalks and strapped himself to the top of rockets launching into space. But before embarking on his historic Artemis II journey around the moon, he faced something even more difficult: a conversation with his four daughters.
paras.zh: 加那利群岛特内里费岛——前美国宇航局宇航员维克多·格洛弗 (Victor Glover) 曾参加过战斗飞行，进行过四次太空行走，并将自己绑在发射升空的火箭顶部。但在开始他历史性的阿耳忒弥斯二号绕月之旅之前，他面临着更困难的事情：与他的四个女儿的对话。

paras.en: Speaking alongside former astronaut Chris Hadfield at the Starmus VIII festival in Tenerife, Canary Islands, on Oct. 18, Glover opened up about the challenges of preparing his family for his riskiest mission yet.
paras.zh: 10 月 18 日，格洛弗在加那利群岛特内里费岛举行的 Starmus VIII 音乐节上与前宇航员克里斯·哈德菲尔德 (Chris Hadfield) 一起发表讲话，谈到了让家人为他迄今为止最危险的任务做好准备所面临的挑战。

paras.en: "This is maybe the greatest challenge of my astronaut career," Glover said.
paras.zh: “这可能是我宇航员生涯中最大的挑战，”格洛弗说。

paras.en: Glover joined NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman and Christina Koch and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen aboard NASA's Artemis II mission, which launched on April 1, 2026, marking humanity's first crewed journey to the moon since Apollo 17 in 1972.
paras.zh: 格洛弗与 NASA 宇航员 Reid Wiseman 和 Christina Koch 以及加拿大航天局宇航员 Jeremy Hansen 一起登上了 NASA 的 Artemis II 任务，该任务于 2026 年 4 月 1 日发射，标志着自 1972 年阿波罗 17 号以来人类首次载人登月之旅。

paras.en: But preparing for the historic journey wasn't just about mastering the spacecraft and executing the mission successfully. It also meant making sure his family was ready for what lay ahead.
paras.zh: 但为这一历史性的旅程做准备并不仅仅是掌握航天器并成功执行任务。这也意味着确保他的家人为即将发生的事情做好准备。

paras.en: When Glover first traveled to space aboard SpaceX's Crew-1 mission in 2020, his children were much younger and he and his wife, Dionna, made a conscious effort to prepare them for his time in space.
paras.zh: 2020 年，格洛弗首次搭乘 SpaceX 的 Crew-1 任务前往太空时，他的孩子们还小得多，他和妻子迪安娜 (Dionna) 有意识地努力让他们为自己的太空之旅做好准备。

paras.en: "We decided, as a parental unit, Dionna and I, that we were going to put as much effort into making sure our family was ready as NASA was putting into making sure I was ready to be a crew member," Glover explained.
paras.zh: 格洛弗解释说：“作为一个家长，我和迪安娜决定，我们将尽一切努力确保我们的家庭做好准备，就像美国宇航局确保我准备好成为一名宇航员一样。”

paras.en: The family visited NASA's Kennedy Space Center, toured the launch pad and crew quarters and even planned when Glover would call home from the International Space Station. But by the time Artemis II came around, things were different. All four of his daughters were now adults, and preparing them for his journey around the moon meant discussing the mission's risks, including the possibility that he might not return home.
paras.zh: 一家人参观了美国宇航局的肯尼迪航天中心，参观了发射台和机组人员宿舍，甚至计划了格洛弗何时从国际空间站打电话回家。但当阿耳忒弥斯二世出现时，情况就不同了。他的四个女儿现在都已经成年，为她们准备绕月之旅意味着要讨论这次任务的风险，包括他可能无法回家的可能性。

paras.en: Glover recalled his wife telling him something he described as maybe the scariest thing he'd ever heard.
paras.zh: 格洛弗回忆起他的妻子告诉他的事情，他称这可能是他听过的最可怕的事情。

paras.en: "You should have this talk with our daughters."
paras.zh: “你应该和我们的女儿们谈谈。”

paras.en: And although he knew she was right, it wasn't an easy conversation to have.
paras.zh: 尽管他知道她是对的，但这并不是一次轻松的谈话。

paras.en: "We did, and it did not go well in my opinion," Glover admitted. "Well, it's not about going well. The talk needed to be done, just because it's hard."
paras.zh: “我们做到了，但在我看来进展并不顺利，”格洛弗承认。 “嗯，这不是为了进展顺利。谈话需要完成，只是因为它很难。”

paras.en: The following day, Glover sent his daughters and wife a poem, Live Your Life, by Chief Tecumseh.
paras.zh: 第二天，格洛弗给他的女儿和妻子寄了一首特库姆塞酋长的诗《过你的生活》。

paras.en: The poem helped Glover express something he had struggled to put into words during their conversation: why he believed the risks of traveling to the moon were worth taking.
paras.zh: 这首诗帮助格洛弗表达了他在谈话中难以用语言表达的一些东西：为什么他相信去月球旅行的风险是值得冒的。

paras.en: "It was a very tough conversation, but they understood that I know this is risky. I wasn't just telling them Dad's risking his life. There's a real point to this and there's a reason to take this risk," Glover explained. "This poem helped me to say it in a way that I didn't have words for."
paras.zh: “这是一次非常艰难的谈话，但他们明白我知道这是有风险的。我不仅仅是告诉他们爸爸正在冒着生命危险。这确实有道理，也有理由冒这个险，”格洛弗解释道。 “这首诗帮助我以一种我无以言表的方式表达它。”

paras.en: After traveling around the moon and returning safely to Earth, one moment stood out above all others. When we asked Glover in a separate interview at Starmus on Oct. 20, which moment from Artemis II he would most like to relive, he answered immediately.
paras.zh: 在绕月旅行并安全返回地球之后，有一个时刻比其他时刻更加引人注目。 10 月 20 日，当我们在 Starmus 的另一次采访中问格洛弗，他最想重温《阿尔忒弥斯 II》中的哪个时刻时，他立即回答了。

paras.en: "It's the true, ultimate mission accomplishment. Just 'we did it.' We survived. My family is relieved, and there's just nothing like it," Glover explained. "There's nothing like coming home. There's nothing like returning to Earth."
paras.zh: “这是真正的、最终的使命成就。只是‘我们做到了’。”我们活了下来。我的家人松了一口气，没有什么比这更好的了，”格洛弗解释道。 “没有什么比回家更好的了。没有什么比回到地球更好的了。”

paras.en: Daisy Dobrijevic joined Space.com in February 2022, having previously worked as a staff writer for All About Space magazine. She completed an editorial internship with BBC Sky at Night Magazine and worked at the National Space Centre, communicating space science to the public.
paras.zh: Daisy Dobrijevic 于 2022 年 2 月加入 Space.com，此前曾担任《All About Space》杂志的特约撰稿人。她完成了 BBC Sky 夜间杂志的编辑实习，并在国家航天中心工作，向公众传播空间科学。

paras.en: Daisy holds a PhD in plant physiology and a Master's in Environmental Science. Based in Nottingham, U.K., she covers all things space, with a special focus on solar activity and space weather. She also has a keen interest in astrotourism and is always on the lookout for the next northern lights adventure.
paras.zh: 黛西拥有植物生理学博士学位和环境科学硕士学位。她居住在英国诺丁汉，研究太空的所有事物，特别关注太阳活动和太空天气。她还对天文旅游有着浓厚的兴趣，并且总是在寻找下一次北极光冒险。

paras.en: She will join Hurtigruten as an onboard astronomer for a northern lights sailing in January 2027.
paras.zh: 她将作为船上天文学家加入海达路德号，于 2027 年 1 月进行北极光航行。

articles.title: What exactly is a light-day? Here's what Voyager 1's latest milestone means for the interstellar probe
articles.author: Samantha Mathewson

paras.en: After nearly 50 years traveling through space, NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft is approaching a milestone no human-made object has reached before: a distance of one light-day from Earth.
paras.zh: 经过近 50 年的太空旅行，美国宇航局的航海者 1 号宇宙飞船正在接近一个人造物体从未达到过的里程碑：距地球一光日的距离。

paras.en: This milestone — which Voyager 1 is expected to reach on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, at 5:16:07 a.m. EST (1016:07 GMT) — highlights the immense distances Voyager 1 has traveled and the challenges of communicating with spacecraft operating in the outer reaches of the solar system and beyond.
paras.zh: 航海者 1 号预计将于美国东部时间 2026 年 11 月 18 日星期三上午 5:16:07（格林尼治标准时间 1016:07）到达这一里程碑，突显航海者 1 号已经行驶了很长的距离，以及与在太阳系外围及更远的地方运行的航天器进行通信所面临的挑战。

paras.en: Astronomers use a measurement known as a light-day to describe how far light travels in 24 hours. Light moves at approximately 186,000 miles (300,000 kilometers) per second, meaning one light-day is roughly 16 billion miles (about 26 billion kilometers), according to a statement from NASA.
paras.zh: 天文学家使用光日测量来描述光在 24 小时内传播的距离。根据 NASA 的一份声明，光的移动速度约为每秒 186,000 英里（300,000 公里），这意味着一个光日大约为 160 亿英里（约 260 亿公里）。

paras.en: Although the term light-day might sound like a measurement of time, it is actually a unit of distance, much like a light-year. Astronomers use light-based measurements because conventional miles and kilometers become increasingly difficult to comprehend when describing the enormous distances between objects in space.
paras.zh: 虽然光日这个术语听起来像是时间的测量单位，但它实际上是一个距离单位，很像光年。天文学家使用基于光的测量，因为在描述太空中物体​​之间的巨大距离时，传统的英里和公里变得越来越难以理解。

paras.en: For perspective on how far Voyager 1 has travelled, sunlight takes about eight minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth, meaning our planet is approximately 8.3 light-minutes from the sun. Radio signals traveling between Earth and Mars can take anywhere from three to 22 minutes, depending on the planets' positions in their orbits, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 从航海者 1 号的飞行距离来看，阳光大约需要 8 分 20 秒才能到达地球，这意味着我们的星球距离太阳大约 8.3 光分钟。声明称，无线电信号在地球和火星之间传输可能需要 3 到 22 分钟，具体时间取决于行星在轨道上的位置。

paras.en: By comparison, when Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth, a radio signal sent from the probe will take a full 24 hours to reach mission controllers on Earth, and a command transmitted from Earth will take another 24 hours to reach the spacecraft.
paras.zh: 相比之下，当旅行者一号到达距离地球一光日时，从探测器发出的无线电信号将需要整整 24 小时才能到达地球上的任务控制器，而从地球发送的命令将另外需要 24 小时才能到达航天器。

paras.en: The communication delay affects how engineers operate spacecraft at such distances. Unlike spacecraft operating closer to Earth, which can receive commands and return data with relatively little delay, communicating with Voyager 1 requires mission controllers to account for the extended signal travel time when planning spacecraft operations, troubleshooting technical issues and evaluating the results of commands sent to the probe.
paras.zh: 通信延迟会影响工程师在如此距离内操作航天器的方式。与靠近地球运行的航天器不同，航天器可以以相对较小的延迟接收命令和返回数据，与航行者一号通信需要任务控制器在规划航天器操作、解决技术问题和评估发送到探测器的命令结果时考虑延长的信号传播时间。

paras.en: Voyager 1 has been traveling away from Earth since its launch on Sept. 5, 1977. Now cruising through interstellar space at nearly 38,000 mph (61,000 kph), the spacecraft has spent more than 49 years covering the distance that light can cross in a single day.
paras.zh: 自 1977 年 9 月 5 日发射以来，旅行者 1 号一直在远离地球的地方航行。现在，这艘航天器以近 38,000 英里/小时（61,000 公里/小时）的速度在星际空间中巡航，它已经用了超过 49 年的时间来完成光在一天内可以穿越的距离。

paras.en: Even at that speed, Voyager 1 is moving relatively slowly compared with light itself. Its twin, Voyager 2, which launched in 1977 on a different trajectory, is expected to reach the same one-light-day milestone in November 2035.
paras.zh: 即使以这样的速度，与光速相比，航海者一号的移动速度也相对较慢。它的双胞胎航海者 2 号于 1977 年以不同的轨道发射，预计将在 2035 年 11 月达到同样的一光日里程碑。

paras.en: As Voyager 1 and, eventually, Voyager 2 continue their journeys through interstellar space, their growing distances from Earth offer a measure of both the reach of human exploration and the communication challenges that come with sending spacecraft ever farther into the cosmos.
paras.zh: 随着航海者 1 号和最终航海者 2 号继续穿越星际空间的旅程，它们与地球的距离越来越远，这既衡量了人类探索的范围，也衡量了将航天器送入更远的宇宙所带来的通信挑战。

paras.en: Samantha Mathewson joined Space.com as an intern in the summer of 2016. She received a B.A. in Journalism and Environmental Science at the University of New Haven, in Connecticut. Previously, her work has been published in Nature World News. When not writing or reading about science, Samantha enjoys traveling to new places and taking photos! You can follow her on Twitter @Sam_Ashley13.
paras.zh: Samantha Mathewson 于 2016 年夏天作为实习生加入 Space.com。她获得了学士学位。康涅狄格州纽黑文大学新闻学和环境科学专业。此前，她的研究成果曾发表在《自然·世界新闻》上。当不撰写或阅读有关科学的内容时，萨曼莎喜欢去新的地方旅行并拍照！您可以在 Twitter 上关注她@Sam_Ashley13。

articles.title: ESCAPADE on its way to Mars after Earth flybys
articles.author: Jeff Foust

paras.en: WASHINGTON — Two NASA smallsats are headed toward Mars after completing flybys of Earth nearly a year after their launch.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——美国宇航局的两颗小型卫星在发射近一年后完成了对地球的飞越，目前正飞往火星。

paras.en: The second of two Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers, or ESCAPADE, spacecraft, nicknamed Gold, flew by Earth at about 6 a.m. Eastern Nov. 9, coming within about 1,050 kilometers of Earth. That took place a little more than 48 hours after the first ESCAPADE spacecraft, Blue, made a similar flyby at an altitude of about 1,600 kilometers.
paras.zh: 两艘逃逸与等离子体加速与动力学探测器（ESCAPADE）中的第二艘，昵称“黄金”，于 11 月 9 日东部时间早上 6 点左右飞过地球，距离地球约 1,050 公里。距离第一艘 ESCAPADE 太空飞船“蓝色”号在大约 1,600 公里高度进行类似飞越 48 小时多一点。

paras.en: During both flybys, the Rocket Lab-built spacecraft fired their engines, using a principle called the Oberth effect to maximize the performance of the maneuver. It was the first time a NASA spacecraft used such a powered flyby to go to Mars.
paras.zh: 在两次飞越过程中，火箭实验室制造的航天器都启动了发动机，利用奥伯特效应原理来最大限度地提高机动性能。这是美国宇航局航天器首次使用这种动力飞越火星。

paras.en: “This is the first time NASA has used a powered Earth flyby to propel a spacecraft toward Mars, and we’ve now executed this maneuver twice, flawlessly, in just two days,” Asal Naseri, acting associate flight director in NASA’s heliophysics division, said in an agency statement.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局太阳物理部门代理飞行副主任阿萨尔·纳塞里（Asal Naseri）在一份机构声明中表示：“这是美国宇航局第一次使用动力飞越地球来推动航天器飞向火星，我们现在已经在短短两天内完美地执行了两次这种机动。”

paras.en: ESCAPADE is taking a nontraditional approach to going to Mars. Rather than launch during short windows that open roughly every two years, ESCAPADE launched last November on the second flight of Blue Origin’s New Glenn. The two spacecraft loitered around the Earth-sun L-2 Lagrange point for nearly a year before swinging around Earth in a final maneuver before heading to Mars.
paras.zh: ESCAPADE 正在采取一种非传统的方式前往火星。 ESCAPADE 并没有在大约每两年开放一次的短暂窗口期间发射，而是于去年 11 月在蓝色起源公司 New Glenn 的第二次飞行中发射。这两艘航天器在地球-太阳 L-2 拉格朗日点周围徘徊了近一年，然后在前往火星之前进行最后一次绕地球摆动。

paras.en: That trajectory was developed by Advanced Space as a means of opening up Mars mission launch opportunities outside of traditional windows. “This method provides the flexibility to launch almost anytime and then use Earth’s gravity to get a boost to Mars, rather than waiting every two years to launch there directly when the planets are aligned,” said Jeff Parker of Advanced Space in a statement.
paras.zh: 该轨道由 Advanced Space 开发，作为在传统窗口之外开辟火星任务发射机会的一种手段。高级太空公司的杰夫·帕克在一份声明中表示：“这种方法提供了几乎随时发射的灵活性，然后利用地球引力来推动火星，而不是每两年等待一次，当行星对齐时直接发射到火星。”

paras.en: That approach, though, required a precise burn by each spacecraft’s main engine as they flew by Earth. “These burns were critical in the same way a Mars orbit insertion burn is,” Rob Lillis, principal investigator for ESCAPADE, said during a Nov. 9 meeting of the Mars Exploration Program Analysis Group. “I’m happy to report that they went well. They were executed perfectly.”
paras.zh: 然而，这种方法需要每艘航天器飞过地球时其主发动机进行精确燃烧。 ESCAPADE 首席研究员 Rob Lillis 在 11 月 9 日的火星探索计划分析小组会议上表示：“这些烧伤的重要性与火星轨道插入烧伤的重要性相同。” “我很高兴地报告，他们进展顺利。他们被完美地执行了。”

paras.en: The maneuvers put both spacecraft on trajectories to Mars, arriving two days apart in September 2027. Each spacecraft will perform an 11-minute burn of its main engine to go into orbit around Mars, later maneuvering into its planned science orbit.
paras.zh: 此次演习使两艘航天器都沿着飞往火星的轨道，于 2027 年 9 月抵达，相隔两天。每艘航天器都将对其主发动机进行 11 分钟的燃烧，以进入火星轨道，随后机动进入其计划的科学轨道。

paras.en: The two spacecraft will study space weather at Mars, examining how the solar wind interacts with the planet’s magnetosphere and atmosphere. The spacecraft will first perform those observations in the same orbit, separated from each other by up to 30 minutes to measure variations in space weather over time. They will later shift into separate orbits, with one spacecraft focusing on the incoming solar wind and the other on the effects on Mars.
paras.zh: 这两艘航天器将研究火星的太空天气，研究太阳风如何与火星磁层和大气层相互作用。该航天器将首先在同一轨道上进行这些观测，轨道之间的间隔最多为 30 分钟，以测量空间天气随时间的变化。随后，它们将转移到不同的轨道，其中一艘航天器专注于传入的太阳风，另一艘则关注对火星的影响。

paras.en: ESCAPADE is the last surviving mission of a NASA program called SIMPLEx, or Small Innovative Missions for Planetary Exploration, intended to support low-cost planetary science missions. NASA selected ESCAPADE for development in 2019 alongside two other SIMPLEx missions, the Janus asteroid flyby spacecraft and the Lunar Trailblazer orbiter.
paras.zh: ESCAPADE 是 NASA 计划 SIMPLEx（即行星探索小型创新任务）中最后一个幸存的任务，旨在支持低成本的行星科学任务。 NASA 选择在 2019 年开发 ESCAPADE 以及另外两项 SIMPLEx 任务：“杰纳斯”小行星飞越航天器和“月球开拓者”轨道飞行器。

paras.en: However, NASA canceled Janus in 2023 after delays in the launch of the Psyche asteroid mission, on which Janus was a rideshare, prevented it from carrying out its planned asteroid flybys. Lunar Trailblazer malfunctioned shortly after its launch in February 2025, and NASA formally ended the mission five months later after efforts to recover it were unsuccessful.
paras.zh: 然而，NASA 于 2023 年取消了 Janus，原因是 Janus 共享乘车的 Psyche 小行星任务发射延迟，导致其无法执行计划中的小行星飞越任务。月球开拓者号于 2025 年 2 月发射后不久就发生故障，五个月后，美国宇航局在回收努力失败后正式结束了这次任务。

paras.en: Two previous cubesat-class SIMPLEx missions, LunaH-Map and Q-PACE, also failed after their launches. NASA, citing budget pressures, has not solicited proposals for new SIMPLEx missions and has not stated any plans to do so for the foreseeable future.
paras.zh: 之前的两次立方体卫星级 SIMPLEx 任务 LunaH-Map 和 Q-PACE 在发射后也失败了。 NASA 以预算压力为由，尚未征求有关新 SIMPLEx 任务的建议，也没有表示在可预见的未来有任何这样做的计划。

articles.title: What role does industry play in Europe’s space sovereignty push?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Jason Rainbow interviews Atle Woello, the CEO and senior vice president of the space systems and surveillance business unit at Kongsberg NanoAvionics. They discuss the role space plays for defense systems that are increasingly interconnected across domains, as well as the role that the European industrial base can play in the continent’s recent political and fundraising push to bolster sovereignty, independence and resilience in space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Jason Rainbow 采访了 Kongsberg NanoAvionics 空间系统和监视业务部门的首席执行官兼高级副总裁 Atle Woello。他们讨论了太空对于跨领域互联日益紧密的防御系统的作用，以及欧洲工业基础在欧洲大陆最近为加强太空主权、独立和复原力而进行的政治和筹款活动中可以发挥的作用。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Xiphos Systems.
paras.zh: 本集由 Xiphos Systems 赞助。

paras.en: Xiphos Systems develops compact, high-performance embedded computing solutions for spacecraft and aerospace applications. Founded in 1996 and based in Montreal, the company specializes in commercial off-the-shelf processing platforms designed for space, combining processors, programmable logic, storage, networking, and RF capabilities in low size, weight, power, and cost designs. Its portfolio includes processor boards, onboard computers, RF payload systems, and AI-capable computing platforms for satellites, launch vehicles, lunar missions, and robotics. With more than two decades of experience and over 1,000 processor cards delivered, Xiphos supports customers from system integration through deployment, helping bring reliable computing closer to the mission.
paras.zh: Xiphos Systems 为航天器和航空航天应用开发紧凑、高性能的嵌入式计算解决方案。该公司成立于 1996 年，总部位于蒙特利尔，专注于为太空设计的商用现成处理平台，将处理器、可编程逻辑、存储、网络和射频功能与低尺寸、重量、功耗和成本设计相结合。其产品组合包括处理器板、机载计算机、射频有效载荷系统以及用于卫星、运载火箭、月球任务和机器人的人工智能计算平台。 Xiphos 拥有二十多年的经验和交付的 1,000 多个处理器卡，为客户提供从系统集成到部署的支持，帮助实现可靠的计算更接近使命。

articles.title: Cosmo Bee to flight-test Honeybee Hall thruster with D-Orbit in 2027
articles.author: Cosmo Bee

paras.en: Daejeon, Republic of Korea – October 14, 2026: South Korean space electric propulsion startup Cosmo Bee plans to conduct an in-orbit flight test of its 10 mN-class Honeybee Hall thruster system in October 2027 through a service agreement with D-Orbit.
paras.zh: 韩国大田 – 2026 年 10 月 14 日：韩国太空电力推进初创公司 Cosmo Bee 计划通过与 D-Orbit 签订的服务协议，于 2027 年 10 月对其 10 mN 级 Honeybee Hall 推进器系统进行在轨飞行测试。

paras.en: Honeybee is a 10 mN-class Hall thruster system under development by Cosmo Bee for small satellites operating in LEO constellations.
paras.zh: Honeybee 是 Cosmo Bee 正在为在 LEO 星座运行的小型卫星开发的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器系统。

paras.en: “In-orbit validation is an essential step as we prepare to bring Honeybee to the commercial market,” said Dongha Park, co-founder and CEO of Cosmo Bee. “D-Orbit is an ideal partner to help us achieve that goal.”
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Dongha Park 表示：“在轨验证是我们准备将 Honeybee 推向商业市场的重要一步。” “D-Orbit 是帮助我们实现这一目标的理想合作伙伴。”

paras.en: “Hosting in-orbit demonstrations is one of the core services we offer aboard ION,” said Matteo Lorenzoni, Director of the Orbital Access Business Unit at D-Orbit. “Honeybee will operate in the real space environment, with our mission operations team supporting the test throughout, so Cosmo Bee comes away with the performance data it needs to take the thruster to market.” This test will evaluate Honeybee’s key performance parameters, including thrust and specific impulse, under various operating conditions.
paras.zh: “举办在轨演示是我们在 ION 上提供的核心服务之一，”D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部总监 Matteo Lorenzoni 说道。 “Honeybee 将在真实的太空环境中运行，我们的任务运营团队全程支持测试，因此 Cosmo Bee 可以获得将推进器推向市场所需的性能数据。”该测试将评估 Honeybee 在各种操作条件下的关键性能参数，包括推力和比冲量。

paras.en: “For satellite operators choosing a propulsion system, flight heritage is often what decides the purchase”, commented Matteo Zeni, Head of Sales of D-Orbit’s Orbital Access Business Unit. “Our in-orbit demonstration service gives technology developers like Cosmo Bee a direct route to space and the data they need to move from qualification to a commercial product. We look forward to flying Honeybee next year.”
paras.zh: “对于选择推进系统的卫星运营商来说，飞行传统往往是决定购买的因素”，D-Orbit 轨道接入业务部销售主管 Matteo Zeni 评论道。 “我们的在轨演示服务为 Cosmo Bee 等技术开发人员提供了直接进入太空的途径，以及他们从资格认证转向商业产品所需的数据。我们期待明年让 Honeybee 飞行。”

paras.en: Through the partnership, Cosmo Bee plans to establish flight heritage for Honeybee while preparing for the system’s commercial introduction in 2027. The company intends to make Honeybee available to satellite operators and mission developers seeking electric propulsion systems for small spacecraft.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Cosmo Bee 计划为 Honeybee 建立飞行遗产，同时为 2027 年该系统的商业推出做准备。该公司打算将 Honeybee 提供给卫星运营商和寻求小型航天器电力推进系统的任务开发商。

paras.en: Cosmo Bee was founded in July 2023 as a spin-off from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), building on electric propulsion research conducted by Professor Wonho Choe’s team since 2003.
paras.zh: Cosmo Bee 成立于 2023 年 7 月，是韩国科学技术院 (KAIST) 的一个衍生公司，其基础是 Wonho Choe 教授团队自 2003 年以来进行的电力推进研究。

paras.en: In November 2025, the company launched its first space mission, K-HERO, a 3U CubeSat designed to demonstrate the operation of a 150 W-class Hall thruster in orbit. The spacecraft was launched aboard South Korea’s KSLV-2 launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月，该公司发射了其首次太空任务 K-HERO，这是一颗 3U 立方体卫星，旨在演示 150 W 级霍尔推进器在轨道上的运行。该航天器是由韩国的 KSLV-2 运载火箭发射升空的。

paras.en: In June 2026, the Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) designated Cosmo Bee’s 10 mN-class Hall thruster and hollow cathode technologies as “New Space Technologies.” The company also raised $5 million in a Series A funding round that month.
paras.zh: 2026 年 6 月，韩国宇宙航空管理局 (KASA) 将 Cosmo Bee 的 10 mN 级霍尔推进器和空心阴极技术指定为“新空间技术”。该公司还在当月的 A 轮融资中筹集了 500 万美元。

paras.en: “Cosmo Bee is growing alongside the rapidly expanding demand for LEO satellite constellations in South Korea,” Park said. “We hope Honeybee can support customers developing the next generation of small satellite constellations.”
paras.zh: Park 表示：“随着韩国对 LEO 卫星星座需求的快速增长，Cosmo Bee 也在不断发展。” “我们希望 Honeybee 能够支持客户开发下一代小型卫星星座。”

articles.title: A Collage Showing 49 Drill Holes Made by NASA’s Curiosity Mars Rover

paras.en: This collage shows 49 drill holes captured by NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover as of November 2026. Each hole represents a sample collected from rocks on the Martian surface; Curiosity’s drill, located on the end of its robotic arm, drops pulverized rock samples into instruments in its belly that analyze their composition.
paras.zh: 这幅拼贴画展示了截至 2026 年 11 月美国宇航局好奇号火星探测器捕获的 49 个钻孔。每个孔代表从火星表面岩石中收集的样本；好奇号的钻头位于其机械臂的末端，将粉碎的岩石样本放入其腹部的仪器中，分析其成分。

paras.en: These images were taken by the Mars Hand Lens Imager (MAHLI), a camera that is also located on the end of the rover’s robotic arm. Each hole has a diameter of 0.63 inches (16 millimeters).
paras.zh: 这些图像是由火星手持镜头成像仪（MAHLI）拍摄的，该相机也位于火星车机械臂的末端。每个孔的直径为 0.63 英寸（16 毫米）。

paras.en: Curiosity was built by NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory, which is managed by Caltech in Pasadena, California. JPL leads the mission on behalf of NASA’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington as part of NASA’s Mars Exploration Program portfolio. MAHLI was built by Malin Space Science Systems in San Diego.
paras.zh: 好奇号由美国宇航局喷气推进实验室建造，该实验室由位于加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的加州理工学院管理。作为 NASA 火星探索计划组合的一部分，喷气推进实验室代表位于华盛顿的 NASA 科学任务理事会领导这项任务。 MAHLI 由位于圣地亚哥的马林空间科学系统公司建造。

articles.title: Perseverance Update: The Ghostly Rocks of ‘Idubi’ — Bright Remnants of Aqueous Systems from Long Ago

paras.en: Written by Candice Bedford, Research Scientist at Purdue University
paras.zh: 作者：Candice Bedford，普渡大学研究科学家

paras.en: During the Perseverance rover’s investigation of "Idubi" — an area of ancient Martian crust exposed in the "Lac de Charmes" region, outside of Jezero crater — the Perseverance rover team has been captivated by a cluster of eerily bright, light-toned rocks in the area. These bright fragments stand out sharply against the underlying darker and often dust-covered Martian surface, and are even brighter than the igneous and impactite rocks we previously investigated. Suspecting that they differed from the typical igneous rocks in the area, the rover team directed Perseverance to investigate. Newly downlinked data from the SuperCam instrument has confirmed that these light-toned rocks are not igneous in origin and instead are rich in hydrated silica.
paras.zh: 在毅力号火星车对“伊杜比”——杰泽罗陨石坑外的“Lac de Charmes”地区暴露的古代火星地壳区域进行调查期间，毅力号火星车团队被该地区一群异常明亮、浅色调的岩石所吸引。这些明亮的碎片在下面较暗且经常布满灰尘的火星表面上显得格外突出，甚至比我们之前研究的火成岩和冲击岩更亮。火星车团队怀疑它们与该地区典型的火成岩不同，于是指示毅力号进行调查。 SuperCam 仪器最新下载的数据证实，这些浅色岩石并非火成岩，而是富含水合二氧化硅。

paras.en: Hydrated silica can form in many aqueous environments on the Earth, including hydrothermal, pedogenic, and groundwater systems. As such, these types of deposits are prime targets for understanding Mars' hydrological history, as several of these environments could have been capable of supporting life. Furthermore, hydrated silica holds immense astrobiological value due to its remarkable capacity to preserve microfossils. Could these pale remnants of an ancient Martian water system hold signs of ancient life?
paras.zh: 水合二氧化硅可以在地球上的许多水环境中形成，包括热液、土壤和地下水系统。因此，这些类型的沉积物是了解火星水文历史的主要目标，因为其中一些环境可能能够支持生命。此外，水合二氧化硅由于其保存微化石的卓越能力而具有巨大的天体生物学价值。这些古老火星水系的苍白遗迹是否存在古代生命的迹象？

paras.en: When Perseverance previously encountered silica-rich rocks on the inner rim of Jezero Crater, the deposits were too small to deploy proximity science instruments and gather the high-resolution chemical and mineralogical data needed to constrain their origin and biosignature preservation potential. Fortunately, the rocks at "Idubi" offer a much more promising scale, and a detailed proximity science campaign is already underway.
paras.zh: 当毅力号之前在杰泽罗陨石坑内缘遇到富含二氧化硅的岩石时，这些沉积物太小，无法部署邻近科学仪器并收集限制其起源和生物特征保存潜力所需的高分辨率化学和矿物学数据。幸运的是，“伊杜比”的岩石提供了更有希望的规模，并且详细的邻近科学活动已经在进行中。

articles.title: Tossing Fireworks from Cloud to Cloud

paras.en: For astronauts on the International Space Station, looking back to Earth at night can be as dazzling as looking outward toward the stars.
paras.zh: 对于国际空间站上的宇航员来说，夜间回望地球就像向外看星星一样令人眼花缭乱。

paras.en: In an essay for Air & Space magazine, Donald Pettit, a NASA astronaut and dedicated photographer, described the "spectacular" view of Earth at night visible from the station. Cities and civilization, he wrote, looked "like tendrils outlined with the glimmer of a Broadway marquee." Intense, colorful lights cast by clusters of fishing boats across darkened oceans reminded him of "a constellation of stars" forming "unfamiliar members of the Zodiac."
paras.zh: 美国宇航局宇航员兼专业摄影师唐纳德·佩蒂特在《航空与航天》杂志的一篇文章中描述了从空间站可见的地球夜间“壮观”景观。他写道，城市和文明看起来“就像百老汇大帐篷的微光勾勒出的卷须”。漆黑的海洋上成群结队的渔船投射出强烈的彩色灯光，让他想起了“星座”，形成了“黄道十二宫中不熟悉的成员”。

paras.en: NASA astronaut Sally Ride—the first American woman to fly in space—also marveled at the "indescribable" sights of Earth from orbit. Lightning was among the most spectacular, she noted in an essay for the same magazine. "On Earth, people see lightning from below the clouds. In orbit, we see it from above," she wrote. "Bolts of lightning are diffused by the clouds into bursting balls of light. Sometimes, when a storm extends hundreds of miles, it looks like a transcontinental brigade is tossing fireworks from cloud to cloud."
paras.zh: 美国宇航局宇航员莎莉·赖德（Sally Ride）是第一位在太空飞行的美国女性，她也对从轨道上看到的地球“难以形容”的景象感到惊叹。她在同一杂志的一篇文章中指出，闪电是最壮观的。 “在地球上，人们从云层下面看到闪电。在轨道上，我们从上面看到闪电，”她写道。 “闪电被云层扩散成爆炸的光球。有时，当暴风雨延伸数百英里时，看起来就像一个跨大陆旅正在从云层到云层抛掷烟花。”

paras.en: All three phenomena—city lights, fishing fleets, and lightning—were on display when the space station passed over the South China Sea near Borneo at 14:20 UTC (9:20 p.m. Western Indonesian Time) on October 28, 2026. When an astronaut captured this scene with a Nikon Z9 camera, several overshooting tops bubbled up from thunderstorms, including two illuminated by lightning flashes. These tall, domelike protrusions rise above a thunderstorm's anvil and sometimes into the stratosphere, indicating strong updrafts and intense storms.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 28 日世界标准时间 14:20（印度尼西亚西部时间晚上 9:20），当空间站飞越婆罗洲附近的南中国海时，这三种现象——城市灯光、渔船队和闪电——都一一展现出来。当一名宇航员用尼康 Z9 相机捕捉到这一场景时，几个冲顶的顶部从雷暴中冒出，其中两个被闪电照亮。这些高大的圆顶状突起升起在雷暴的铁砧上方，有时甚至进入平流层，表明有强烈的上升气流和强烈的风暴。

paras.en: The lights of Singapore, a city-state of 6.2 million people, appear on the left side of the image, with the curving Singapore Strait separating the city from Batam and Bintan islands to the south. The cluster of blue lights west of Singapore, reminiscent of the Pleiades, or Seven Sisters, was likely produced by fishing boats using bright lights to attract squid or schooling fish such as sardines or anchovies. Offshore to the northwest, the scattered orange points are likely gas flares.
paras.zh: 拥有 620 万人口的城邦新加坡的灯光出现在图像的左侧，弯曲的新加坡海峡将这座城市与南部的巴淡岛和民丹岛隔开。新加坡西部的蓝色光团，让人想起昴宿星团或七姐妹星团，很可能是由渔船使用明亮的灯光吸引鱿鱼或沙丁鱼或凤尾鱼等鱼群产生的。西北海岸，分散的橙色点可能是气体耀斑。

paras.en: For many astronauts, it's the sight of lightning that lingers. "Like fireflies in the night, lightning is my favorite sight from space," said NASA astronaut Anil Menon in a video of Earth's darkened limb that he posted on X, where pinpoints of lightning flicker almost constantly. Lightning is hard to capture and share, he added, but the video offers the best representation he's seen. "It’s unchanged, at real speed, and shows the vast reach of storms and lightning across earth, plus the rapid flashes that dance across the horizon."
paras.zh: 对于许多宇航员来说，挥之不去的就是闪电的景象。 “就像夜晚的萤火虫一样，闪电是我最喜欢的太空景象，”美国宇航局宇航员阿尼尔·梅农在 X 上发布的地球黑暗边缘的视频中说道，其中闪电的针点几乎不断闪烁。他补充说，闪电很难捕捉和分享，但这段视频提供了他所见过的最好的表现。 “它以真实的速度保持不变，显示了地球上风暴和闪电的巨大范围，以及在地平线上舞动的快速闪光。”

paras.en: NASA scientists estimate that there are 2,000 thunderstorms occurring on Earth at any one moment, producing nearly 60 flashes per second—roughly 5 million flashes per day.
paras.zh: NASA 科学家估计，地球上任何时刻都会发生 2,000 场雷暴，每秒产生近 60 次闪光，即每天大约 500 万次闪光。

paras.en: Astronaut photograph ISS075-E-250951 was acquired on October 28, 2026, with a Nikon Z9 digital camera using a focal length of 14 millimeters. It is provided by the ISS Crew Earth Observations Facility and the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit at NASA Johnson Space Center. The image was taken by a member of the Expedition 75 crew. The image has been cropped and enhanced to improve contrast, and lens artifacts have been removed. The International Space Station Program supports the laboratory as part of the ISS National Lab to help astronauts take pictures of Earth that will be of the greatest value to scientists and the public, and to make those images freely available on the Internet. Additional images taken by astronauts and cosmonauts can be viewed at the NASA/JSC Gateway to Astronaut Photography of Earth. Story by Adam Voiland.
paras.zh: 宇航员照片 ISS075-E-250951 于 2026 年 10 月 28 日使用尼康 Z9 数码相机拍摄，焦距为 14 毫米。它由国际空间站机组人员地球观测设施和美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心的地球科学与遥感部门提供。这张照片是由 Expedition 75 号船员拍摄的。图像经过裁剪和增强以提高对比度，并且镜头伪影已被消除。国际空间站计划支持该实验室作为国际空间站国家实验室的一部分，帮助宇航员拍摄对科学家和公众最有价值的地球照片，并将这些图像在互联网上免费提供。宇航员拍摄的其他图像可以在 NASA/JSC 地球宇航员摄影网关查看。亚当·沃伊兰的故事。

articles.title: COP31 enters decisive week as climate talks face political test and AI initiatives gather pace

paras.en: COP31 enters decisive week as climate talks face political test and AI initiatives gather pace
paras.zh: 随着气候谈判面临政治考验和人工智能举措加快步伐，COP31 进入决定性的一周

paras.en: New international initiatives on artificial intelligence and green industrialization showcased technology’s growing role in climate action, even as negotiators remained deadlocked on finance, fossil fuels and adaptation ahead of the final stretch of the UN talks.
paras.zh: 关于人工智能和绿色工业化的新国际倡议展示了技术在气候行动中日益重要的作用，尽管谈判代表在联合国谈判的最后阶段在金融、化石燃料和适应问题上仍陷入僵局。

paras.en: - Negotiations: Ministers prepare for the high-level segment as pressure mounts over finance, fossil fuels and a possible overarching agreement.
paras.zh: - 谈判：随着金融、化石燃料和可能达成的总体协议面临的压力越来越大，部长们正在为高级别会议做准备。

paras.en: - Artificial intelligence: A new Antalya pledge attracts 80 endorsements and 271 commitments to make AI more sustainable.
paras.zh: - 人工智能：一项新的安塔利亚承诺吸引了 80 项认可和 271 项承诺，旨在使人工智能更具可持续性。

paras.en: - Green industrialization: Governments launch an initiative to accelerate investment in cleaner steel, cement and other industrial products.
paras.zh: - 绿色工业化：各国政府发起倡议，加快对清洁钢铁、水泥和其他工业产品的投资。

paras.en: - Science: Countries remain divided over when the next major Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) climate assessment should be published, with vulnerable nations pushing for a 2028 deadline.
paras.zh: - 科学：对于政府间气候变化专门委员会 (IPCC) 下一次主要气候评估何时发布，各国仍存在分歧，脆弱国家力争在 2028 年发布最后期限。

paras.en: As COP31 entered its second and final week, the corridors of the conference centre in Antalya, Türkiye, began filling up again, with ministers arriving ahead of Tuesday's formal high-level segment after seven days dominated by technical negotiations, announcements and speeches.
paras.zh: 随着 COP31 进入第二周也是最后一周，土耳其安塔利亚会议中心的走廊再次开始挤满人，在经过 7 天的技术谈判、公告和演讲之后，部长们在周二正式的高级别会议之前抵达。

paras.en: Countries remain divided over who should pay for climate action, how to help vulnerable nations adapt, how to protect workers during the energy transition and what the final agreement should say about moving away from fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 在谁应该为气候行动买单、如何帮助脆弱国家适应气候变化、如何在能源转型期间保护工人以及最终协议应就摆脱化石燃料做出哪些规定等问题上，各国仍存在分歧。

paras.en: Late Monday, Australia, COP31 co-host and lead negotiator, circulated a first draft of the overarching decision, but the text remains only a starting point for negotiations. Countries are divided not only over its contents, but over whether such a decision should exist at all.
paras.zh: 周一晚些时候，COP31 共同主办国和首席谈判代表澳大利亚分发了总体决定的初稿，但该文本仍然只是谈判的起点。各国不仅在其内容上存在分歧，而且在是否应该存在这样的决定上也存在分歧。

paras.en: Ministers will gather in a Divan, an Ottoman term for an imperial assembly, to seek political compromises on the most contentious issues still dividing countries.
paras.zh: 部长们将聚集在 Divan（奥斯曼帝国对帝国议会的称呼）中，寻求就仍然分裂国家的最具争议性问题达成政治妥协。

paras.en: A ‘slow first half’ with the toughest decisions ahead
paras.zh: “缓慢的上半场”面临着最艰难的决定

paras.en: For Soenke Kreft, a climate policy expert at the United Nations University, the negotiations resemble a football match heading into its second half.
paras.zh: 对于联合国大学气候政策专家索恩克·克雷夫特来说，谈判就像一场进入下半场的足球比赛。

paras.en: “We probably will also have overtime,” he told UN News.
paras.zh: “我们可能还会加班，”他告诉联合国新闻。

paras.en: While some technical issues have been resolved, much of the political work remains unfinished.
paras.zh: 虽然一些技术问题已经解决，但许多政治工作仍未完成。

paras.en: “It has been a somewhat slow first half,” he said. “We really need to see a momentum swing for the second week.”
paras.zh: “上半场有点慢，”他说。 “我们确实需要看到第二周的势头摇摆。”

paras.en: One example is a growing dispute over science itself. Countries remain divided over when the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) should publish its next major assessment, with vulnerable nations pushing for the findings to be ready in 2028, in time to inform the second Global Stocktake, which will assess global progress under the Paris Agreement.
paras.zh: 一个例子是关于科学本身的日益激烈的争论。对于政府间气候变化专门委员会 (IPCC) 何时发布下一次重大评估，各国仍存在分歧，脆弱国家力争在 2028 年准备好调查结果，以便及时向第二次全球盘点通报情况，该盘点将评估《巴黎协定》下的全球进展。

paras.en: The deadlock has delayed decisions on the scientific timetable, raising concerns that governments could enter future negotiations without the latest comprehensive findings on climate change.
paras.zh: 这一僵局推迟了科学时间表的决定，引发了人们的担忧，即各国政府可能在没有关于气候变化的最新综合发现的情况下进入未来的谈判。

paras.en: “We have to defend science. We have to defend the scientists,” said Laurence Tubiana, CEO of the European Climate Foundation and one of the architects of the Paris Agreement, at a packed science plenary on Monday.
paras.zh: “我们必须捍卫科学。我们必须捍卫科学家，”欧洲气候基金会首席执行官、《巴黎协定》的缔造者之一劳伦斯·图比亚纳 (Laurence Tubiana) 周一在拥挤的科学全体会议上说道。

paras.en: Mary Robinson, former President of Ireland, echoed her concerns: “The world cannot afford to undermine or lose the IPCC,” urging countries to resolve their differences and ensure its next assessment is delivered on time.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰前总统玛丽·罗宾逊（Mary Robinson）也表达了她的担忧：“世界无法承受破坏或失去政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）的后果”，敦促各国解决分歧并确保其下一次评估按时进行。

paras.en: Scientists also warned about the risks of overshoot – temporarily exceeding the 1.5°C warming threshold – and called for the latest evidence to guide decisions at COP31.
paras.zh: 科学家们还警告了超调的风险——暂时超过 1.5°C 的升温阈值——并呼吁提供最新证据来指导 COP31 的决策。

paras.en: Meanwhile, climate activists spoke against allowing the proposed overarching decision to distract from negotiations on concrete climate action.
paras.zh: 与此同时，气候活动人士反对允许拟议的总体决定分散对具体气候行动谈判的注意力。

paras.en: “Cover decisions, at the end of the day, have the danger of becoming a distraction,” a Climate Action Network representative said, urging journalists to look beyond political declarations.
paras.zh: 气候行动网络的一位代表表示：“归根结底，封面决定有分散注意力的危险。”他敦促记者不要只看政治宣言。

paras.en: The group criticized proposals for a just transition mechanism that would give workers and communities a voice without providing the necessary resources.
paras.zh: 该组织批评了公正过渡机制的提议，该机制将在不提供必要资源的情况下为工人和社区提供发言权。

paras.en: One activist compared it to being offered “a seat at the table with no food, no place, no cutlery, and very bad wine.”
paras.zh: 一位活动家将其比作“餐桌上没有食物、没有地方、没有餐具、酒也很糟糕”。

paras.en: “The coal miners in Australia, the lithium, cobalt, platinum miners in Africa, the steel workers in Germany, India and UK cannot afford more dialogues,” he added.
paras.zh: “澳大利亚的煤矿开采商，非洲的锂、钴、铂矿开采商，德国、印度和英国的钢铁工人无法承受更多的对话，”他补充道。

paras.en: On finance, activists questioned how major climate funds would be replenished, noting that the Solomon Islands, a climate-vulnerable small island nation, was the first country to announce a contribution to the Green Climate Fund at COP31 while commitments from wealthier countries remained scarce
paras.zh: 在资金方面，活动人士质疑主要气候基金将如何补充，并指出所罗门群岛是一个气候脆弱的小岛国，是第一个在 COP31 上宣布向绿色气候基金捐款的国家，而较富裕国家的承诺仍然很少

paras.en: Can AI help the climate without making it worse?
paras.zh: 人工智能能否帮助气候变化而不让气候变得更糟？

paras.en: Artificial Intelligence can help predict extreme weather, identify vulnerable communities and improve energy efficiency. But increasingly powerful models also require vast amounts of electricity and water.
paras.zh: 人工智能可以帮助预测极端天气、识别脆弱社区并提高能源效率。但日益强大的模型也需要大量的电力和水。

paras.en: At a ministerial meeting, Türkiye and the UN International Telecommunication Union (ITU) launched the Antalya Artificial Intelligence Pledge, which had secured 80 endorsements and 271 commitments by Monday morning.
paras.zh: 在一次部长级会议上，土耳其和联合国国际电信联盟 (ITU) 发起了《安塔利亚人工智能承诺》，截至周一上午，该承诺已获得 80 项认可和 271 项承诺。

paras.en: The voluntary initiative seeks to reduce AI’s environmental footprint through cleaner energy, more efficient infrastructure, better emissions tracking and wider access to technology, particularly in developing countries.
paras.zh: 该自愿倡议旨在通过更清洁的能源、更高效的基础设施、更好的排放跟踪和更广泛的技术获取来减少人工智能的环境足迹，特别是在发展中国家。

paras.en: ITU Deputy Secretary-General Tomas Lamanauskas warned that energy consumption from data centres powering AI is expected to double by 2030, while some technology companies have already seen their emissions rise by 50 per cent in recent years.
paras.zh: 国际电联副秘书长托马斯·拉马瑙斯卡斯警告说，到 2030 年，为人工智能提供动力的数据中心的能源消耗预计将增加一倍，而一些科技公司的排放量近年来已经增加了 50%。

paras.en: “This is becoming a challenge that we need to rein in if we want [...] to make sure that AI is a solution, not the problem,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果我们想要[...]确保人工智能是一种解决方案，而不是问题，这正在成为我们需要控制的挑战，”他说。

paras.en: He stressed that the real test of the Antalya Pledge would be its implementation, with the ITU committing to track progress and hold participants accountable.
paras.zh: 他强调，《安塔利亚承诺》的真正考验将是其实施情况，国际电联承诺跟踪进展情况并追究参与者的责任。

paras.en: From climate risks to practical solutions
paras.zh: 从气候风险到实际解决方案

paras.en: For Álvaro Rojas of the United Nations University in Bonn, AI is already helping governments make better decisions. His team used it to analyse 1,600 disaster risk management documents, identifying where countries need support on climate-related loss and damage and where expertise already exists.
paras.zh: 对于波恩联合国大学的阿尔瓦罗·罗哈斯来说，人工智能已经在帮助政府做出更好的决策。他的团队使用它分析了 1,600 份灾害风险管理文件，确定哪些国家在气候相关损失和损害方面需要支持，以及哪些国家已经具备专业知识。

paras.en: “Technology is a tool,” he told UN News. “The tool itself is only useful as long as the people understand what is behind it.”
paras.zh: “技术是一种工具，”他告诉联合国新闻。 “只有当人们了解其背后的含义时，该工具本身才有用。”

paras.en: But AI also carries risks. A UNESCO-University College London study found chatbots sometimes abandon established climate facts when challenged, while accuracy varies across languages.
paras.zh: 但人工智能也存在风险。联合国教科文组织伦敦大学学院的一项研究发现，聊天机器人在受到挑战时有时会放弃既定的气候事实，而准确性因语言而异。

paras.en: The findings reinforce concerns behind a joint UN, Brazil and UNESCO initiative to protect the integrity of climate information, particularly during disasters.
paras.zh: 这些发现加深了人们对联合国、巴西和教科文组织联合倡议的担忧，该倡议旨在保护气候信息的完整性，特别是在灾害期间。

paras.en: One new project is attempting to address that problem using AI itself.
paras.zh: 一个新项目正在尝试利用人工智能本身来解决这一问题。

paras.en: Brigitte Perrin, founder of Earth Info Hub and former UN official, is developing Beluga, an AI platform designed to bring trusted scientific information together.
paras.zh: 地球信息中心创始人、前联合国官员 Brigitte Perrin 正在开发 Beluga，这是一个人工智能平台，旨在将可信的科学信息整合在一起。

paras.en: “All the science that the UN organizations, the scientific organizations are creating, day after day, they tend to be spread and fragmented into several platforms and websites,” she explained.
paras.zh: “联合国组织、科学组织日复一日地创造的所有科学知识，往往会被传播并分散到多个平台和网站上，”她解释道。

paras.en: The aim, she said, is to create “a central place and safe place” where policymakers, journalists and the public can find reliable environmental research.
paras.zh: 她说，其目标是创建一个“中心和安全的地方”，让政策制定者、记者和公众能够找到可靠的环境研究。

paras.en: Cleaning up the industries that built the modern world
paras.zh: 清理构建现代世界的工业

paras.en: Beyond AI, another focus at COP31 was how to make the steel, cement and other industries underpinning modern life less polluting.
paras.zh: 除了人工智能之外，COP31 的另一个焦点是如何减少支撑现代生活的钢铁、水泥和其他行业的污染。

paras.en: At a ministerial meeting, governments launched the Antalya Green Industrialization Compact, an initiative aimed at unlocking investment, creating markets for cleaner industrial products and helping developing countries access new technologies.
paras.zh: 在一次部长级会议上，各国政府启动了《安塔利亚绿色工业化契约》，该倡议旨在释放投资、为清洁工业产品创造市场并帮助发展中国家获得新技术。

paras.en: “Green industrialisation is about turning the momentum in renewable energy into industrial opportunity that creates jobs, attracts investment, and strengthens energy security,” said Ciyong Zou, Deputy Director-General of the UN Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO).
paras.zh: 联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）副总干事邹慈勇表示：“绿色工业化就是将可再生能源的动力转化为创造就业、吸引投资和加强能源安全的产业机会。”

paras.en: Michael Apicelli, head of the Climate Club Secretariat, a coalition of 53 countries working to cut industrial emissions, said many of the solutions are already within reach.
paras.zh: 气候俱乐部秘书处负责人迈克尔·阿皮切利（Michael Apicelli）是一个由 53 个国家组成的致力于减少工业排放的联盟，他表示许多解决方案已经触手可及。

paras.en: “This isn’t some kind of new technology we're all waiting around for. It’s here. These technologies are here today. The investments just need to be made,” he told UN News.
paras.zh: “这不是我们都在等待的某种新技术。它就在这里。这些技术今天就在这里。只需要进行投资，”他告诉联合国新闻。

paras.en: The urgency, he explained, is that investments in steel and cement production can lock in technologies for 30 to 40 years, making today's choices critical for future generations.
paras.zh: 他解释说，当务之急是对钢铁和水泥生产的投资可以锁定技术 30 到 40 年，使今天的选择对子孙后代至关重要。

paras.en: So, what would cleaner industry actually look like?
paras.zh: 那么，清洁行业到底是什么样子的呢？

paras.en: Peter Schniering, founder of Future Cleantech Architects, a Germany-based non-profit think tank focused on climate innovation, pointed to smarter building designs that use less concrete and steel, and electric furnaces that can reduce emissions from steelmaking.
paras.zh: 德国专注于气候创新的非营利性智囊团“未来清洁技术建筑师”(Future Cleantech Architects) 的创始人彼得·施尼尔林 (Peter Schniering) 指出，更智能的建筑设计可以减少混凝土和钢材的使用，以及可以减少炼钢排放的电炉。

paras.en: “We have way more efficient ways to design buildings and then also to use more low carbon building materials,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们有更有效的方法来设计建筑，然后使用更多的低碳建筑材料，”他说。

paras.en: The challenge now is to make these technologies affordable and widely available, particularly in developing economies where much of the world's new infrastructure will be built.
paras.zh: 现在的挑战是让这些技术变得负担得起并广泛使用，特别是在发展中经济体，世界上大部分新基础设施都将建在这些国家。

paras.en: Other sectors, including long-distance aviation, still require significant innovation. Many of these solutions also depend on one essential ingredient: more clean electricity.
paras.zh: 包括长途航空在内的其他行业仍然需要重大创新。其中许多解决方案还取决于一个基本要素：更清洁的电力。

paras.en: “Without the electricity it will be hard to get the green hydrogen, it will be hard to decarbonize sectors such as aviation, shipping or the steel production,” Mr. Schniering said.
paras.zh: “如果没有电力，就很难获得绿色氢，航空、航运或钢铁生产等行业也很难脱碳，”施尼尔林先生说。

paras.en: - Overarching decision: Will countries agree on a cover text, and will it address the transition away from fossil fuels?
paras.zh: - 总体决定：各国是否会就封面文本达成一致，是否会解决摆脱化石燃料的过渡问题？

paras.en: - Climate finance: Can countries bridge disagreements over public funding obligations and support for developing economies?
paras.zh: - 气候融资：各国能否弥合公共资金义务和支持发展中经济体方面的分歧？

paras.en: - Adaptation: Will governments agree on how to measure progress and provide financial support?
paras.zh: - 适应：政府会就如何衡量进展和提供财政支持达成一致吗？

paras.en: - Just transition: Can ministers agree on a mechanism to support workers and communities?
paras.zh: - 公正过渡：部长们能否就支持工人和社区的机制达成一致？

paras.en: - Climate science: Will the final outcome reinforce the 1.5°C temperature goal and address the issue of overshoot?
paras.zh: - 气候科学：最终结果是否会强化1.5°C温度目标并解决超调问题？

articles.title: ‘An unfulfilled plan helps no one’: Superbug plans have doubled, but few countries are delivering

paras.en: ‘An unfulfilled plan helps no one’: Superbug plans have doubled, but few countries are delivering
paras.zh: “未完成的计划对任何人都没有帮助”：超级细菌计划增加了一倍，但很少有国家能够兑现

paras.en: When medicines lose their power against drug-resistant microbes, common infections become harder to treat, and routine procedures such as surgery, childbirth and cancer care become riskier.
paras.zh: 当药物失去对抗耐药微生物的功效时，常见感染就会变得更难治疗，手术、分娩和癌症护理等常规程序也会变得更加危险。

paras.en: In 2023, around one in six laboratory-confirmed bacterial infections worldwide were resistant to antibiotics.
paras.zh: 2023 年，全球约六分之一的实验室确诊细菌感染对抗生素具有耐药性。

paras.en: The findings, released ahead of World AMR Awareness Week, show that 173 countries report having developed plans to address AMR – more than double the 79 that did so in 2017.
paras.zh: 世界抗菌素耐药性宣传周之前发布的调查结果显示，173 个国家报告已制定了解决抗菌素耐药性问题的计划，这一数字是 2017 年 79 个国家的两倍多。

paras.en: However, only 22 per cent of countries report having both the necessary funding and full implementation of their national action plans, leaving major gaps from preventing infections to diagnosing and treating patients.
paras.zh: 然而，只有 22% 的国家报告拥有必要的资金并充分实施其国家行动计划，从预防感染到诊断和治疗患者都存在重大差距。

paras.en: “National plans are essential for protecting the medicines that protect us, and the fact that most countries now have plans in place is great news,” said WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞表示：“国家计划对于保护保护我们的药物至关重要，大多数国家现在都制定了计划，这是个好消息。”

paras.en: Testing remains inadequate in most countries. Only 36 per cent report having a national reference laboratory equipped to test the selected bacteria and fungi – far short of the global target of 80 per cent of countries having comprehensive bacterial and fungal resistance testing capacity by 2030.
paras.zh: 大多数国家的检测仍然不足。只有 36% 的国家报告拥有配备检测选定细菌和真菌的国家参考实验室，远低于到 2030 年 80% 的国家拥有全面细菌和真菌耐药性检测能力的全球目标。

paras.en: Without adequate testing, patients are more likely to be prescribed antibiotics that are ineffective or unnecessary, and resistant infections and outbreaks may go undetected.
paras.zh: 如果没有充分的检测，患者更有可能服用无效或不必要的抗生素，并且耐药性感染和疫情可能未被发现。

paras.en: The gaps extend to treatment guidelines and surveillance. Only 63 per cent of countries report having guidelines on the appropriate use of antimicrobials, and just over half report having systems to monitor national antibiotic use and track levels of AMR.
paras.zh: 这些差距还延伸到治疗指南和监测方面。只有 63% 的国家报告拥有适当使用抗菌药物的指南，略多于一半的国家报告拥有监测国家抗生素使用和跟踪抗菌素耐药性水平的系统。

paras.en: The data come from the latest Tracking Antimicrobial Resistance Country Self-assessment Survey (TrACSS), completed by 183 countries this year.
paras.zh: 该数据来自今年由 183 个国家完成的最新抗菌素耐药性国家自我评估追踪调查 (TrACSS)。

paras.en: World AMR Awareness Week runs from 18 to 24 November under the theme One Health, one action: Prevent AMR now.
paras.zh: 世界抗微生物药物耐药性宣传周将于 11 月 18 日至 24 日举行，主题为“同一个健康，一项行动：立即预防抗微生物药物耐药性”。

paras.en: “Every infection prevented means fewer antimicrobials are needed, and testing ensures that patients receive the right treatment only when necessary,” said Tedros, urging all countries to invest in infection prevention, surveillance, equitable access to essential antimicrobials and quality diagnostics.
paras.zh: 谭德塞表示：“每一次感染的预防都意味着需要更少的抗菌药物，而检测可确保患者仅在必要时接受正确的治疗。”他敦促所有国家投资于感染预防、监测、公平获得基本抗菌药物和高质量诊断。

articles.title: ‘Peace begins in our hearts’: Children close Muscat forum with a message to the world

paras.en: ‘Peace begins in our hearts’: Children close Muscat forum with a message to the world
paras.zh: “和平从我们的心中开始”：孩子们关闭马斯喀特论坛并向世界传达信息

paras.en: Children from across the world sent a message of peace from the Omani capital Muscat on Monday, calling for an end to hatred, respect for diversity and the protection of human rights.
paras.zh: 周一，来自世界各地的儿童从阿曼首都马斯喀特发出和平信息，呼吁结束仇恨、尊重多样性和保护人权。

paras.en: Their message closed the two-day Muscat Plan of Action Forum, held on the International Day for Tolerance, marked by the UN every 16 November.
paras.zh: 他们的致辞结束了为期两天的马斯喀特行动计划论坛，该论坛于每年 11 月 16 日联合国纪念的国际宽容日举行。

paras.en: “Peace begins in our hearts, and in our belief that we all belong to one humanity,” the children said, describing understanding as the bridge between peoples and coexistence as the foundation for a safe and prosperous future.
paras.zh: 孩子们说：“和平始于我们的内心，始于我们相信我们都属于同一个人类。”他们将理解描述为各国人民之间的桥梁，将共存描述为安全和繁荣未来的基础。

paras.en: They pledged to build bridges of solidarity, stand up for children’s rights, protect the planet and act as ambassadors for peace in their own communities.
paras.zh: 他们承诺搭建团结的桥梁，维护儿童权利，保护地球，并在自己的社区中充当和平大使。

paras.en: On the forum’s second day, UN officials, religious and traditional leaders and experts discussed how to turn the goals of the Muscat Plan of Action – launched at UN Headquarters in New York in June – into practical programmes and partnerships.
paras.zh: 在论坛的第二天，联合国官员、宗教和传统领袖以及专家讨论了如何将 6 月在纽约联合国总部启动的马斯喀特行动计划的目标转化为实际计划和伙伴关系。

paras.en: Mohamed bin Said bin Khalfan Al Mamari, Oman’s Minister of Endowments and Religious Affairs, said the plan aims to strengthen the role of religious and traditional leaders and Indigenous Peoples in preventing conflict and combating hate speech.
paras.zh: 阿曼捐赠和宗教事务部长穆罕默德·本·赛义德·本·哈凡·马马里表示，该计划旨在加强宗教和传统领袖以及土著人民在预防冲突和打击仇恨言论方面的作用。

paras.en: “Difference in itself does not create conflict, just as similarity does not guarantee peace,” said Mr. Al Mamari.
paras.zh: “差异本身不会造成冲突，就像相似性并不能保证和平一样，”阿尔·马马里先生说。

paras.en: Peace “is not merely the absence of violence or the cessation of conflicts and wars,” he continued, but needs a system built on justice, trust and security.
paras.zh: 他继续说，和平“不仅仅是没有暴力或停止冲突和战争”，而是需要一个建立在正义、信任和安全基础上的体系。

paras.en: The minister called for stronger local mediators, a better link between early warning and institutional response and a bigger role for women and young people.
paras.zh: 这位部长呼吁加强地方调解员的力量，在预警和机构反应之间建立更好的联系，并让妇女和年轻人发挥更大的作用。

paras.en: Chaloka Beyani, the UN Special Adviser on the Prevention of Genocide, said tolerance is the basis for peace, human rights and coexistence, warning that discrimination and exclusion can escalate into incitement to violence and crimes against humanity.
paras.zh: 联合国防止种族灭绝问题特别顾问查洛卡·贝亚尼表示，宽容是和平、人权和共存的基础，并警告说，歧视和排斥可能升级为煽动暴力和危害人类罪。

paras.en: He pointed to the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda and the 1995 Srebrenica genocide as examples of where rhetoric fuelling marginalization and hatred can lead.
paras.zh: 他指出，1994 年卢旺达针对图西族的种族灭绝事件和 1995 年斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝事件就是煽动边缘化和仇恨言论可能导致的后果的例子。

paras.en: “Hate speech and intolerance feed each other in a vicious circle,” said Mr. Beyani, urging action at an early stage, before words turn into hostility or violence.
paras.zh: 贝亚尼先生说：“仇恨言论和不宽容相互助长，形成恶性循环。”他敦促在言语变成敌意或暴力之前尽早采取行动。

paras.en: Metropolitan Emmanuel of Chalcedon, of the Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople, warned that atrocity crimes can be preceded by years of rhetoric that strips people of their identity and casts them as a threat.
paras.zh: 君士坦丁堡普世宗主教区的卡尔西登都主教伊曼纽尔警告说，在暴行犯罪之前，可能会出现多年剥夺人们身份并将其视为威胁的言论。

paras.en: Imams, priests, rabbis and community leaders can spot tensions early and confront inflammatory speech, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，伊玛目、牧师、拉比和社区领袖可以及早发现紧张局势并应对煽动性言论。

paras.en: Egypt’s Minister of Endowments, Osama Al-Azhari, called for an “acquaintance of civilizations” in place of conflict, citing the Quranic verse: “And We made you into peoples and tribes that you may know each other.”
paras.zh: 埃及捐赠部长奥萨马·爱资哈里 (Osama Al-Azhari) 呼吁以“不同文明的相识”来代替冲突，并引用《古兰经》的经文：“我们使你们成为民族和部落，以便你们能够相互了解。”

paras.en: Queen Gladys Mbuya of Cameroon, a lawyer and human rights defender, described how a traditional leader resolved a dispute between Indigenous Bororo herders and farmers whose crops were being destroyed by livestock.
paras.zh: 喀麦隆女王格拉迪斯·姆布亚 (Gladys Mbuya) 是一名律师和人权捍卫者，她描述了一位传统领袖如何解决土著博罗罗牧民与农作物被牲畜毁坏的农民之间的争端。

paras.en: After a full-day meeting at his palace, both sides agreed that the herds would be kept off cultivated land and the farmers would put up fences.
paras.zh: 在他的宫殿举行一整天的会议后，双方同意牛群将远离耕地，农民将竖起栅栏。

paras.en: Traditional mediation looks for solutions acceptable to everyone, rather than simply punishing the party at fault, said Queen Mbuya.
paras.zh: 姆布亚女王表示，传统调解寻求的是各方都能接受的解决方案，而不是简单地惩罚有过错的一方。

paras.en: The forum closed with the presentation of a global framework for putting the Muscat Plan into practice between 2027 and 2032.
paras.zh: 论坛最后提出了 2027 年至 2032 年实施马斯喀特计划的全球框架。

paras.en: - cooperation, including an annual progress meeting in Muscat;
paras.zh: - 合作，包括在马斯喀特举行的年度进展会议；

paras.en: - capacity building, through training in local languages;
paras.zh: - 通过当地语言培训进行能力建设；

paras.en: - and communication, including a global platform for sharing experience in mediation and peacebuilding.
paras.zh: - 沟通，包括分享调解和建设和平经验的全球平台。

articles.title: Brown reveals Djokovic advice that will help McLaren after 'underperformance'

paras.en: McLaren chief Zak Brown says advice from Novak Djokovic will help F1 team bounce back from losing titles to Mercedes
paras.zh: 迈凯伦首席执行官扎克·布朗表示，诺瓦克·德约科维奇的建议将帮助 F1 车队从输给梅赛德斯的冠军中恢复过来

paras.en: Listen to Sky Sports' full length interview with McLaren chief Zak Brown on the latest episode of The F1 Show; watch the Las Vegas GP this weekend on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 4am on Saturday and the race at 4am on Sunday
paras.zh: 收听天空体育在最新一集《F1 秀》中对迈凯伦首席执行官扎克·布朗的完整采访；本周末在天空体育 F1 上观看拉斯维加斯大奖赛，周六凌晨 4 点排位赛，周日凌晨 4 点正赛

paras.en: McLaren chief executive Zak Brown says he is using advice from Novak Djokovic to aid his team's attempt to bounce back after losing both of their Formula 1 titles to Mercedes this season.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦首席执行官扎克·布朗表示，他正在利用诺瓦克·德约科维奇的建议来帮助他的车队在本赛季将两个一级方程式冠军输给梅赛德斯后试图反弹。

paras.en: Lando Norris was replaced as world champion by Kimi Antonelli at the Mexico City Grand Prix earlier this month before Mercedes sealed a dominant Constructors' Championship triumph a week later in Brazil.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，兰多·诺里斯在墨西哥城大奖赛上被基米·安东内利取代，成为世界冠军，一周后，梅赛德斯在巴西夺得了车队冠军。

paras.en: McLaren won their first constructors' title in 26 years in 2024 before repeating the feat the following year, but a major change in the sport's regulations reset the pecking order ahead of the 2026 season.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦于 2024 年赢得了 26 年来的首个车队冠军，并在次年重复了这一壮举，但这项运动规则的重大变化在 2026 赛季之前重置了排名顺序。

paras.en: - Las Vegas GP: UK schedule and how to watch on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：英国赛程以及如何在天空体育上观看

paras.en: - F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Asked during a special episode of Sky Sports' The F1 Show about watching Mercedes celebrate on the podium after Norris had claimed something of a consolation victory for McLaren at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, Brown jokingly replied: "I just want to push them off and get our team back up there!
paras.zh: 在天空体育的 F1 秀的一期特别节目中，当诺里斯在圣保罗大奖赛上为迈凯伦赢得了一些安慰性的胜利后，布朗开玩笑地回答道：“我只是想把他们推开，让我们的车队重新站上领奖台！

paras.en: "I mean, first of all, congratulations to Mercedes and Kimi. Now I have an appreciation for how hard this is.
paras.zh: “我的意思是，首先，祝贺梅赛德斯和基米。现在我意识到这是多么困难。

paras.en: "And the sport is so competitive and the top four teams, I mean, to beat a Red Bull, beat a Mercedes, beat a Ferrari, you've got to be damn good.
paras.zh: “这项运动竞争如此激烈，我的意思是，要击败红牛、击败梅赛德斯、击败法拉利，排名前四的球队，你必须非常出色。

paras.en: "It just makes me want it more. We won 14 races last year. I don't think anyone's ever won 14, two in a row.
paras.zh: “这让我更加想要它。去年我们赢得了 14 场比赛。我认为没有人曾经赢得过 14 场比赛，连续两场胜利。

paras.en: "We've won three this year. Madrid, coulda, shoulda, woulda. So it's been a year that I feel like we've underperformed on the whole, but that's a learning. It makes us stronger.
paras.zh: “今年我们赢得了三场胜利。马德里，可以，应该，应该。所以这一年我觉得我们整体表现不佳，但这是一个学习。它让我们变得更强。”

paras.en: "I think Brazil was awesome. That was McLaren at its best. The upgrades were great, the strategy, the drivers.
paras.zh: “我认为巴西很棒。那是迈凯伦的最佳状态。升级、策略和车手都很棒。

paras.en: Brown then explained how tennis icon Djokovic, who has won a record 24 men's Grand Slam singles titles, previously gave him some advice that he and McLaren team principal Andrea Stella have taken on board as they prepare for the 2027 season.
paras.zh: 布朗随后解释了网球偶像德约科维奇（创纪录的 24 个男子大满贯单打冠军）之前向他提供的一些建议，他和迈凯伦车队领队安德里亚·斯特拉在备战 2027 赛季时采纳了这些建议。

paras.en: "It's sport, and the big thing is, Novak Djokovic is a good friend of ours, and he's quite inspiring," Brown said. "When people say things to me, they stick with me, certain things.
paras.zh: “这是运动，最重要的是，诺瓦克·德约科维奇是我们的好朋友，他非常鼓舞人心，”布朗说。 “当人们对我说话时，他们会坚持我的观点，某些事情。

paras.en: "And he said, 'you can't control your emotions, how you feel is how you feel, but you can control how you react to them.'
paras.zh: “他说，‘你无法控制自己的情绪，你的感受就是你的感受，但你可以控制你对情绪的反应。’

paras.en: "So, the emotions of not winning, as Andrea says, no poison biscuits, but you kind of sit back, take a deep breath, and you go, you know what, 'that's what happened, now let's go push forward and win.' And it makes winning feel so good."
paras.zh: “所以，正如安德里亚所说，没有获胜的情绪，没有毒饼干，但你会坐下来，深吸一口气，然后你就会说，‘这就是发生的事情，现在让我们继续前进，赢得胜利。’”这让获胜的感觉非常好。”

paras.en: 'A lot of changes' to be made to 2027 McLaren
paras.zh: 2027 年迈凯伦将做出“很多改变”

paras.en: McLaren's relative struggles this season, during which Norris has still managed three wins with two races to go, were contributed to by the team pushing until the end of 2025 while others switched more focus to working on their 2026 cars.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦本赛季的表现相对挣扎，其中诺里斯在还剩两场比赛的情况下仍然取得了三场胜利，这是由于车队将工作时间推迟到 2025 年底，而其他人则将更多精力转移到了 2026 年赛车上。

paras.en: There ended up being fundamental issues with the MCL40, such as a shorter wheelbase than some of their rivals, that made it difficult for them to consistently compete for wins.
paras.zh: MCL40 最终出现了根本性问题，例如轴距比一些竞争对手更短，这使得他们很难持续竞争胜利。

paras.en: Asked whether this was something that will be addressed on next year's challenger, Brown said: "Yeah, always addressing the race car.
paras.zh: 当被问及明年的挑战者是否会解决这个问题时，布朗说：“是的，总是解决赛车问题。

paras.en: "Weight was a big issue this year for a lot of cars, obviously a shorter wheelbase (results in a) lighter car.
paras.zh: “对于很多汽车来说，今年的重量是一个大问题，显然轴距较短（导致汽车更轻）。

paras.en: "So yeah, I think there's things that, slow speed corners weren't great for us.
paras.zh: “所以，是的，我认为有些事情，慢速弯道对我们来说并不好。

paras.en: "We've learned a lot about the power unit this year, and deployment, and all the stuff that, we're all still learning.
paras.zh: “今年我们对动力装置、部署以及所有我们仍在学习的东西了解了很多。

paras.en: "So yeah, I think this season, there's a lot of takeaways and changes we're going to make going into 2027."
paras.zh: “所以，是的，我认为这个赛季，我们将在 2027 年之前做出很多收获和改变。”

paras.en: Norris' superb victory at Interlagos saw the Brit continue his dominance over his team-mate Oscar Piastri this season.
paras.zh: 诺里斯在英特拉格斯的精彩胜利见证了英国人本赛季继续对队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的统治地位。

paras.en: After the pair were extremely closely matched last season as Norris edged out Red Bull's Max Verstappen and Piastri for the title, there has been a clear gap between them in 2026.
paras.zh: 上赛季诺里斯击败红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘和皮亚斯特里夺得冠军，两人的实力非常接近，但到了 2026 年，他们之间的差距已经很明显了。

paras.en: Norris is 94 points ahead of Piastri in the drivers' standings, has all three of McLaren's grand prix victories this season, and six podiums to Piastri's two.
paras.zh: 诺里斯在车手积分榜上领先皮亚斯特里 94 分，拥有迈凯伦本赛季全部三场大奖赛胜利，并六次登上领奖台，而皮亚斯特里只有两次。

paras.en: There have been similarly surprising shifts in performance from last year to this year at other teams, with Antonelli outpacing George Russell at Mercedes and Lewis Hamilton proving far more competitive against his Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc in the new cars.
paras.zh: 从去年到今年，其他车队的表现也出现了类似的令人惊讶的变化，安东内利在梅赛德斯超越了乔治·拉塞尔，而刘易斯·汉密尔顿在新车中与他的法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔相比更具竞争力。

paras.en: Brown reflected: "I think we've seen it mix up a little bit of the grid, right? Charles last year got the better of Lewis. Lewis is getting the better of him. George got the better of Kimi, so I think it's mixed up the grid a little bit.
paras.zh: 布朗反思道：“我认为我们已经看到了一些网格的混乱，对吧？去年查尔斯战胜了刘易斯。刘易斯正在战胜他。乔治战胜了基米，所以我认为网格有点混乱了。”

paras.en: "I think if you look at Oscar's strengths, there were kind of big, brave corners. Now all of a sudden these new big, brave corners, it's like, 'hey lift, conserve, preserve.' So, I think there's a small element of him having to adapt to a new car.
paras.zh: “我认为，如果你看看奥斯卡的优势，就会发现有一些大而勇敢的角落。现在突然间这些新的大而勇敢的角落，就像是，‘嘿举起，保存，保存。’所以，我认为他必须适应新车有一个小因素。

paras.en: "And then let's not take any credit away from Lando. I've never seen him drive better.
paras.zh: “然后，我们不要剥夺兰多的任何荣誉。我从未见过他开得更好。

paras.en: "So, I think you have a combination of Lando who's driving the best I've ever seen him drive. Oscar who's just not yet clicked with it. There's your gap, but it's not a big gap."
paras.zh: “所以，我认为兰多的驾驶能力是我见过的最好的。奥斯卡还没有适应这一点。你们之间存在差距，但差距不是很大。”

articles.title: Ravens' season on the brink after loss to struggling Chargers

paras.en: NFL: Baltimore Ravens beaten by Los Angeles Chargers to leave season on brink as Justin Herbert's side claim first win
paras.zh: NFL：巴尔的摩乌鸦队被洛杉矶闪电队击败，贾斯汀·赫伯特的球队取得首场胜利，赛季结束

paras.en: The Los Angeles Chargers end their losing 0-8 start to the season by beating the Baltimore Ravens 23-20 behind Omarion Hampton's impressive efforts on the ground; the Ravens remain without quarterback Lamar Jackson, who is out for up to 10 weeks with a thumb injury
paras.zh: 洛杉矶闪电队凭借奥马里昂·汉普顿令人印象深刻的场上表现，以 23-20 击败巴尔的摩乌鸦队，结束了赛季开局 0-8 的失利；乌鸦队四分卫拉马尔·杰克逊因拇指受伤缺席长达 10 周

paras.en: Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton ran for first-half touchdowns as the Los Angeles Chargers earned their first win of the season, manhandling Baltimore at the line of scrimmage in a 23-20 victory over the Ravens on Monday night.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，贾斯汀·赫伯特和奥马里恩·汉普顿在上半场达阵，洛杉矶闪电队在混战线上粗暴对待巴尔的摩，以 23-20 战胜乌鸦队，赢得了本赛季的首场胜利。

paras.en: Derrick Henry was held to 10 yards on 10 carries, although he did score two touchdowns as Baltimore (4-6) skidded to its fifth straight loss and by far the most demoralising.
paras.zh: 德里克·亨利 (Derrick Henry) 10 次冲球被限制在 10 码内，尽管他确实取得了两次达阵，巴尔的摩 (4-6) 陷入了五连败，也是迄今为止最令人沮丧的一场。

paras.en: The Chargers (1-8) had lost 11 in a row dating back to last season but they outrushed the Ravens 160-16.
paras.zh: 闪电队(1胜8负)自上赛季以来已经遭遇11连败，但他们以160-16击败乌鸦队。

paras.en: The combined 15 straight losses by the Chargers and Ravens entering the game was a record for a Monday night game.
paras.zh: 闪电队和乌鸦队在这场比赛中合计 15 连败创下了周一晚上比赛的记录。

paras.en: - Latest NFL fixtures, results and UK kick-off times
paras.zh: - 最新 NFL 赛程、赛果和英国开球时间

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Herbert completed only 12 passes for 129 yards, but his 22-yard scoring run on the first Los Angeles possession gave the Chargers a lead they wouldn't relinquish.
paras.zh: 赫伯特仅完成 12 次传球，推进 129 码，但他在洛杉矶首个控球权中的 22 码跑动为闪电队带来了无法放弃的领先优势。

paras.en: "I respect those guys in that locker room so much, for sticking together, not pointing fingers," said Herbert. "It's been a tough year, but the way they continue to show up to work, they're true professionals and I'm honoured to be part of it."
paras.zh: 赫伯特说：“我非常尊重更衣室里的那些人，他们团结在一起，而不是相互指责。” “这是艰难的一年，但从他们继续工作的方式来看，他们是真正的专业人士，我很荣幸能成为其中的一部分。”

paras.en: With the Chargers up 23-20, Baltimore's Zay Flowers lost a fumble after catching a pass near the Los Angeles 45 with 2:03 remaining.
paras.zh: 在闪电队以 23-20 领先的情况下，巴尔的摩队的扎伊·弗劳尔斯在比赛还剩 2 分 03 秒时在洛杉矶 45 洞附近接到传球后失手。

paras.en: Then Herbert threw to ex-Raven Charlie Kolar for the first down that all but ended the game.
paras.zh: 然后赫伯特将第一球传给了前乌鸦队球员查理·科拉尔，这几乎结束了比赛。

paras.en: Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards in his Baltimore debut. With Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley both on injured reserve, the Ravens traded for Brissett in the hope that the veteran could at least keep the offense functional as Baltimore tries to avoid falling out of playoff contention.
paras.zh: 雅各比·布里塞特 (Jacoby Brissett) 在他的巴尔的摩首秀中传出 340 码。由于拉马尔·杰克逊和泰勒·亨特利都处于伤病储备名单中，乌鸦队交易了布里塞特，希望这位老将至少能在巴尔的摩试图避免退出季后赛争夺时至少保持进攻功能。

paras.en: The Ravens began the game by going three-and-out three straight times, and boos rained down on a Baltimore team that's now lost seven of its last eight home games - four at night - at a time when it was supposed to be competing for Super Bowls.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队以连续三场三胜出局的方式开始了比赛，而巴尔的摩队现在已经输掉了过去八场主场比赛中的七场（其中四场是晚上），而此时这支巴尔的摩队本应争夺超级碗的席位，却遭到了嘘声。

paras.en: Brissett and the offense gradually improved. A two-yard touchdown run by Henry cut the Los Angeles lead to 10-7, but after an interception, Hampton produced one of the game's key plays.
paras.zh: 布里塞特的进攻也逐渐有了起色。亨利的两码达阵将洛杉矶队的领先优势缩小到10-7，但在拦截后，汉普顿打出了比赛的关键一球。

paras.en: On fourth down from the one, he was initially stopped by linebacker Roquan Smith, but Hampton was able to power into the end zone with some help from a couple of team-mates. That made it 17-7 with 1:56 left in the half.
paras.zh: 在倒数第四个位置上，他最初被线卫罗泉·史密斯拦住，但汉普顿在几名队友的帮助下冲入达阵区。半场还剩1分56秒时，比分是17-7。

paras.en: Neither team reached the end zone again until Henry's one-yard run made it 23-20 with 10:23 left.
paras.zh: 直到比赛还剩10分23秒时，亨利的一码跑动将比分改写为23-20，双方都没有再次到达达阵区。
