articles.title: Autel Expands Nissan Diagnostic and ADAS Access
articles.author: Brake and Front End Staff

paras.en: Autel U.S. has released diagnostic and ADAS software updates for Nissan vehicles using the Consult 4 platform. The updates expand bidirectional control and ADAS calibration access across supported North American vehicles.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 已使用 Consult 4 平台为日产汽车发布了诊断和 ADAS 软件更新。这些更新扩展了受支持的北美车辆的双向控制和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: The Nissan diagnostic software is available on supported MaxiSYS Ultra and Ultra S2 tablets. ADAS calibration capability is available on these tablets with ADAS calibration software installed.
paras.zh: Nissan 诊断软件可在受支持的 MaxiSYS Ultra 和 Ultra S2 平板电脑上使用。这些安装了 ADAS 校准软件的平板电脑上提供 ADAS 校准功能。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。这些功能包括ECU信息、故障代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和ADAS校准程序。

paras.en: Supported Autel tablets access protected vehicle functions through AutoAuth. The independent service works with manufacturers and aftermarket tool providers to verify shops, technicians and tools for secure vehicle access.
paras.zh: 受支持的Autel平板电脑通过AutoAuth访问受保护的车辆功能。该独立服务与制造商和售后市场工具提供商合作，对维修店、技师和工具进行验证，以确保安全访问车辆。

paras.en: Authenticated Access for Newer Nissan Platforms
paras.zh: 针对较新日产平台的身份验证访问

paras.en: Nissan began incorporating security-gateway protections into select North American vehicles with the 2020 model year. These protections restrict designated bidirectional functions unless the technician, shop and diagnostic tool receive proper authentication.
paras.zh: 从2020年车型开始，日产开始将安全网关保护功能纳入部分北美车型。这些保护措施会限制指定的双向功能，除非技师、维修店和诊断工具获得适当的身份验证。

paras.en: Autel has offered AutoAuth-based Nissan security-gateway access for several years. The access applies to vehicles supported by Nissan’s Consult-III plus diagnostic platform.
paras.zh: 多年来，Autel 一直提供基于 AutoAuth 的日产安全网关访问。该访问权限适用于日产 Consult-III plus 诊断平台支持的车辆。

paras.en: Nissan introduced its newer web-based Consult 4 diagnostic software for the 2023 Nissan Ariya. The automaker now uses the software on a growing number of newer vehicle platforms.
paras.zh: 日产为2023款日产Ariya推出了更新的基于网络的Consult 4诊断软件。这家汽车制造商目前正在越来越多的新型车辆平台上使用该软件。

paras.en: Supporting protected functions required Autel to develop and validate a compatible authorization process. The process works with the vehicles’ newer electronic architectures.
paras.zh: 支持受保护功能需要Autel开发并验证兼容的授权流程。该流程适用于车辆的较新电子架构。

paras.en: Autel’s new capability expands diagnostic and ADAS calibration access across supported Nissan vehicles using Consult 4.
paras.zh: Autel的新功能通过Consult 4扩展了对所有支持的日产车辆的诊断和ADAS校准访问。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。这些功能包括ECU信息、故障代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和ADAS校准程序。

paras.en: North American Nissan vehicles using Consult 4 include:
paras.zh: 使用Consult 4的北美日产车辆包括：

paras.en: - 2025 and newer Nissan Kicks, Murano, Pathfinder and Armada
paras.zh: - 2025 年及更新款的日产劲客、楼兰、探路者和途乐

paras.en: Autel issued the expanded capabilities through the Nissan_V7.40 diagnostic software and Nissan_ADAS V5.20 software released on Sept. 9.
paras.zh: 9 月 9 日，Autel 通过发布的 Nissan_V7.40 诊断软件和 Nissan_ADAS V5.20 软件提供了扩展功能。

paras.en: Access requires an active Autel software subscription and an active AutoAuth account for Nissan access. ADAS calibration also requires applicable Autel software, equipment, targets and accessories.
paras.zh: 访问需要有效的Autel软件订阅和有效的AutoAuth账户才能访问日产车辆。ADAS 校准还需要适用的 Autel 软件、设备、目标和配件。

paras.en: Supported Consult 4 vehicle coverage does not require a separate AutoAuth service tier. Eligible users can obtain the software releases through the standard update process on their Autel tablet.
paras.zh: 受支持的 Consult 4 车型覆盖范围不需要单独的 AutoAuth 服务层。符合条件的用户可以通过其 Autel 平板电脑上的标准更新流程获取软件版本。

articles.title: Allison Transmission Named Idealease’s Supplier of the Year
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: Allison Transmission received the Idealease Supplier of the Year award, its third recognition from the leasing and rental company in eight years. The transmission supplier previously received the award in 2018 and 2022.
paras.zh: 艾里逊变速箱荣获 Idealease 年度供应商奖，这是这家租赁公司八年来第三次获得该奖项。该变速器供应商此前曾于 2018 年和 2022 年荣获该奖项。

paras.en: Idealease selects the recipient through evaluations by its affiliate network and corporate leadership. The award recognizes customer service responsiveness, product support, and relationships across the organization.
paras.zh: Idealease 通过其附属网络和公司领导层的评估来选择收件人。该奖项旨在表彰客户服务响应能力、产品支持以及整个组织的关系。

paras.en: “Allison has established product performance and customer service standards that are simply unmatched in our industry, making them more than deserving of this year’s Supplier of the Year award,” said Dan Murphy, president and CEO of Idealease. “In our experience, every Allison team member carries the same passion for upholding these standards with true professionalism, and that consistency is exactly what we value in a supplier partner.”
paras.zh: Idealease 总裁兼首席执行官 Dan Murphy 表示：“艾里逊建立的产品性能和客户服务标准在我们行业中是无与伦比的，这使他们当之无愧地获得今年的年度供应商奖。” “根据我们的经验，每一位艾里逊团队成员都怀有同样的热情，以真正的专业精神维护这些标准，而这种一致性正是我们对供应商合作伙伴所看重的。”

paras.en: The companies’ relationship spans four decades. Nearly 100% of Idealease’s medium-duty vehicles use Allison fully automatic transmissions, according to the announcement.
paras.zh: 两家公司的关系跨越了四十年。据公告称，理想的中型车辆近100%使用艾里逊全自动变速箱。

paras.en: The leasing company operates through more than 430 dealer-affiliated locations, offering full-service leasing, rental, and dedicated maintenance for customer-owned vehicles. Its network also provides fleet safety and compliance services.
paras.zh: 该租赁公司通过 430 多个经销商附属地点开展业务，为客户拥有的车辆提供全方位租赁、出租和专门维护服务。其网络还提供车队安全和合规服务。

paras.en: Allison 1000, 2000, 3000, and 4000 Series transmissions power vehicles across the fleet. The supplier announced the Idealease Supplier of the Year recognition on Oct. 28, 2026.
paras.zh: 艾里逊 1000、2000、3000 和 4000 系列变速箱为整个车队的车辆提供动力。该供应商于 2026 年 10 月 28 日宣布荣获 Idealease 年度供应商称号。

articles.title: Valvoline Global Continues Mahindra Racing Partnership
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Valvoline Global Operations reaffirmed its role as an official partner of Mahindra Racing. The announcement followed the team’s unveiling of its new GEN4 car and livery for Formula E’s 2026-27 season. Both companies built the partnership on the co-development of advanced e-fluids and transmission fluid technologies, emphasizing technical collaboration.
paras.zh: 胜牌全球运营部重申其作为 Mahindra Racing 官方合作伙伴的角色。在此消息发布之前，该团队为电动方程式 2026-27 赛季推出了新款 GEN4 赛车和涂装。两家公司建立了合作伙伴关系，共同开发先进的电子油和变速箱油技术，强调技术合作。

paras.en: This collaboration remains central as Mahindra Racing enters the GEN4 era following its strongest season to date. The team earned a record 252 points and finished third in the 2025-26 Teams’ Championship.
paras.zh: 随着 Mahindra Racing 在经历迄今为止最强劲的赛季后进入第 4 代时代，这种合作仍然至关重要。该队获得创纪录的 252 分，并在 2025-26 赛季团体锦标赛中获得第三名。

paras.en: Valvoline Global Advances E-Fluid Technology
paras.zh: 胜牌全球推进 E-Fluid 技术

paras.en: Mahindra Racing’s cars have used the jointly developed transmission fluid since May 2026, supporting the team’s performance and reliability efforts. Valvoline Global continues developing e-fluids and lubrication systems to withstand higher loads and optimize electric powertrain performance.
paras.zh: Mahindra Racing 的赛车自 2026 年 5 月起开始使用联合开发的变速箱油，为车队的性能和可靠性工作提供支持。胜牌全球不断开发电子油和润滑系统，以承受更高的负载并优化电动动力系统性能。

paras.en: Insights from racing also influence Valvoline’s commercial product development for mass-production EVs, where drivetrain efficiency, durability and reliability remain critical.
paras.zh: 来自赛车的见解也影响胜牌量产电动汽车的商业产品开发，其中动力传动系统的效率、耐用性和可靠性仍然至关重要。

paras.en: “Formula E is the ultimate proving ground for innovation. What sets this partnership apart is that the learning does not stay on the track,” said Jamal Muashsher, president and CEO, Valvoline Global. “The same rigor we apply to e-fluids performance under race conditions informs how we shape the next generation of mobility. The 2025/26 season showed what this collaboration can deliver, and we are now translating those proven capabilities into the real world.”
paras.zh: Valvoline Global 总裁兼首席执行官 Jamal Muashsher 表示：“Formula E 是创新的终极试验场。此次合作的独特之处在于，学习不会停留在赛道上。” “我们在比赛条件下对电子烟液性能的严格要求，也影响了我们如何塑造下一代出行方式。2025/26 赛季展示了这种合作可以带来的成果，我们现在正在将这些经过验证的功能转化为现实世界。”

paras.en: Mahindra Racing Prepares for GEN4 Season
paras.zh: Mahindra Racing 为 GEN4 赛季做准备

paras.en: Nyck de Vries and Edoardo Mortara return for the 2026-27 season. The drivers delivered a double podium at the London season finale and secured the team’s first top-three finishes in a decade. The team aims to carry that momentum into the new GEN4 car.
paras.zh: 尼克·德弗里斯和爱德华多·莫塔拉将在 2026-27 赛季回归。车手们在伦敦赛季决赛中双夺领奖台，并确保车队十年来首次进入前三名。该团队的目标是将这种势头带入新款 GEN4 赛车中。

paras.en: “GEN4 will demand a steep learning curve from the whole team, and continuity in our technical partnerships matters as much as continuity in our driver lineup,” said Frédéric Bertrand, team principal and CEO of Mahindra Racing. “Valvoline has been a valued technical partner, and we embed their work on e- and transmission fluids into how we solve for increased loads and energy management demands of the new car.”
paras.zh: Mahindra Racing 车队负责人兼首席执行官 Frédéric Bertrand 表示：“GEN4 将要求整个车队经历陡峭的学习曲线，我们技术合作伙伴关系的连续性与我们车手阵容的连续性一样重要。” “胜牌一直是重要的技术合作伙伴，我们将他们在电子和变速箱油方面的工作融入到我们如何解决新车增加的负载和能源管理需求中。”

paras.en: Racing Insights Support Commercial Product Development
paras.zh: 赛车洞察支持商业产品开发

paras.en: The partnership also continues to expand its track-to-road approach. Valvoline’s research and development spans internal combustion, hybrid and fully electric powertrains. The company draws on more than 160 years of experience and over two decades of dedicated EV research.
paras.zh: 该合作伙伴关系还继续扩大其从赛道到公路的方式。胜牌的研发涵盖内燃、混合动力和全电动动力系统。该公司拥有 160 多年的经验和 20 多年的电动汽车专业研究经验。

paras.en: This approach creates an engineering feedback loop between racing and commercial product development. Competition exposes fluids to extreme thermal and mechanical stress and rapid duty cycles. These conditions allow engineers to test formulations, confirm performance and define specifications.
paras.zh: 这种方法在赛车和商业产品开发之间创建了工程反馈循环。竞争使流体面临极端的热应力和机械应力以及快速的工作循环。这些条件允许工程师测试配方、确认性能并定义规格。

paras.en: The resulting data supports GEN4 readiness and helps establish standards for Valvoline’s commercial product range.
paras.zh: 生成的数据支持 GEN4 准备就绪，并有助于为胜牌商业产品系列建立标准。

paras.en: “Powering the Next Generation is not a slogan for us. It is an engineering brief,” Muashsher added. “Every generation of Formula E car raises the bar for what a fluid must do. Our job is to be ready before the bar moves.”
paras.zh: “为下一代提供动力对我们来说不是一个口号。这是一份工程简报，”Muashsher 补充道。 “每一代电动方程式赛车都提高了液体必须达到的标准。我们的工作是在标准发生变化之前做好准备。”

articles.title: Heavy Duty Aftermarket Dialogue Set for January 2027
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: MEMA announced that Heavy Duty Aftermarket Dialogue (HDAD) will take place January 18, 2027, at the Gaylord Texan Resort & Convention Center in Grapevine, TX.
paras.zh: MEMA 宣布重型汽车售后市场对话 (HDAD) 将于 2027 年 1 月 18 日在德克萨斯州格雷普韦恩的盖洛德德克萨斯度假酒店及会议中心举行。

paras.en: International’s Executive Vice President Service Solutions Fabio Souza will take the stage at HDAD ’27 to share the OEM perspective on the commercial vehicle aftermarket.
paras.zh: International 服务解决方案执行副总裁 Fabio Souza 将在 HDAD '27 上登台分享 OEM 对商用车售后市场的看法。

paras.en: As OEMs accelerate technology investments, their relationships with manufacturers, dealers, fleets, and aftermarket suppliers continue to evolve. Leading International’s aftersales operations and digital strategy expansion, Souza offers a firsthand OEM perspective on the changes shaping the future of the industry.
paras.zh: 随着原始设备制造商加速技术投资，他们与制造商、经销商、车队和售后供应商的关系不断发展。 Souza 领导 International 的售后运营和数字化战略扩展，为塑造行业未来的变化提供第一手的 OEM 视角。

paras.en: Early bird pricing is now available, according to MEMA. Additional speaker announcements are forthcoming.
paras.zh: 据 MEMA 称，早鸟价现已推出。其他演讲者公告即将发布。

articles.title: The Group Launches Toys for Tots Drive
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: For the 15th consecutive year, participating Automotive Parts Services Group (The Group) members are supporting the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots campaign by collecting toy and monetary donations for children in need in their communities.
paras.zh: 连续第 15 年，参与活动的汽车零部件服务集团 (集团) 成员通过为社区中有需要的儿童收集玩具和金钱捐款来支持美国海军陆战队为幼儿储备玩具活动。

paras.en: “Over the years, our Toys for Tots partnership has continued to grow as we collect toys and raise funds to bring holiday cheer to children in need across the country,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “The Group’s members have played an important role in growing the campaign through their commitment to promoting the program and encouraging community support. What began as a holiday effort has grown into a year-round initiative. We extend our sincere thanks to the Federated Alliance, The Pronto Network and our supplier partners for their ongoing generosity and commitment to this cause.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“多年来，我们与 Toys for Tots 的合作不断发展，我们收集玩具并筹集资金，为全国有需要的儿童带来节日欢乐。” “集团成员致力于推广该计划并鼓励社区支持，在推动这项活动方面发挥了重要作用。最初的假日活动已发展成为一项全年活动。我们衷心感谢联邦联盟、Pronto Network 和我们的供应商合作伙伴对这一事业的持续慷慨和承诺。”

paras.en: The Group Raises Over $4 Million for Toys For Tots
paras.zh: 该集团为幼儿玩具筹集了超过 400 万美元

paras.en: Since partnering with the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Program, The Group, its members and vendor partners have helped raise over $4 million for Toys for Tots. In addition to toy donations at participating locations, financial contributions can be made online by visiting The Group’s Toys for Tots website and clicking on “Make a Donation.” Donors can use a credit card securely or print out a form and mail it with a check made payable to Toys for Tots.
paras.zh: 自从与美国海军陆战队后备儿童玩具计划合作以来，该集团、其成员和供应商合作伙伴已帮助为儿童玩具筹集了超过 400 万美元的资金。除了在参与地点捐赠玩具外，还可以通过访问该集团的 Toys for Tots 网站并点击“捐赠”来在线捐款。捐赠者可以安全地使用信用卡，也可以打印表格并附上抬头为 Toys for Tots 的支票邮寄。

paras.en: “All donations made online or at participating member locations are distributed in the area where the toys and money are collected, helping make the holidays brighter for deserving children in their own communities,” said Marcum.
paras.zh: 马库姆说：“所有在线或在参与会员地点进行的捐款都会分发到收集玩具和金钱的区域，帮助他们自己社区的孩子们度过一个更加美好的假期。”

paras.en: Last year, the campaign delivered 24 million toys to nearly 11 million children and since 1947, the Marine Toys for Tots Foundation has distributed more than 732 million toys to more than 325 million children.
paras.zh: 去年，该活动向近 1100 万儿童分发了 2400 万件玩具，自 1947 年以来，海洋儿童玩具基金会已向超过 3.25 亿儿童分发了超过 7.32 亿件玩具。

articles.title: AutoZone President and CEO Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO, customer satisfaction, AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度部门总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 AutoZone 的商业销售额接近 60 亿美元，并在其约 95% 的商店中实施了该计划，因此正在加强其产品质量、可用性和交付能力，以更好地为维修店提供服务。 Daniele 强调了原厂品质或更好产品的重要性，包括其 Duralast 产品组合，以及通过其中心和大型中心战略扩大的品种。对技术、库存优化和专业销售队伍的投资正在帮助 AutoZone 更快地将合适的零件送到商店，同时建立更牢固的客户关系。

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering “WOW! customer service” remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. For professional repair shops, that means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供“哇！客户服务”仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。对于专业维修店来说，这意味着快速交付优质零件、确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

paras.en: To hear more of Daniele’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解 Daniele 的更多见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

articles.title: Thinkers of Cernavodă: Mysterious Stone Age figurines discovered in a 7,000-year-old grave in Romania
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: In 1956, archaeologists unearthed two unique figurines from one grave while excavating a Stone Age cemetery in southeast Romania. The unusual figurines — known as the Thinkers of Cernavodă or the Thinker and the Seated Woman — were made by people from the Hamangia culture and may be linked to ancient astronomical beliefs.
paras.zh: 1956 年，考古学家在罗马尼亚东南部挖掘石器时代墓地时，从一座坟墓中出土了两个独特的雕像。这些不寻常的雕像被称为切尔纳沃德思想家或思想家和坐着的女人，是由哈曼吉亚文化的人们制作的，可能与古代天文学信仰有关。

paras.en: The Thinkers of Cernavodă are in the collection of the National Museum of Romanian History and are a key part of the country's cultural heritage. They were crafted from fired clay and measure about 4.5 inches (11.5 centimeters) tall. The two figurines may represent a man (the Thinker) and a woman (the Seated Woman), according to the museum.
paras.zh: 切尔纳沃德思想家收藏于罗马尼亚国家历史博物馆，是该国文化遗产的重要组成部分。它们由烧制粘土制成，高约 4.5 英寸（11.5 厘米）。据博物馆称，这两个雕像可能代表一个男人（思想者）和一个女人（坐着的女人）。

paras.en: The Thinker sits on a low, four-legged stool. He bends forward slightly, rounding his back and neck, and his arms are bent. He rests his elbows on his knees and his head in his hands. This pose gives him a meditative quality, according to the museum, which is why he has been named after Auguste Rodin's famous 1904 bronze sculpture. The Seated Woman also has a long, bent neck and a small face. She has prominent hips, thighs and breasts. Her right leg is bent, and her hands rest on her knee.
paras.zh: 思考者坐在一张低矮的四脚凳上。他稍微向前弯腰，拱起背部和颈部，双臂弯曲。他将肘部放在膝盖上，双手抱头。据博物馆称，这种姿势赋予他一种冥想的品质，这就是为什么他以奥古斯特·罗丹 1904 年著名的青铜雕塑命名的原因。坐着的女人也有一个长而弯曲的脖子和一张小脸。她有突出的臀部、大腿和胸部。她的右腿弯曲，双手放在膝盖上。

paras.en: The figurines are about 7,000 years old and were made by the Hamangia people, a Late Neolithic culture that stretched from the Danube River to the Black Sea. According to archaeologist Dumitru Berciu, who excavated the Cernavodă cemetery, the Hamangia culture lasted from about 5200 to 4500 B.C. The people focused primarily on sheep and goat herding, and they built defensive hilltop settlements. They also crafted spiral-decorated pottery and human-shaped figurines. But while Berciu found dozens of male and female figurines in the Cernavodă cemetery, he noted that both Thinkers were unusual for being depicted seated rather than standing.
paras.zh: 这些雕像约有 7000 年前的历史，由哈曼吉亚人制作，哈曼吉亚人是新石器时代晚期的文化，从多瑙河一直延伸到黑海。根据挖掘切尔纳沃德公墓的考古学家杜米特鲁·贝尔丘 (Dumitru Berciu) 的说法，哈曼吉亚文化大约持续了公元前 5200 年至公元前 4500 年。人们主要以放牧绵羊和山羊为业，并在山顶建造了防御性定居点。他们还制作了螺旋装饰的陶器和人形雕像。不过，虽然贝尔丘在切尔纳沃德墓地发现了数十个男性和女性雕像，但他指出，这两位思想家的不同寻常之处在于，他们被描绘成坐着而不是站着。

paras.en: The specific meaning of the Thinkers is unclear. Berciu suggested that the figurines were somewhat stylized, rather than realistic, because they served a magical or religious purpose. Since solar worship was common among later Bronze Age groups in Europe — as evidenced by artifacts like the Nebra sky disc from Germany and an ornate sun chariot from Denmark — Berciu interpreted the figurines as possibly connected to sun worship.
paras.zh: 思想家的具体含义尚不清楚。贝尔丘认为这些雕像有些程式化，而不是现实的，因为它们具有魔法或宗教目的。由于太阳崇拜在欧洲后来的青铜时代群体中很常见——德国的内布拉天盘和丹麦的华丽太阳战车等文物就证明了这一点——贝尔丘将这些雕像解释为可能与太阳崇拜有关。

paras.en: But the National Museum of Romanian History has suggested that the two figurines may have been made specifically as a pair, representing the complementary principles of masculine and feminine natures or a Neolithic family unit. Another interpretation is that the sculptures depict a pair of mourners who were buried with the deceased.
paras.zh: 但罗马尼亚国家历史博物馆表示，这两个雕像可能是专门作为一对制作的，代表了男性和女性本性的互补原则或新石器时代的家庭单位。另一种解释是，这些雕塑描绘了一对与死者合葬的哀悼者。

paras.en: While the original meaning of the 7,000-year-old sculptures remains a mystery, people continue to be drawn to the contemplative pair, and the male Thinker figures prominently today in the logo of the National Museum of Romanian History.
paras.zh: 虽然这对具有 7000 年历史的雕塑的原始意义仍然是个谜，但人们仍然被这对沉思的雕像所吸引，而今天，这位男性思想家在罗马尼亚国家历史博物馆的标志中占据了显着的位置。

articles.title: Tiny robots can tumble through blood vessels to help dissolve blood clots, early test shows
articles.author: Victoria Atkinson

paras.en: Microrobots controlled by magnets can sweep drugs towards hard-to-reach blood clots in the body, boosting the efficacy of these life-saving treatments, early tests in animals suggest.
paras.zh: 早期动物试验表明，由磁铁控制的微型机器人可以将药物扫向体内难以到达的血栓，从而提高这些救生治疗的功效。

paras.en: In tests with pigs, the microbots helped to dissolve clots around 10 times faster than medication alone. The research team is now working on further safety testing to ready the technology for eventual human trials.
paras.zh: 在对猪进行的测试中，微型机器人溶解血栓的速度比单独使用药物的速度快 10 倍左右。研究团队目前正在开展进一步的安全测试，为该技术最终的人体试验做好准备。

paras.en: "The whole construct is inspired by nature," said lead researcher Simone Schürle, professor of medical microsystems at ETH Zürich. "There are these tiny bacteria that have little magnetic backbones which they use to navigate with the Earth's magnetic field, and we were really struck by the physics and the properties of them when exposed to rotating magnetic fields," Schürle told Live Science.
paras.zh: “整个结构的灵感来自于大自然，”首席研究员、苏黎世联邦理工学院医学微系统教授西蒙·舒尔勒 (Simone Schürle) 说。舒尔告诉《生活科学》杂志：“这些微小的细菌几乎没有磁性骨架，它们可以利用地球磁场进行导航，当它们暴露在旋转磁场中时，我们真的对它们的物理特性和特性感到震惊。”

paras.en: ETH Zürich announced the research in a statement on Nov. 9. It has not been described in a peer-reviewed study yet.
paras.zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院在 11 月 9 日的一份声明中宣布了这项研究。该研究尚未在同行评审的研究中进行描述。

paras.en: Tiny robots tumbling through blood vessels
paras.zh: 微型机器人在血管中翻滚

paras.en: Left untreated, blood clots can cause life-threatening damage. These blockages can restrict the flow of blood to the body's key tissues, triggering serious cardiovascular events, such as heart attacks or strokes, which starve cells of oxygen.
paras.zh: 如果不及时治疗，血栓可能会造成危及生命的损害。这些阻塞会限制血液流向身体的关键组织，引发严重的心血管事件，例如心脏病或中风，使细胞缺氧。

paras.en: Doctors can either remove clots manually with tools or deliver clot-dissolving drugs, called thrombolytics, close to the site of the blockage. However, getting these medications through the final few millimeters of their journey is often the hardest part.
paras.zh: 医生可以使用工具手动清除血栓，或者在堵塞部位附近提供溶解血栓的药物（称为溶栓剂）。然而，让这些药物通过其旅程的最后几毫米往往是最困难的部分。

paras.en: "When a pipe becomes blocked in a branched pipe system, the fluid encounters greater resistance and instead flows through alternative routes where it can pass more easily," Schürle explained. "So when you then try to bring in drugs to dissolve the clot, they won't flow into this area because it's occluded [blocked off]."
paras.zh: “当分支管道系统中的管道被堵塞时，流体会遇到更大的阻力，而是流经更容易通过的替代路线，”舒尔解释道。 “因此，当你尝试引入药物来溶解血栓时，它们不会流入该区域，因为它被闭塞了。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: This is where microbots can help. The bots are tiny particles whose movements can be controlled by external magnets, which send them rotating and tumbling through blood vessels. These bots can redirect the interrupted blood flow and thus carry essential drugs straight to their target, Schürle and her team say.
paras.zh: 这就是微型机器人可以提供帮助的地方。这些机器人是微小的颗粒，其运动可以通过外部磁铁控制，从而使它们在血管中旋转和翻滚。舒尔和她的团队说，这些机器人可以重新引导中断的血流，从而将基本药物直接运送到目标。

paras.en: Each bullet-shaped microbot contains a magnetic backbone of iron oxide nanoparticles, which is surrounded by a protective sheath of hydrogel polymer. When exposed to a rotating magnetic field, the microbots essentially start to somersault through the blood vessel, creating little vortices that help carry the drugs along with them.
paras.zh: 每个子弹形微型机器人都包含氧化铁纳米粒子的磁性主链，其周围环绕着水凝胶聚合物的保护套。当暴露在旋转磁场中时，微型机器人基本上开始在血管中翻筋斗，产生小漩涡，帮助携带药物。

paras.en: Crucially, the bots' rigid backbone ensures that they spin predictably, while the gel body prevents the particles from sticking together and forming a clump.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，机器人的刚性骨架确保它们可预测地旋转，而凝胶体可防止颗粒粘在一起并形成团块。

paras.en: The researchers introduce the tiny robots into blood vessels where clots are present.
paras.zh: 研究人员将微型机器人引入存在血栓的血管中。

paras.en: The robots' motion helps to direct blood-clot-dissolving drugs toward the clots in question.
paras.zh: 机器人的运动有助于将血栓溶解药物引导到有问题的血栓处。

paras.en: The team first tested the microbots in a silicon model of a blood vessel that contained clots of pigs' blood. Aided by the rotating microparticles, a thrombolytic drug dissolved the blockages around 10 times faster than medication alone did. That's a potentially life-saving difference, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 研究小组首先在含有猪血凝块的硅血管模型中测试了微型机器人。在旋转微粒的帮助下，溶栓药物溶解堵塞物的速度比单独药物快约 10 倍。研究人员表示，这可能是挽救生命的差异。

paras.en: They then repeated the experiment in live pigs, placing clots in vessels in each of the animals' kidneys. "When we introduced our micro-robots with a conventional, state-of-the-art drug, we could reperfuse [restore blood flow to] a much larger area than if only the drug was there," Schürle said. "The next step is doing safety studies over a longer time and in larger animals."
paras.zh: 然后他们在活猪身上重复了这个实验，将凝块放入每只动物肾脏的血管中。 “当我们为微型机器人引入一种传统的、最先进的药物时，我们可以将[恢复血流]重新灌注到比只有药物更大的区域，”Schürle 说。 “下一步是在更长的时间内对更大的动物进行安全性研究。”

paras.en: Earlier safety studies in mice showed that both the iron oxide and the gel sheath polymer safely break down in the body within a few weeks. However, the team will now need to demonstrate that the device is safe in larger mammals before it can be trialed in human patients; their latest test in pigs did not look at how the device broke down or how the pigs fared after the clots were dissolved.
paras.zh: 早期对小鼠的安全性研究表明，氧化铁和凝胶鞘聚合物都会在几周内在体内安全分解。然而，该团队现在需要证明该设备在大型哺乳动物中是安全的，然后才能在人类患者身上进行试验。他们对猪进行的最新测试并没有观察该装置如何损坏，也没有观察凝块溶解后猪的表现如何。

paras.en: Ultimately, the researchers hope that the bots could be injected into the body alongside the thrombolytic medicine. Once inside, they'd be controlled by targeted electromagnets, making the technique easy to integrate into existing clinical procedures for treating clots.
paras.zh: 最终，研究人员希望机器人能够与溶栓药物一起注射到体内。一旦进入内部，它们将受到目标电磁体的控制，从而使该技术易于集成到现有的治疗血栓的临床程序中。

paras.en: The team's research is still undergoing peer review, but Schürle has applied for a patent for the microbots' production, which uses a droplet-based microfluidics technique to form each individual particle.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究仍在接受同行评审，但 Schürle 已为微型机器人的生产申请了专利，该微型机器人使用基于液滴的微流体技术来形成每个单独的颗粒。

paras.en: "It's a very cheap, high throughput method to produce the micro-robots," she said. "It's about improving the [clot-dissolving] procedure where it is lacking and helping the drugs travel the last millimeters to be really effective."
paras.zh: “这是一种非常便宜、高产量的微型机器人生产方法，”她说。 “这是为了改进[血栓溶解]程序的不足，并帮助药物到达最后几毫米以真正发挥作用。”

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Victoria Atkinson is a freelance science journalist, specializing in chemistry and its interface with the natural and human-made worlds. Currently based in York (UK), she formerly worked as a science content developer at the University of Oxford, and later as a member of the Chemistry World editorial team. Since becoming a freelancer, Victoria has expanded her focus to explore topics from across the sciences and has also worked with Chemistry Review, Neon Squid Publishing and the Open University, amongst others. She has a DPhil in organic chemistry from the University of Oxford.
paras.zh: 维多利亚·阿特金森 (Victoria Atkinson) 是一名自由科学记者，专门研究化学及其与自然和人造世界的相互作用。她目前居住在英国约克，曾在牛津大学担任科学内容开发人员，后来成为《化学世界》编辑团队的成员。自从成为自由职业者以来，维多利亚将她的注意力扩大到探索跨科学的主题，并与 Chemistry Review、Neon Squid Publishing 和 Open University 等合作。她拥有牛津大学有机化学博士学位。

articles.title: The Leonid meteor shower peaks tonight: How to see more than a dozen 'shooting stars' per hour
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: One of November's best meteor showers peaks tonight (Nov. 16-17) and is expected to bring up to 15 "shooting stars" per hour to a near-moonless night sky.
paras.zh: 11 月最好的流星雨之一将于今晚（11 月 16 日至 17 日）达到顶峰，预计每小时将多达 15 颗“流星”带入几乎没有月亮的夜空。

paras.en: Although the annual Leonid meteor shower, which is famous for occasionally producing spectacular meteor storms, is active from Nov. 6 to Nov. 30, the peak on Monday into Tuesday is the best time to look, according to the American Meteor Society.
paras.zh: 据美国流星协会称，一年一度的狮子座流星雨以偶尔产生壮观的流星风暴而闻名，活动时间为11月6日至11月30日，但周一至周二的高峰期是观看的最佳时间。

paras.en: Although the Leonids typically produce around 15 meteors per hour under ideal conditions, they're among the year's fastest shooting stars, reaching 43 miles per second (70 kilometers per second), and often produce bright meteors that leave glowing trails.
paras.zh: 虽然狮子座流星雨在理想条件下通常每小时产生约 15 颗流星，但它们是一年中最快的流星之一，速度达到每秒 43 英里（每秒 70 公里），并且经常产生明亮的流星，留下发光的痕迹。

paras.en: The best time to see them is between midnight and dawn Tuesday (Nov. 17), when the constellation Leo, from which the meteors appear to radiate, climbs higher in the eastern sky. However, shooting stars can appear anywhere in the sky.
paras.zh: 观看流星的最佳时间是周二（11 月 17 日）午夜和黎明之间，此时狮子座（流星似乎从这里辐射出来）在东方天空中爬得更高。然而，流星可能出现在天空的任何地方。

paras.en: A 45%-lit waxing crescent moon will set just before midnight, leaving dark skies for meteor watching. For the best views, find a spot away from artificial lights, lie back with a wide view of the sky, and allow about 20 minutes for your eyes to become adapted to the dark. Don't use binoculars or a telescope during a meteor shower; they will only restrict your view. However, you can try your hand at photographing the shower with your smartphone or a good astrophotography camera.
paras.zh: 45% 亮度的上弦月将在午夜前落下，留下黑暗的天空供观赏流星。为了获得最佳景观，请找到一个远离人造光源的地方，躺下来可以看到广阔的天空，并给您的眼睛大约 20 分钟的时间来适应黑暗。流星雨期间不要使用双筒望远镜或望远镜；他们只会限制你的观点。不过，您可以尝试使用智能手机或优质的天文摄影相机拍摄淋浴。

paras.en: The Leonids are produced by tiny particles of dust and debris left behind in the inner solar system by Comet 55P/Tempel-Tuttle, which takes about 33 years to orbit the sun and is about 2.2 miles (3.6 km) in diameter. Tempel-Tuttle last visited the inner solar system in 1998 and is due to return again in 2031.
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨是由 55P/Tempel-Tuttle 彗星在内太阳系留下的微小尘埃和碎片产生的，彗星绕太阳运行大约需要 33 年，直径约为 2.2 英里（3.6 公里）。坦普尔-塔特尔上次访问内太阳系是在 1998 年，预计将于 2031 年再次返回。

paras.en: Although no rapid-fire "meteor storms" are expected this year, the Leonids are famous for occasionally producing outbursts of 1,000 shooting stars per hour. Such storms occurred in 1833, 1866, 1966, 1999, 2001 and 2002, according to the American Meteor Society. The next storm is expected to hit in 2099.
paras.zh: 尽管预计今年不会出现快速的“流星风暴”，但狮子座流星雨以每小时偶尔产生 1,000 颗流星的爆发而闻名。据美国流星协会称，此类风暴分别发生在 1833 年、1866 年、1966 年、1999 年、2001 年和 2002 年。预计下一次风暴将于 2099 年袭击。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: After the Leonids, the next major meteor shower will be the Geminids, which peak overnight on Dec. 13-14. The Geminid meteor shower, which is caused by an asteroid rather than a comet, can produce up to 120 meteors per hour. This year, the Geminids will peak in dark skies, thanks to a slim crescent moon setting shortly after dark on Dec. 13.
paras.zh: 继狮子座流星雨之后，下一个主要流星雨将是双子座流星雨，其峰值将于 12 月 13 日至 14 日夜间达到峰值。双子座流星雨是由小行星而不是彗星引起的，每小时可产生多达 120 颗流星。今年，由于 12 月 13 日天黑后不久，一轮细长的新月落下，双子座流星雨将在黑暗的天空中达到顶峰。

paras.en: Jamie Carter is a Cardiff, U.K.-based freelance science journalist and a regular contributor to Live Science. He is the author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners and co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and leads international stargazing and eclipse-chasing tours. His work appears regularly in Space.com, Forbes, New Scientist, BBC Sky at Night, Sky & Telescope, and other major science and astronomy publications. He is also the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com.
paras.zh: 杰米·卡特 (Jamie Carter) 是英国卡迪夫的一名自由科学记者，也是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人。他是《初学者观星计划》一书的作者，也是《日食效应》一书的合著者，并领导国际观星和日食追逐之旅。他的作品经常出现在 Space.com、福布斯、新科学家、BBC 夜间天空、天空与望远镜以及其他主要科学和天文学出版物上。他还是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑。

articles.title: A French Court Annuls the $1.6-Million Sale of This Camille Pissarro Painting, Allegedly Looted During World War II

paras.en: In 1941, German forces in occupied Paris looted a Jewish banker’s collection of impressionist artworks. Now, more than eight decades later, a French court has stepped in to demand the return of one allegedly looted painting to the descendants of its owner.
paras.zh: 1941 年，德国军队在占领的巴黎抢劫了一位犹太银行家收藏的印象派艺术品。现在，八多年过去了，法国一家法院介入，要求将一幅据称被掠夺的画作归还给其主人的后裔。

paras.en: A 1902 landscape by Camille Pissarro titled Darse de pêche et bassin Duquesne, Dieppe, après-midi ensoleillée (Fishing Dock and Duquesne Basin, Dieppe, Sunny Afternoon) was auctioned by Sotheby’s London on June 25, 2024, to an anonymous buyer for roughly $1.6 million. On November 5, the Paris Judicial Court annulled that sale and ordered Sotheby’s to “disclose the full identity of the buyer of the work” within two months or pay a $1,115 fine for every additional day it fails to do so, CNN’s Lianne Kolirin reports.
paras.zh: 2024 年 6 月 25 日，伦敦苏富比拍卖行以约 160 万美元的价格将一幅卡米尔·毕沙罗 (Camille Pissarro) 创作的风景画《Darse de pêche et bassin Duquesne, Dieppe, après-midi ensoleillée》（迪耶普的钓鱼码头和杜肯盆地，阳光明媚的下午）拍卖给一位匿名买家。据 CNN 的 Lianne Kolirin 报道，11 月 5 日，巴黎司法法院宣布该拍卖无效，并命令苏富比在两个月内“披露该作品买家的完整身份”，否则每多一天支付 1,115 美元的罚款。

paras.en: Between 1933 and 1945, the Nazi regime orchestrated the largest art theft in history, seizing more than 650,000 artworks across Europe—some 20 percent of the continent’s art—including from Jewish families, collectors and museums.
paras.zh: 1933 年至 1945 年间，纳粹政权策划了历史上最大规模的艺术品盗窃案，在欧洲各地没收了超过 65 万件艺术品（约占欧洲大陆艺术品的 20%），其中包括来自犹太家庭、收藏家和博物馆的艺术品。

paras.en: Salomon Flavian, a Jewish banker of French and Romanian heritage, purchased Pissarro’s view of the Normandy port town of Dieppe at the Hôtel Drouot auction house in Paris in March 1935, according to the Sotheby’s listing.
paras.zh: 根据苏富比拍卖行的清单，所罗门·弗拉维安 (Salomon Flavian) 是一位拥有法国和罗马尼亚血统的犹太银行家，他于 1935 年 3 月在巴黎的 Hôtel Drouot 拍卖行购买了毕沙罗的诺曼底港口小镇迪耶普景观。

paras.en: When war erupted in September 1939, Flavian placed the canvas and dozens of other works into the care of the Westminster Foreign Bank in Paris. In 1941, German forces seized his collection. Although Flavian survived the war and recovered some pieces, the Pissarro remained missing and was listed in France’s official register of looted property.
paras.zh: 1939 年 9 月战争爆发时，弗拉维安将这幅画和数十件其他作品交由巴黎威斯敏斯特外国银行保管。 1941 年，德国军队没收了他的收藏。尽管弗拉维安在战争中幸存下来并找回了一些作品，但毕沙罗的画作仍然下落不明，并被列入法国官方被掠夺财产登记册中。

paras.en: Nearly eight decades later, the painting resurfaced at Sotheby’s London with a note stating that it was “offered for sale pursuant to a settlement between the current owner and heirs of Salomon Flavian.” That settlement had been brokered by the Mondex Corporation, a Toronto-based firm specializing in recovering Nazi-looted art.
paras.zh: 近八个十年后，这幅画在伦敦苏富比拍卖行重新出现，并附有说明，称其“根据所罗门·弗拉维安现任所有者与继承人之间的和解协议进行出售”。该和解是由 Mondex Corporation 促成的，Mondex Corporation 是一家总部位于多伦多的公司，专门回收纳粹掠夺的艺术品。

paras.en: At a hearing in this fall, seven descendants of Flavian told the court that two relatives had signed the deal without consulting the rest of the family. The descendants claimed they had only found out about the sale months later, when Mondex sent a letter explaining that it had accepted in their name a “relatively modest” 8 percent share of the net sale price “in exchange for their cooperation,” while the two heirs who signed the contract received a 16 percent commission, the Art Newspaper’s Vincent Noce reported in September.
paras.zh: 在今年秋天的一次听证会上，弗拉维安的七名后裔告诉法庭，两名亲戚在没有咨询其他家族成员的情况下签署了协议。据《艺术报》的文森特·诺斯 (Vincent Noce) 9 月份报道，后代们声称，他们是在几个月后才得知此次拍卖的消息，当时 Mondex 发了一封信，解释说，它以他们的名义接受了“相对适度”的净售价 8% 的份额，“以换取他们的合作”，而签署合同的两位继承人则获得了 16% 的佣金。

paras.en: At the hearing, Sotheby’s and Mondex presented research claiming that Flavian had parted with the painting before the war, pointing to a 1939 Pissarro catalogue raisonné by Paris dealer Paul Rosenberg that listed British artist and collector Edward Le Bas as the owner. Sotheby’s auction provenance similarly traced the canvas from Flavian to Rosenberg by 1937 and to Le Bas by 1939. It then eventually passed through several American collections, including David Rockefeller’s, and a 1985 sale at Sotheby’s New York.
paras.zh: 在听证会上，苏富比和 Mondex 提交了研究报告，声称弗拉维安在战前就放弃了这幅画，并指出巴黎经销商保罗·罗森伯格 (Paul Rosenberg) 于 1939 年绘制的毕沙罗全集画册，其中将英国艺术家兼收藏家爱德华·勒巴斯 (Edward Le Bas) 列为所有者。苏富比的拍卖来源同样可以追溯到 1937 年这幅油画从弗拉维安 (Flavian) 到罗森伯格 (Rosenberg)，再到 1939 年的勒巴斯 (Le Bas)。随后，它最终被几个美国收藏家收藏，其中包括大卫·洛克菲勒 (David Rockefeller) 的收藏，并于 1985 年在纽约苏富比拍卖行进行了一次拍卖。

paras.en: Earlier this month, the Paris court rejected that timeline, finding “no direct and convincing evidence” of prewar sales to Rosenberg or Le Bas, according to the Art Newspaper. Instead, the court concluded that the family presented “a set of precise, serious and concurring elements demonstrating that Pissarro’s work was indeed looted during” the war.
paras.zh: 据《艺术报》报道，本月早些时候，巴黎法院驳回了这一时间表，认为“没有直接且令人信服的证据”表明战前曾向罗森伯格或勒巴斯出售过艺术品。相反，法院得出的结论是，该家族提出了“一系列精确、严肃和一致的证据，证明毕沙罗的作品确实在战争期间被掠夺”。

paras.en: The court ordered “the restitution of the work, wherever and in whoever’s possession it may be, to the descendants of Salomon Flavian,” the London Times’ David Chazan reports.
paras.zh: 据伦敦《泰晤士报》的大卫·查赞报道，法院下令“将这件作品归还给所罗门·弗拉维安的后裔，无论它在哪里、由谁拥有”。

paras.en: “It is a very important ruling, which opens the way to a restitution that the Flavian family has demanded since the war,” Corinne Hershkovitch, the claimants’ lawyer, tells the Art Newspaper.
paras.zh: 原告律师科琳·赫什科维奇 (Corinne Hershkovitch) 告诉《艺术报》：“这是一项非常重要的裁决，为弗拉维安家族自战后要求的赔偿开辟了道路。”

paras.en: In May, the Musée d’Orsay in Paris opened a new permanent exhibition titled “Who Owns These Works?” It showcases 13 artworks that may have been looted or sold under suspicious circumstances during World War II with the hope that public exposure may help locate the rightful owners.
paras.zh: 五月，巴黎奥赛博物馆开设了一个名为“谁拥有这些作品？”的新常设展览。它展示了 13 件可能在二战期间被抢劫或在可疑情况下被出售的艺术品，希望公开曝光可以帮助找到合法的所有者。

paras.en: Mondex, which was ordered to pay $11,000 to the heirs, plans to challenge the verdict. Mondex founder James Palmer tells ARTnews’ Brian Boucher that an appeal will be filed “forthwith.” He adds: “We are confident that when the vast amount of complex provenance research evidence is properly understood and considered that the court of appeal will reach a different conclusion.”
paras.zh: Mondex 被责令向继承人支付 11,000 美元，计划对判决提出质疑。 Mondex 创始人 James Palmer 告诉 ARTnews 的 Brian Boucher，将“立即”提起上诉。他补充道：“我们相信，当大量复杂的出处研究证据得到正确理解和考虑时，上诉法院将得出不同的结论。”

paras.en: Because the French judgment applies immediately despite any appeal, the legal battle now shifts toward enforcing the order across the English Channel. Hershkovitch, however, tells the Times that cross-border enforcement between France and England is “a fairly simple procedure.” She adds: “Sotheby’s will have to find a solution very quickly because their reputation is at stake.”
paras.zh: 由于无论上诉如何，法国的判决都会立即适用，因此法律斗争现在转向在英吉利海峡执行该命令。然而，赫什科维奇告诉《泰晤士报》，法国和英国之间的跨境执法是“一个相当简单的程序”。她补充道：“苏富比必须尽快找到解决方案，因为他们的声誉受到威胁。”

paras.en: In a statement, Sotheby’s London noted its disappointment in the verdict, welcomed the dismissal of charges against the auction house and recognized the “profound losses suffered by the Flavian family during the Nazi era,” per CNN. A spokesperson says that Sotheby’s is considering whether to join Mondex’s appeal, while stressing that “client confidentiality is of paramount importance,” according to the Art Newspaper.
paras.zh: 据美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 报道，伦敦苏富比在一份声明中表示对判决感到失望，对撤销对拍卖行的指控表示欢迎，并承认“弗拉维家族在纳粹时代遭受了巨大损失”。据《艺术报》报道，一位发言人表示，苏富比正在考虑是否加入 Mondex 的上诉，同时强调“客户保密至关重要”。

articles.title: These Adorable Hatchlings Are From the U.S. West Coast's First Known Natural Sea Turtle Nests. Now, They've Returned to the Wild

paras.en: In September, authorities in California were baffled to find two sea turtle nests on their beaches—the first natural ones ever confirmed on the United States’ West Coast. Now, dozens of the eggs have hatched. Experts released the baby olive ridley turtles over the weekend, allowing the tiny creatures to begin their perilous journeys to adulthood.
paras.zh: 9 月，加利福尼亚州当局在其海滩上发现了两个海龟巢，这也是美国西海岸首次确认的天然海龟巢。现在，已有数十枚蛋孵化出来。周末，专家们释放了小橄榄丽龟，让这些小生物开始了危险的成年之旅。

paras.en: The two nests were identified on Seal Beach and Huntington Beach in Orange County. Because a tropical storm was coming soon after the nests were found, biologists moved the more than 200 eggs to the Aquarium of the Pacific. The Ping-Pong ball-size spheres stayed in closed incubators under sand in a temperature- and humidity-controlled room, simulating their ideal natural conditions.
paras.zh: 这两个巢穴是在奥兰治县的海豹海滩和亨廷顿海滩发现的。由于发现巢穴后不久热带风暴即将来临，生物学家将这 200 多个蛋转移到了太平洋水族馆。这些乒乓球大小的球体被放置在温度和湿度可控的房间里的沙子下的封闭培养箱中，模拟它们理想的自然条件。

paras.en: Aquarium staff first saw signs of hatching activity on November 12, when they noticed changes in the surface of the sand in the incubation container with the Seal Beach eggs, said Lance Adams, the aquarium’s veterinarian, during a press conference on November 14. The team spotted a depression and some cracks in the sand, indicating something was happening beneath it. The first turtle emerged the following day at around 7:15 p.m. Pacific time. Around two hours later, more of the baby turtles from the Seal Beach nest started popping out, resulting in 54 squirming critters.
paras.zh: 水族馆兽医兰斯·亚当斯 (Lance Adams) 在 11 月 14 日的新闻发布会上表示，水族馆工作人员在 11 月 12 日首次看到孵化活动的迹象，当时他们注意到装有海豹海滩蛋的孵化容器中的沙子表面发生了变化。团队在沙子上发现了一个凹陷和一些裂缝，这表明沙子下面发生了一些事情。第二天晚上 7 点 15 分左右，第一只海龟出现了。太平洋时间。大约两小时后，更多海豹宝宝从海豹海滩巢穴中涌出，导致 54 只小海龟蠕动。

paras.en: “It kind of went from looking like very smooth beach sand to looking like an eruption of baby sea turtles,” Adams explained. It “was really exciting and very, very cute.” As of the press conference date, 50 eggs from the nest had not hatched. Experts do not know whether they’re viable, but they will continue monitoring the makeshift home.
paras.zh: 亚当斯解释说：“它从看起来像非常光滑的沙滩变成了看起来像小海龟的爆发。”它“真的很令人兴奋，而且非常非常可爱。”截至记者招待会当日，巢中尚有50枚蛋尚未孵化。专家们不知道他们是否可行，但他们将继续监控临时住所。

paras.en: The Seal Beach hatchlings were released in the same location where their nest had been, very early on Saturday morning, before the sun had risen, according to a social media post. That’s because baby turtles use moonlight to navigate toward the ocean. After reaching the water, hatchlings experience a “frenzy period” in which they swim continuously for 24 to 48 hours, according to the post. The energetic outburst is justified; experts estimate that only one in 1,000 olive ridley turtle hatchlings survive to adulthood, according to a statement.
paras.zh: 据社交媒体帖子称，周六一大早，太阳升起之前，海豹海滩的海豹幼崽就在它们巢穴所在的同一地点被释放。这是因为小海龟利用月光向海洋航行。帖子称，入水后，幼龟会经历一段“疯狂期”，在这段时间内它们会连续游泳 24 至 48 小时。精力充沛的爆发是有道理的；一份声明称，专家估计，只有千分之一的橄榄龟幼龟能活到成年。

paras.en: The Huntington Beach eggs weren’t too far behind, with many hatchlings emerging shortly after the Seal Beach eggs. They were returned to Huntington Beach on Sunday, also under the cover of darkness during the wee morning hours. All the released hatchlings made it to the water, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 亨廷顿海滩的蛋也紧随其后，在海豹海滩的蛋之后不久，许多幼龟就出现了。他们于周日被送回亨廷顿海滩，也是在凌晨的黑暗掩护下。声明称，所有被释放的幼体都已进入水中。

paras.en: Olive ridley turtles are among the smallest sea turtles in the world, growing to approximately two feet long and weighing between 70 to 100 pounds.
paras.zh: 丽龟是世界上最小的海龟之一，长约 2 英尺，重 70 至 100 磅。

paras.en: Olive ridleys are some of the most abundant and widespread sea turtles in the world. Unfortunately, all their populations are considered threatened or endangered. The species is mostly found in the tropical regions of the Pacific, Indian and Atlantic oceans, and experts still don’t know why or how these nests ended up in the contiguous United States.
paras.zh: 丽龟是世界上数量最多、分布最广的海龟之一。不幸的是，它们的所有种群都被认为受到威胁或濒临灭绝。该物种主要分布在太平洋、印度洋和大西洋的热带地区，专家们仍然不知道这些巢穴为什么或如何最终出现在美国本土。

paras.en: “There’s never been a recorded instance of any sea turtle nesting on a California beach,” Jeff Flocken, president and CEO of the Aquarium of the Pacific, told SFGate’s Olivia Harden in September. “Typically, the most north we know of any olive ridley or any sea turtle that nests are in Mexico, so this is quite a bit farther north for them.”
paras.zh: “从来没有海龟在加州海滩筑巢的记录，”太平洋水族馆总裁兼首席执行官 Jeff Flocken 在 9 月份告诉 SFGate 的 Olivia Harden。 “通常情况下，我们所知道的橄榄丽龟或海龟筑巢的最北位置都在墨西哥，所以这对它们来说是更北的地方。”

paras.en: Around that time, Justin Viezbicke, California stranding coordinator for the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, told the Guardian’s Lois Beckett that the mother turtles may have lost their way because of a hurricane. The ongoing “super” El Niño in the Pacific Ocean, which is affecting water temperatures, currents and weather, may also have helped push them to California.
paras.zh: 大约在那个时候，美国国家海洋和大气管理局加州搁浅协调员贾斯汀·维兹比克（Justin Viezbicke）告诉《卫报》的路易斯·贝克特（Lois Beckett），海龟妈妈可能因为飓风而迷路了。太平洋上正在发生的“超级”厄尔尼诺现象正在影响水温、海流和天气，也可能促使它们来到加利福尼亚州。

paras.en: However, biologist Jonathan Snyder, of the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, has a more hopeful outlook. “I think the warm waters along the coast are certainly part of the story, but I think there’s another really important part of the story,” he said during the press conference.
paras.zh: 然而，美国鱼类和野生动物管理局的生物学家乔纳森·斯奈德的前景更为乐观。 “我认为沿海的温暖水域肯定是故事的一部分，但我认为故事还有另一个非常重要的部分，”他在新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: Decades of sea turtle conservation efforts have “really moved the needle” for olive ridleys, he noted. “Their populations have increased substantially throughout the portions of the range, and it’s the reason that there are these sea turtles along our coast that could take advantage of these unique environmental conditions.”
paras.zh: 他指出，几十年来的海龟保护工作已经“真正改变了”橄榄龟的状况。 “在整个范围内，它们的数量大幅增加，这就是我们沿海的这些海龟可以利用这些独特的环境条件的原因。”

paras.en: In fact, authorities found a third nest farther north in California’s Ventura County on November 1, but it was destroyed by high tides, Snyder tells the Los Angeles Times’ Corinne Purtill. Regardless, experts still aren’t sure whether the recent nests will continue to represent an unusual event or they are the start of a new normal.
paras.zh: 事实上，当局于 11 月 1 日在加利福尼亚州文图拉县更北的地方发现了第三个巢穴，但它被涨潮摧毁了，斯奈德告诉《洛杉矶时报》的科琳·普尔蒂尔。无论如何，专家们仍然不确定最近的巢穴是否会继续代表不寻常的事件，还是新常态的开始。

articles.title: The Bloomsbury Group's Vanessa Bell and Duncan Grant Tangled Their Art and Lives Together for Decades. A Final Sketch of Bell on Her Deathbed Just Resurfaced After 60 Years

paras.en: The lives of artists Duncan Grant and Vanessa Bell—collaborators, companions and sometimes lovers—were deeply intertwined both on canvases and in private quarters.
paras.zh: 艺术家邓肯·格兰特和凡妮莎·贝尔——合作者、同伴，有时甚至是恋人——的生活在画布上和私人空间中都深深地交织在一起。

paras.en: The pair were central figures in the Bloomsbury Group, a circle of artists and intellectuals active in early 20th-century Britain who radically, and often controversially, challenged contemporary creative and social norms. These included public sentiments on philosophy, sexuality and mental illness. The group featured, among others, the economist John Maynard Keynes, as well as the writers E. M. Forster and Virginia Woolf, Bell’s biological sister.
paras.zh: 两人都是布鲁姆斯伯里集团的核心人物，该集团是一个活跃在 20 世纪早期英国的艺术家和知识分子圈子，他们激进且常常引起争议地挑战当代创意和社会规范。其中包括公众对哲学、性和精神疾病的看法。该团体的成员包括经济学家约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯、作家 E·M·福斯特和贝尔的亲妹妹弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫。

paras.en: Grant and Bell were often the subjects of each other’s work. Among their most well-known collaborations is one of Grant’s first and most extravagant depictions of Bell, a full-length portrait painted in 1915.
paras.zh: 格兰特和贝尔经常成为彼此作品的主题。他们最著名的合作作品之一是格兰特在 1915 年绘制的一幅全身肖像画，这是格兰特首次也是最夸张地描绘了贝尔。

paras.en: But this summer, while preparing for “Vanessa Bell & Duncan Grant: Inside Bloomsbury,” an exhibition that opened this week at Tate Britain, scholars discovered an intimate, previously unknown work that sheds new light on the end of Grant and Bell’s relationship.
paras.zh: 但今年夏天，在准备本周在英国泰特美术馆开幕的“凡妮莎·贝尔和邓肯·格兰特：布鲁姆斯伯里内部”展览时，学者们发现了一件亲密的、以前不为人知的作品，为格兰特和贝尔关系的终结提供了新的线索。

paras.en: Hidden for some 60 years among private family papers, the newly recovered drawing is thought to be Grant’s final depiction of Bell. Created in an uncharacteristically simple style—soft monochrome pencil and biro on paper—the piece shows an ailing Bell with her eyes closed, head resting on a pillow, from the perspective of an artist who likely was sitting at her bedside. In the bottom right-hand corner, Grant dated the piece April 14, 1961—one week after Bell succumbed to an illness at the age of 81, and two days after her burial.
paras.zh: 这幅新发现的图画在私人家庭文件中隐藏了大约 60 年，被认为是格兰特对贝尔的最后描绘。这件作品以一种异常简单的风格创作——柔软的单色铅笔和圆珠笔在纸上——从一位可能坐在她床边的艺术家的角度展示了一个生病的贝尔闭着眼睛，头靠在枕头上的样子。在右下角，格兰特在这幅作品上注明了 1961 年 4 月 14 日的日期——贝尔 81 岁因病去世一周后，也是她下葬两天后。

paras.en: “I found this drawing deeply moving when I first saw it. We know Duncan’s drawings of Vanessa so intimately, made over the course of their long friendship, that the discovery of a previously unknown work is remarkable in itself,” Nathaniel Hepburn, director of Charleston, the pair’s former home and studio in East Sussex, says in a statement. “But there is something incredibly poignant about imagining Duncan sitting beside Vanessa, drawing her after her death.”
paras.zh: “当我第一次看到这幅画时，我感到深深的感动。我们非常熟悉邓肯在他们长期友谊的过程中为凡妮莎画的画，因此发现一件以前不为人知的作品本身就是一件了不起的事情，”查尔斯顿（查尔斯顿是两人在东萨塞克斯的故居和工作室）的主任纳撒尼尔·赫本在一份声明中说。 “但是想象邓肯坐在瓦妮莎身边，在她死后描绘她，有一种令人难以置信的辛酸。”

paras.en: The drawing is considered an emotional bookend to the pair’s decades-long relationship. In a 1937 letter to her son, Bell described Grant as “so incredibly full of charm, his genius as an artist seems to overflow so into his life and character & he is so amusing too and odd and unaccountable that lots of people I think don’t see clearly what to me is really his most adorable quality—his honesty…”
paras.zh: 这幅画被认为是两人长达数十年关系的情感书挡。在 1937 年写给儿子的一封信中，贝尔将格兰特描述为“令人难以置信地充满魅力，他作为艺术家的天才似乎渗透到了他的生活和性格中，他也很有趣、奇怪和不负责任，以至于我认为很多人都不清楚对我来说真正最可爱的品质是什么——他的诚实……”

paras.en: Scholars believe that Grant may have erred slightly, perhaps affected by grief, in his dating of the drawing.
paras.zh: 学者们认为，格兰特在绘制这幅画的年代时可能犯了一些小错误，也许是受到悲伤的影响。

paras.en: “What seems very likely here is that Duncan knew this drawing had been made around Vanessa’s death and later added a date from memory,” Darren Clarke, head of collections and research at Charleston, says in the statement. “He got remarkably close, but apparently not quite close enough. Everything about the drawing itself—its viewpoint, its intimacy and its extraordinary economy—suggests someone sitting quietly beside Vanessa’s bed and drawing the face he had known for half a century.”
paras.zh: 查尔斯顿收藏和研究主管达伦·克拉克在声明中表示：“邓肯很可能知道这幅画是在瓦妮莎去世前后绘制的，后来根据记忆添加了日期。” “他非常接近，但显然还不够接近。这幅画本身的一切——它的观点、它的亲密感和它非凡的经济——都表明有人静静地坐在瓦妮莎的床边，画着他认识了半个世纪的脸。”

paras.en: Though it won’t feature in the new Tate show, the drawing will enter into a permanent collection at Charleston as part of the institution’s “50 for 50” campaign, which seeks to secure 50 more works by prominent Bloomsbury Group figures by 2030. In May 2027, after the completion of renovations, it will be put on display for the very first time.
paras.zh: 虽然这幅画不会出现在泰特美术馆新的展览中，但它将成为查尔斯顿的永久收藏，作为该机构“50 for 50”活动的一部分，该活动旨在到 2030 年之前再收藏 50 件布鲁姆斯伯里集团著名人物的作品。 2027 年 5 月，翻修完成后，它将首次展出。

paras.en: Bell had a daughter, Angelica, with Grant in 1918. Bell raised Angelica as the daughter of Clive Bell, her husband, and did not reveal Angelica’s true father until she turned 18.
paras.zh: 贝尔于 1918 年与格兰特育有一女安吉丽卡。贝尔将安吉丽卡当作丈夫克莱夫·贝尔的女儿抚养长大，直到安吉丽卡 18 岁那年才透露她的真实父亲。

paras.en: At the Tate exhibition, which opened last week and runs through April, some 300 portraits, still lives, landscape paintings and other works guide visitors through the intertwined lives of Grant and Bell, as well as their involvement with the Bloomsbury Group.
paras.zh: 泰特美术馆于上周开幕并持续到 4 月，展览中约有 300 幅肖像画、静物画、风景画和其他作品引导参观者了解格兰特和贝尔交织的生活，以及他们与布鲁姆斯伯里集团的关系。

paras.en: “It’s so fascinating to see the ways they differ,” Thomas Kennedy, curator of Modern British art at Tate Britain, tells the Art Newspaper’s Andrew Pulver. “We should recognize their individual accomplishments of course, but also the works they made together and how they influenced each other.”
paras.zh: “看到它们的不同之处真是令人着迷，”泰特英国现代艺术馆馆长托马斯·肯尼迪告诉《艺术报》的安德鲁·普尔弗。 “我们当然应该认识到他们的个人成就，但也应该认识到他们共同创作的作品以及他们如何相互影响。”

paras.en: “Vanessa Bell & Duncan Grant: Inside Bloomsbury” is on view at Tate Britain in London until April 11, 2027.
paras.zh: “凡妮莎·贝尔与邓肯·格兰特：布鲁姆斯伯里内部”将于 2027 年 4 月 11 日在伦敦泰特英国美术馆展出。

articles.title: The iPhone Duo Is Getting a Limited Version of Face ID
articles.author: Julian Chokkattu

paras.en: Apple's most expensive smartphone—the iPhone Duo—lacks one of the company's hallmark features: Face ID. The folding phone is already jam-packed with a hinge and multiple display layers, leaving no room for the TrueDepth sensor required for biometric face authentication. The Duo relies on Touch ID instead.
paras.zh: 苹果最昂贵的智能手机 iPhone Duo 缺乏该公司的标志性功能之一：Face ID。这款折叠手机已经挤满了铰链和多个显示层，没有为生物识别面部认证所需的 TrueDepth 传感器留下空间。 Duo 则依赖 Touch ID。

paras.en: That's changing now in a software update. On Monday, Apple announced that it's bringing facial recognition to the iPhone Duo as part of the iOS 27.3 update. But since it can't rely on the tried-and-true Face ID system without those crucial components, it's borrowing the feature from the company's recently launched smart display, the HomeView.
paras.zh: 现在软件更新正在改变这种情况。周一，苹果宣布将在 iOS 27.3 更新中为 iPhone Duo 带来面部识别功能。但由于没有这些关键组件，它就无法依赖经过验证的 Face ID 系统，因此它借用了该公司最近推出的智能显示器 HomeView 的功能。

paras.en: The HomeView personalizes the display content for up to six people in a household, with its camera recognizing people who step in front of it (it also uses voice data for recognition when someone asks Siri a command). This “person recognition” technology is protected by the Secure Exclave—different from the Secure Enclave chip that houses Face ID data—a memory-protected space in Apple's A20 Pro processor. As WIRED's Lily Hay Newman writes, it's still not as comprehensive as Face ID, and could be more susceptible to attacks.
paras.zh: HomeView 可以为家庭中最多 6 人个性化显示内容，其摄像头可以识别走在它前面的人（当有人向 Siri 发出命令时，它还会使用语音数据进行识别）。这种“人员识别”技术受到 Secure Exclave 的保护，与保存 Face ID 数据的 Secure Enclave 芯片不同，后者是 Apple A20 Pro 处理器中受内存保护的空间。正如《连线》杂志的 Lily Hay Newman 所写，它仍然不如 Face ID 全面，并且可能更容易受到攻击。

paras.en: Rumors abound that Apple is racing to add proper Face ID to the second-generation iPhone Duo. Still, tight development cycles might mean the feature may not arrive until the third generation in 2028. That also points to limitations in the Duo's new facial recognition tech.
paras.zh: 有传言称，苹果正在竞相为第二代 iPhone Duo 添加合适的 Face ID。尽管如此，紧张的开发周期可能意味着该功能可能要到 2028 年第三代才会推出。这也表明了 Duo 新面部识别技术的局限性。

paras.en: You cannot use it to authenticate payments or unlock sensitive content, like your banking app. You'll still need your thumbprint or passcode to approve Apple Wallet purchases. Instead, it's designed to unlock the foldable without tapping a finger on the Touch ID sensor. There is also a time-based limitation. For face recognition to work, it needs a recent Touch ID or passcode authentication within a 45-minute window. This capability is also restricted to the front screen and camera—it doesn't work if the iPhone Duo is unfolded. Also in iOS 27.3, Apple has a new toggle that lets you lock your iPhone Duo when you close it.
paras.zh: 您无法使用它来验证付款或解锁敏感内容，例如您的银行应用程序。您仍然需要指纹或密码来批准 Apple Wallet 购买。相反，它的设计目的是无需用手指敲击 Touch ID 传感器即可解锁可折叠设备。还有一个基于时间的限制。为了使人脸识别发挥作用，需要在 45 分钟内进行最近的 Touch ID 或密码身份验证。此功能也仅限于前屏幕和摄像头 - 如果 iPhone Duo 展开，则该功能不起作用。同样在 iOS 27.3 中，Apple 还提供了一个新的开关，可让您在关闭 iPhone Duo 时锁定它。

paras.en: Google's newer Pixel folding phones are the only ones on the US market with secure facial authentication, though it's not as effective in the dark as Apple's Face ID. Samsung's facial biometrics on its Galaxy phones aren't strong enough to protect sensitive content and are largely used to unlock the device.
paras.zh: 谷歌较新的 Pixel 折叠手机是美国市场上唯一一款具有安全面部识别功能的手机，尽管它在黑暗中不如苹果的 Face ID 有效。三星 Galaxy 手机上的面部生物识别技术不够强大，无法保护敏感内容，并且主要用于解锁设备。

paras.en: Apple’s willingness to roll out a watered-down version of Face ID is a rare compromise for the company—and shows just how much of a friction point Touch ID has become for Duo owners.
paras.zh: 苹果愿意推出 Face ID 的淡化版本，对于该公司来说是一种罕见的妥协，这表明 Touch ID 对于 Duo 用户来说已经成为了多么大的摩擦点。

articles.title: Best Early Black Friday Espresso Machine Deals (2026)
articles.author: Kat Merck

paras.en: Thanksgiving is coming, and so, possibly, is an audience. If you want to show your in-laws you know how to entertain in style with a postprandial espresso or cappuccino, don’t be fiddling with steam wands and the owner’s manual while Uncle Bob stands nearby and offers his opinions (at full volume).
paras.zh: 感恩节即将到来，观众也可能随之而来。如果您想向您的姻亲展示您知道如何用餐后浓缩咖啡或卡布奇诺来招待您，请不要在鲍勃叔叔站在附近（以最大音量）提供他的意见时摆弄蒸汽棒和用户手册。

paras.en: Luckily, there are plenty of early Black Friday espresso machine deals happening right now. If you take advantage, it will make you look smart both by not paying full price and by knowing how to pull a perfect shot, having had three weeks of practice.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，现在有很多早期的黑色星期五浓缩咖啡机优惠活动正在进行。如果你利用了这一优势，那么你会显得很聪明，因为你不需要支付全价，而且经过三周的练习，你知道如何拍出完美的照片。

paras.en: Each deal below is on a machine a WIRED reviewer has tested—including a Breville that one colleague has used happily for seven years—and personally recommends. For more savings, check out our Best Early Black Friday Deals, as well as early deals at Amazon and Home Depot.
paras.zh: 下面的每笔交易都是在《连线》评论员测试过的机器上进行的，其中包括一位同事已经愉快使用了七年的 Breville 机器，并亲自推荐。如需更多优惠，请查看我们的黑色星期五最佳早期优惠，以及亚马逊和家得宝的早期优惠。

paras.en: Updated November 16: I’ve removed expired deals and added new deals on De’Longhi, Ninja, Nespresso, and Atlas Coffee Club.
paras.zh: 11 月 16 日更新：我删除了 De’Longhi、Ninja、Nespresso 和 Atlas Coffee Club 的过期优惠并添加了新优惠。

paras.en: This sleek, design-oriented semiautomatic (“a steampunk gasworks of a thing,” according to former WIRED reviewer Matthew Korfhage) is quite dramatic in person, and it has a dual boiler—meaning you can froth milk at the same time you’re pulling a shot—and it comes with a nice set of accessories, including a tamper and milk pitcher. Note that this sale is on the 2nd Gen machine, which features expanded grinder settings and a new portafilter.
paras.zh: 这款时尚、以设计为导向的半自动咖啡机（据《连线》前评论员马修·科尔夫哈格称，“蒸汽朋克煤气厂”）本身相当引人注目，它有一个双锅炉——这意味着你可以在拉镜头的同时打奶泡——而且它还配有一套漂亮的配件，包括搅拌棒和牛奶罐。请注意，此次销售的是第二代机器，该机器具有扩展的研磨机设置和新的手柄。

paras.en: Formerly the Linea Classic, De’Longhi’s Classic is the best bare-bones espresso machine we’ve tried, with a pressure gauge, 15-bar pump, and updated thermoblock system. I used one for a full year and, while it’s not as foolproof as a semiautomatic, it was enough for morning espresso shots and cappuccinos, and I even pulled off some rudimentary latte art with its steam wand.
paras.zh: De’Longhi’s Classic 的前身为 Linea Classic，是我们尝试过的最好的浓缩咖啡机，配有压力表、15 巴泵和更新的热块系统。我用了整整一年，虽然它不像半自动的那么万无一失，但它足够早上喝浓缩咖啡和卡布奇诺，我什至用它的蒸汽棒完成了一些基本的拿铁艺术。

paras.en: The Vertuo Pop+ is our favorite pod maker for espresso, and the Deluxe model adds a larger, side-mount water tank (37 ounces to the original’s 25 ounces) and new finishes, including this white one that’s on sale. (There’s also matte black-and-gold and a sort of gunmetal gray, but those are not as heavily discounted.)
paras.zh: Vertuo Pop+ 是我们最喜欢的浓缩咖啡豆荚机，豪华版增加了一个更大的侧装水箱（原来的 25 盎司为 37 盎司）和新的饰面，包括这款正在促销的白色饰面。 （还有哑光黑金和一种青铜灰色，但这些折扣没有那么大。）

paras.en: We appreciated this semiautomatic’s slim profile, consistent shots, and built-in burr grinder. The cold-brew setting is more of a gimmick than a way to make actual cold brew, and some design choices are a little quirky, but it’s a beautiful, industrial-looking machine that takes up only 12 inches of counter space.
paras.zh: 我们欣赏这款半自动手枪的纤薄外形、一致的射击和内置毛刺研磨机。冷萃咖啡设置更多的是一种噱头，而不是真正的冷萃咖啡的制作方法，而且一些设计选择有点古怪，但它是一台漂亮的工业外观机器，仅占用 12 英寸的柜台空间。

paras.en: Ninja sometimes has a reputation for doing too much, but this semiautomatic we liked is a beginner-friendly option that pulls some solid shots. It’s got a built-in grinder and milk frother, the latter of which can make cold foam and even has a setting for plant-based milk. In true Ninja fashion, it also has settings for drip coffee and cold brew, but neither impressed our tester, so I wouldn’t buy it for that alone. (Note the sale is on the “Gunmetal” color only.)
paras.zh: 忍者有时因做得太多而闻名，但我们喜欢的这款半自动是一个适合初学者的选择，可以打出一些稳定的镜头。它有一个内置的研磨机和奶泡器，后者可以制作冷奶泡，甚至还有植物奶的设置。在真正的忍者时尚中，它还具有滴滤咖啡和冷萃咖啡的设置，但这两种设置都没有给我们的测试人员留下深刻的印象，所以我不会单独购买它。 （请注意，促销仅针对“青铜色”颜色。）

paras.en: Maybe you or your recipient already has an espresso machine; in that case, they’ll need some quality beans. Our favorite coffee subscription, Atlas Coffee Club, has a new gift option on offer for Black Friday, which is a quarterly subscription of three bags of unique, globally sourced coffee every three months for $59. You can choose any roast you want, including espresso roast and even Nespresso pods. If you’d rather buy an ongoing subscription for yourself, your first bag is free with Atlas’ Black Friday sale.
paras.zh: 也许您或您的收件人已经拥有一台浓缩咖啡机；在这种情况下，他们需要一些优质的豆子。我们最喜欢的咖啡订阅服务 Atlas Coffee Club 在黑色星期五推出了新的礼品选项，即每三个月订阅三袋独特的全球采购咖啡，价格为 59 美元。您可以选择任何您想要的烘焙方式，包括浓缩咖啡烘焙甚至 Nespresso 咖啡包。如果您想为自己购买持续订阅，您的第一个包可以通过 Atlas 的黑色星期五促销免费获得。

articles.title: The Bank Outage May Have Nothing to Do With Your Bank
articles.author: Andrew Couts, Maddy Varner

paras.en: If you were planning to do any banking today, good luck.
paras.zh: 如果您今天打算办理任何银行业务，祝您好运。

paras.en: Customers of many major financial institutions experienced unspecified technical issues on Monday as thousands of reports flooded the uptime-tracking website Downdetector.com from people saying that they had issues using their banks in some way.
paras.zh: 周一，许多主要金融机构的客户都遇到了未具体说明的技术问题，正常运行时间跟踪网站 DownDetector.com 上充斥着数千份报告，人们称他们在以某种方式使用银行时遇到了问题。

paras.en: It is currently unclear which systems are having issues. However, the problem may stem from technical difficulties at JPMorganChase, the top retail bank that holds over 10 percent of all US deposits, did identify a specific issue.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚哪些系统存在问题。然而，问题可能源于摩根大通的技术困难，摩根大通是一家持有美国全部存款 10% 以上的顶级零售银行，它确实发现了一个具体问题。

paras.en: “JPMorganChase has experienced a temporary issue related to a software bug in on-premise hardware systems—there is no evidence this is cyber-related,” says JPMorganChase spokesperson Pablo Rodriguez. “It is taking longer than usual to service some customers.”
paras.zh: 摩根大通发言人巴勃罗·罗德里格斯 (Pablo Rodriguez) 表示：“摩根大通遇到了与本地硬件系统中的软件错误相关的临时问题，没有证据表明这与网络有关。” “为某些客户提供服务的时间比平时要长。”

paras.en: Rodriguez adds that the bank is not experiencing a “systemic issue” but that “other banks may have been impacted by slowness in transactions only to the extent that they were a party to a transaction with us.” The spokesperson adds that customers “still have access to their accounts and funds” and that the bank is working to resolve the issues.
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯补充说，该银行并未遇到“系统性问题”，但“其他银行可能会受到交易缓慢的影响，但仅限于它们是与我们进行交易的一方。”该发言人补充说，客户“仍然可以访问他们的账户和资金”，银行正在努力解决这些问题。

paras.en: Apparent issues with the banks, credit unions, fintech apps, and credit card companies appear to begin around 9:30 am ET and peaked at around 2 pm ET. Many people also reported issues using Zelle, the peer-to-peer money-transfer system adopted by major banks. However, in a statement, Zelle denied its systems were the cause of the reported outages while acknowledging that issues at banks may impact people’s ability to use Zelle.
paras.zh: 银行、信用合作社、金融科技应用程序和信用卡公司的明显问题似乎开始于美国东部时间上午 9:30 左右，并在美国东部时间下午 2 点左右达到顶峰。许多人还报告了使用 Zelle（各大银行采用的点对点汇款系统）的问题。然而，Zelle 在一份声明中否认其系统是所报告的中断的原因，同时承认银行的问题可能会影响人们使用 Zelle 的能力。

paras.en: “Zelle is not down. Zelle is operating as it should,” a Zelle spokesperson says in a statement. “Consumers use Zelle through participating banks and credit unions, which manage their accounts and hold their funds. Consumers do not have a separate Zelle account, and Zelle does not hold consumer funds.”
paras.zh: “Zelle 并没有倒闭。Zelle 正在按其应有的方式运作，”Zelle 发言人在一份声明中表示。 “消费者通过参与银行和信用合作社使用 Zelle，这些银行和信用社管理他们的账户并持有他们的资金。消费者没有单独的 Zelle 账户，Zelle 也不持有消费者资金。”

paras.en: US Bank spokesperson Jeffrey Shelman also says the financial institution’s systems “are not directly impacted.” Shelman adds, however, that “clients attempting to send or receive Zelle payments with another financial institution may experience transaction delays.”
paras.zh: 美国银行发言人杰弗里谢尔曼也表示，该金融机构的系统“没有直接受到影响”。不过，Shelman 补充道，“尝试与其他金融机构发送或接收 Zelle 付款的客户可能会遇到交易延迟。”

paras.en: Seth Eisen, senior vice president of communications at MasterCard, says, “Our network is operating normally.” A Visa spokesperson says the company is aware of the ongoing payments issue, but that Visa’s systems are operating normally too.
paras.zh: 万事达卡通信高级副总裁 Seth Eisen 表示：“我们的网络运行正常。” Visa 发言人表示，该公司已意识到持续存在的支付问题，但 Visa 的系统也运行正常。

paras.en: According to reports on Downdetector, which is sourced to user reports rather than official statements, the issues on Monday also impacted customers of Bank of America, Capital One, Wells Fargo, TD Bank, Navy Credit Federal Union, and more. These companies did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 根据来自用户报告而不是官方声明的 DownDetector 的报道，周一的问题还影响了美国银行、第一资本、富国银行、道明银行、海军信贷联邦联盟等公司的客户。这些公司没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Eisen, the Mastercard VP, says that DownDetector was “not correct” in the case of his company.
paras.zh: 万事达卡副总裁艾森表示，DownDetector 就其公司而言“不正确”。

paras.en: Whatever the cause, the timing of the issues may as well have been designed to get people looking for broader patterns. Last Thursday, Microsoft 365 experienced an unprecedented 24-hour outage that impacted millions of people, governments, businesses, and other institutions globally. Microsoft executive vice president Charles Lamanna said in a post on X on Monday that the outage, which impacted Outlook, Teams, and many other Microsoft cloud services, was related to an update that started rolling out in July but only began causing problems last week.
paras.zh: 无论原因是什么，问题出现的时机也可能是为了让人们寻找更广泛的模式。上周四，Microsoft 365 经历了前所未有的 24 小时中断，影响了全球数百万人、政府、企业和其他机构。微软执行副总裁查尔斯·拉曼纳 (Charles Lamanna) 周一在 X 上发帖表示，此次中断影响了 Outlook、Teams 和许多其他微软云服务，与 7 月开始推出但上周才开始引发问题的更新有关。

paras.en: Soon after Microsoft resolved its outage on Friday, the Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop order. This time, the issue was related to a problem with Air Traffic Control’s communications systems. “The FAA’s legacy equipment became unstable when data began flooding the FAA FTI network, at a rate of 1,000 connection attempts every 4 to 5 seconds,” the agency wrote in an FAQ explaining the outage. “This disrupted the system and created instability with aircraft communications and radar feeds.”
paras.zh: 微软周五解决了停电问题后不久，美国联邦航空管理局就发布了全国范围内的停飞令。这次的问题与空中交通管制的通信系统问题有关。 “当数据开始以每 4 到 5 秒 1,000 次连接尝试的速度涌入 FAA FTI 网络时，FAA 的旧设备变得不稳定，”该机构在解释此次中断的常见问题解答中写道。 “这扰乱了系统并导致飞机通信和雷达馈送不稳定。”

paras.en: The FAA’s five-hour ground stop resulted in thousands of canceled flights and otherwise disrupted travel for countless travelers. The impact of Monday’s banking outage remains unclear.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局五个小时的地面停留导致数千架航班取消，并扰乱了无数旅客的旅行。周一银行业务中断的影响仍不清楚。

articles.title: The Death of ‘Keep 1.5 Alive’
articles.author: Katrin Bennhold

paras.en: There was a reason, 11 years ago in Paris, that world leaders set themselves a target to keep the global rise in temperatures below 1.5 degrees Celsius compared with preindustrial levels. Beyond that, climate scientists say, warming will dangerously change our way of life.
paras.zh: 11 年前，世界领导人在巴黎为自己设定了将全球气温较工业化前水平上升幅度控制在 1.5 摄氏度以下的目标，这是有原因的。除此之外，气候科学家表示，气候变暖将危险地改变我们的生活方式。

paras.en: We got a taste of it this year, as temperatures rose above the threshold for several months. Heat waves. Wildfires. Flash floods. And with a super El Niño year unfolding, next year might be worse. As one climate expert put it to me: This El Niño will effectively offer a time machine to the 2030s, showing what will happen if we don’t radically cut carbon emissions.
paras.zh: 今年我们尝到了这种滋味，因为气温连续几个月都上升到了阈值以上。热浪。野火。山洪暴发。随着超级厄尔尼诺年的到来，明年的情况可能会更糟。正如一位气候专家对我所说：这次厄尔尼诺现象将有效地为 2030 年代提供一台时间机器，展示如果我们不从根本上减少碳排放将会发生什么。

paras.en: A key climate goal is dead. What happens now?
paras.zh: 一个关键的气候目标已经失效。现在会发生什么？

paras.en: It was the climate movement’s unifying slogan for the past decade: “Keep 1.5 Alive.”
paras.zh: 这是过去十年气候运动的统一口号：“Keep 1.5 Alive”。

paras.en: The tagline referred to the central ambition of the 2015 Paris climate agreement, in which almost every country pledged to try to limit global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius.
paras.zh: 标语提到了 2015 年巴黎气候协议的核心目标，其中几乎每个国家都承诺努力将全球变暖限制在 1.5 摄氏度。

articles.title: Trump’s Asia Trip Will Bring Him to the Table With Xi and Putin: What to Know
articles.author: Lily Kuo

paras.en: President Trump sets off this week for meetings in Asia that will culminate in a summit with two strongmen he has often praised: President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统本周将启程前往亚洲举行会议，最终将与他经常赞扬的两位强人举行峰会：中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京。

paras.en: It will be the first time the three men, who command the world’s largest nuclear arsenals, will have sat down together. Mr. Trump plans to discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world and the war against Iran, according to a White House spokeswoman. He is not expected to bring up Russia’s war with Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这将是这三个掌握着世界上最大核武库的人第一次坐在一起。白宫发言人表示，特朗普计划讨论世界范围内削减核武器和针对伊朗的战争。预计他不会提及俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: Mr. Trump will travel first to Manila, then to southern China, and will meet with regional leaders confronting an array of uncertainties. Those include the course of the war between the United States and Iran, high energy prices and mounting concern over the risks of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 特朗普将首先前往马尼拉，然后前往中国南部，并将与面临一系列不确定因素的地区领导人会面。其中包括美国和伊朗之间的战争进程、高能源价格以及对人工智能风险日益增长的担忧。

paras.en: For Mr. Trump, the trip will be a pivot to foreign policy and relationships after American voters delivered a swift rebuke to his party in the midterm elections. His trip also comes as his administration faces scrutiny over a scandal involving the former chief executive of Nvidia, the tech giant, which has raised questions about Chinese espionage and American tech exports.
paras.zh: 对特朗普来说，在美国选民在中期选举中迅速谴责特朗普的政党之后，此行将成为外交政策和关系的一个支点。他此行之际，他的政府因涉及科技巨头英伟达前首席执行官的丑闻而面临审查，该丑闻引发了对中国间谍活动和美国科技出口的质疑。

paras.en: The highlight of Mr. Trump’s trip is expected to be his meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin on Thursday in China.
paras.zh: 特朗普此行的亮点预计将是周四在中国与习近平和普京的会面。

paras.en: The prospect of their summit has drawn comparisons to the 1945 conference in the Crimean city of Yalta, where the leaders of the United States, the Soviet Union and Britain met to decide the shape of postwar Europe.
paras.zh: 人们将这次峰会的前景与 1945 年在克里米亚城市雅尔塔举行的会议进行了比较，当时美国、苏联和英国的领导人在这次会议上决定了战后欧洲的形态。

articles.title: 10 Numbers That Might Change How You See Asia
articles.author: Damien Cave

paras.en: President Trump’s trip to Asia this week will largely be seen as a test of American power in the main region where the United States and China compete for influence.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统本周的亚洲之行将在很大程度上被视为对美国在美国和中国争夺影响力的主要地区的实力的考验。

paras.en: His meetings in Manila and Shenzhen, China, will be scrutinized for shifts on trade and security. Deals he might strike with Beijing — plus a gathering with President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia — will put the world’s great-power contest on display, as all three seek to show strength.
paras.zh: 他在马尼拉和中国深圳举行的会议将受到密切关注，以了解贸易和安全方面的变化。他可能与北京达成的协议，加上与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京的会面，将使世界大国的竞争得以展现，因为这三个国家都在寻求展示实力。

paras.en: But Asia is not just a theater of competition. Many countries in the region have become wealthier, more technologically advanced and increasingly interconnected. Especially now, as China’s military becomes more threatening and the United States less reliable, they are hedging against greatness and relying more on neighbors.
paras.zh: 但亚洲不仅仅是竞争的舞台。该地区许多国家变得更加富裕、技术更加先进、相互联系日益紧密。尤其是现在，随着中国的军事威胁越来越大，美国越来越不可靠，他们正在对冲大国，更多地依赖邻国。

paras.en: Asian students and workers are moving to neighboring states. Countries with expanding defense industries are selling weapons to new partners. Nations that compete for high-tech investment are even making plans to cooperate on energy and cybersecurity.
paras.zh: 亚洲学生和工人正在迁移到邻国。国防工业不断扩张的国家正在向新伙伴出售武器。争夺高科技投资的国家甚至正在制定能源和网络安全合作计划。

paras.en: “They’re all looking at what more they can do together when the great powers are behaving so badly,” said Ted Osius, a former U.S. ambassador to Vietnam and adjunct professor of geopolitics at Fulbright University in Ho Chi Minh City. “If you’re a middle power, you’re thinking ‘I need more options.’”
paras.zh: 美国前驻越南大使、胡志明市富布赖特大学地缘政治学兼职教授特德·奥修斯表示：“当大国表现如此恶劣时，他们都在考虑可以共同做些什么。” “如果你是中等强国，你会想‘我需要更多选择。’”

paras.en: Here are a few numbers that provide a sense of what the region contributes to the global economy, and how its nations are becoming more bound together to shape the world.
paras.zh: 以下一些数字可以让我们了解该地区对全球经济的贡献，以及该地区各国如何更加紧密地联系在一起来塑造世界。

articles.title: Leon Bridges Lands Fourth Adult Alternative Airplay No. 1 With ‘Talk It Over’
articles.author: Xander Zellner

paras.en: Leon Bridges scores his fourth leader on Billboard’s Adult Alternative Airplay chart as “Talk It Over” rises 2-1 on the Nov. 21-dated ranking.
paras.zh: 莱昂·布里奇斯 (Leon Bridges) 在公告牌成人另类音乐播放排行榜上第四次领先，《Talk It Over》在 11 月 21 日的排名中以 2-1 上升。

paras.en: The track rises to the summit with a 10% increase in plays at the format during the Nov. 6-12 tracking week, according to Luminate.
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，在 11 月 6 日至 12 日的追踪周期间，该赛道的播放量增加了 10%，达到了顶峰。

paras.en: “Talk It Over” is Bridges’ first leader since “Peaceful Place” in October 2024. Before that, he led with “Bad Bad News” in 2018 and “Smooth Sailin’ ” in 2016.
paras.zh: 《Talk It Over》是 Bridges 自 2024 年 10 月的《Peaceful Place》以来的第一位领唱。在此之前，他曾以 2018 年的《Bad Bad News》和 2016 年的《Smooth Sailin’》领唱。

paras.en: When “Talk It Over” debuted in September, it became Bridges’ 19th career entry at the format. That’s the fifth-most among soloists in the chart’s 30-year history, behind only Jack Johnson (27), Sheryl Crow, John Mayer (26 each) and Beck (21). Among all acts, Dave Matthews Band (including his solo entries) and U2 share the record, with 36 each.
paras.zh: 当《Talk It Over》于 9 月首次亮相时，它成为 Bridges 职业生涯中第 19 个参赛作品。在该榜单 30 年历史中，这一数字在独奏家中排名第五，仅次于杰克·约翰逊（27 岁）、谢丽尔·克劳、约翰·梅尔（各 26 岁）和贝克（21 岁）。在所有艺人中，戴夫·马修斯乐队（包括他的独奏作品）和 U2 并列第一，各有 36 首。

paras.en: Bridges released “Talk It Over” in August on the second of three four-song EPs that previewed his fifth studio album, Happiness Anytime. The full 12-track set arrived Sept. 25 via LisaSawyer63/Columbia Records. Produced by J Lloyd-Watson and Lydia Kitto of the British group Jungle, it reached No. 12 on the Top R&B Albums chart and No. 74 on the Billboard 200.
paras.zh: Bridges 于八月发行了三张四首 EP 中的第二张《Talk It Over》，预览了他的第五张录音室专辑《Happiness Anytime》。完整的 12 首曲目于 9 月 25 日通过 LisaSawyer63/Columbia Records 抵达。该专辑由英国组合 Jungle 的 J Lloyd-Watson 和 Lydia Kitto 制作，在最佳 R&B 专辑排行榜上排名第 12 位，在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第 74 位。

paras.en: “Talk It Over” is also the first Adult Alternative Airplay No. 1 for Columbia Records since Hozier’s “Nobody’s Soldier” in November 2024. While the label boasts 14 No. 1s at the format this decade, it leads the list and Billboard’s Alternative Airplay chart simultaneously for the first time in two decades, as Dominic Fike’s “Babydoll” (released via Sandy Boys/Columbia/Legacy) jumps 3-1 on the latter. Columbia last ruled the charts together in April 2004, when John Mayer’s “Clarity” topped Adult Alternative Airplay and Lostprophets’ “Last Train Home” led Alternative Airplay. Before that, for Columbia, Primitive Radio Gods’ “Standing Outside a Broken Phone Booth With Money in My Hand” led both lists at the same time in July 1996.
paras.zh: 《Talk It Over》也是哥伦比亚唱片公司自 2024 年 11 月 Hozier 的《Nobody's Soldier》以来第一首在成人另类音乐播放榜上排名第一的歌曲。虽然该唱片公司在这十年中在该格式中获得了 14 次第一名，但随着 Dominic Fike 的《Babydoll》（通过 Sandy Boys/Columbia/Legacy 发行）的跃升，它在二十年来首次同时领先于榜单和 Billboard 的另类音乐播放榜。后者3-1。哥伦比亚上一次同时统治排行榜是在 2004 年 4 月，当时约翰·梅尔 (John Mayer) 的《Clarity》在 Adult Alternative Airplay 排行榜上名列前茅，而 Lostprophets 的《Last Train Home》则在 Alternative Airplay 排行榜上名列前茅。在此之前，哥伦比亚唱片公司 Primitive Radio Gods 的《站在破电话亭外，手里拿着钱》在 1996 年 7 月同时位居两项榜单之首。

articles.title: Cole Swindell Signs With Make Wake Artists for Management
articles.author: Jessica Nicholson

paras.en: Cole Swindell has signed with Nashville-based artist management company Make Wake Artists, which also reps Luke Combs.
paras.zh: 科尔·斯温德尔 (Cole Swindell) 与总部位于纳什维尔的艺术家管理公司 Make Wake Artists 签约，该公司也是卢克·库姆斯 (Luke Combs) 的代表。

paras.en: Swindell will be managed by Make Wake founder and chief navigation officer Chris Kappy and partners Dylan Wright and Michael Gonzales. Make Wake, which launched in 2015, also represents artists Jon Bellion, Flatland Cavalry, Stella Lefty and Muscadine Bloodline.
paras.zh: 斯温德尔将由 Make Wake 创始人兼首席导航官 Chris Kappy 以及合伙人 Dylan Wright 和 Michael Gonzales 管理。 Make Wake 于 2015 年推出，还代理艺术家 Jon Bellion、Flatland Cavalry、Stella Lefty 和 Muscadine Bloodline。

paras.en: Swindell has earned eight No. 1 hits on Billboard‘s Country Airplay chart to date. In 2023, he took home a trio of ACM Awards wins, including single of year and song of the year (as songwriter and artist), for his four-week Country Airplay No. 1 “She Had Me at Heads Carolina.”
paras.zh: 迄今为止，斯温德尔已经八次登上公告牌乡村音乐播放榜第一名。 2023 年，他凭借为期四周的乡村音乐节目《She Had Me at Heads Carolina》获得了三项 ACM 奖，包括年度单曲奖和年度歌曲奖（作为词曲作者和艺术家）。

paras.en: In 2027, Swindell will serve as support on Morgan Wallen‘s Last Time I Checked Tour. He’ll also perform at C2C: Country to Country in March and Wallen’s Sand in My Boots Festival in May.
paras.zh: 2027 年，斯温德尔将担任 Morgan Wallen 的 Last Time I Checked 巡演的支持人员。他还将在 3 月份的 C2C：Country to Country 和 5 月份的 Wallen's Sand in My Boots Festival 音乐节上表演。
