articles.title: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
articles.author: Mithil Aggarwal

paras.en: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter.
paras.zh: 香港——英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 陷入中国间谍丑闻的核心科技公司 Megaspeed 周四表示，将配合美国政府对此事的调查。

paras.en: Megaspeed’s statement came hours before the resignation of Huang, one of the leaders of the AI boom, who co-founded the American chipmaker and helped build it into the world’s second most valuable company.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 的声明是在黄仁勋辞职前几个小时发表的。黄仁勋是人工智能热潮的领导者之一，他是这家美国芯片制造商的联合创始人，并帮助其成为全球第二大最有价值的公司。

paras.en: In its first statement since reports emerged about Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the future of the tech giant, Megaspeed said that it takes its obligation to comply with U.S. export control laws “extremely seriously.”
paras.zh: 自有关黄与一名涉嫌中国间谍的婚外情的报道曝光以来，Megaspeed 首次发表声明，引发了人们对美国国家安全和这家科技巨头未来的担忧。Megaspeed 表示，公司“极其严肃”地履行遵守美国出口管制法的义务。

paras.en: U.S. intelligence agencies determined that Alice Huang had an affair with the Nvidia CEO and was a Chinese intelligence operative, a person with knowledge of the matter told NBC News on Sunday.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士周日告诉 NBC 新闻，美国情报机构确定爱丽丝·黄与英伟达首席执行官有染，并且是一名中国情报人员。

paras.en: She held a senior position at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that was one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. Megaspeed is under U.S. criminal investigation for allegedly smuggling American-made chips into China in defiance of U.S. export controls.
paras.zh: 她曾在新加坡公司 Megaspeed 担任高级职位，该公司是 Nvidia 在东南亚最大的客户之一。 Megaspeed 因涉嫌违反美国出口管制，将美国制造的芯片走私到中国而受到美国刑事调查。

paras.en: A criminal investigation is ongoing in Singapore, where officials said Thursday Alice Huang had been barred from re-entering the country. The government also issued her with a stern warning after finding that she had knowingly provided police with inaccurate information to downplay her role in the company. It said that Huang was not investigated for espionage.
paras.zh: 新加坡正在进行一项刑事调查，官员周四表示，爱丽丝·黄已被禁止再次入境该国。在发现她故意向警方提供不准确信息以淡化她在公司中的角色后，政府还向她发出了严厉警告。据称，黄没有因间谍罪受到调查。

paras.en: The country’s Ministry of Home Affairs said in a statement that authorities had interviewed Huang and impounded her passport in 2025, but that its requests for cooperation from U.S. authorities had gone unanswered.
paras.zh: 该国内政部在一份声明中表示，当局已约谈了黄女士，并于 2025 年扣押了她的护照，但其向美国当局提出的合作请求却没有得到答复。

paras.en: “Despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance in respect of the company,” it said.
paras.zh: “尽管一再提出要求，新加坡迄今为止收到的有关该公司的信息或援助有限，”它说。

paras.en: Investigators concluded in February that there was “insufficient evidence to establish that Huang had committed any offences,” the statement said, adding that investigations into Megaspeed and six other individuals were continuing, related to the shipment of servers via Singapore.
paras.zh: 声明称，调查人员在 2 月份得出结论，“没有足够的证据证明黄犯有任何罪行”，并补充说，对 Megaspeed 和其他六人的调查仍在继续，涉及通过新加坡运输服务器的问题。

paras.en: Megaspeed, meanwhile, said in the statement Thursday that it has “cooperated with inspections by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and stands ready to cooperate fully with any other relevant U.S. government authority.” The statement was signed by its chairman and CEO, Tan Yong Pong, who also goes by James Tan.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Megaspeed 在周四的声明中表示，它“已配合美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 的检查，并准备与任何其他相关美国政府机构充分合作。”该声明由其董事长兼首席执行官陈永邦（又名詹姆斯·陈）签署。

paras.en: It said that “Megaspeed is committed to working constructively and transparently with the U.S. government.”
paras.zh: 声明称，“Megaspeed 致力于与美国政府进行建设性且透明的合作。”

paras.en: China has dismissed the spying allegations as “smears.” On Thursday, a Foreign Ministry spokesperson said that “the U.S. side should stop fabricating so-called espionage narratives as a pretext for implementing technological blockades.”
paras.zh: 中国驳斥了这些间谍指控，称其为“诽谤”。周四，外交部发言人表示，“美方应停止编造所谓间谍言论，以此作为实施技术封锁的借口。”

paras.en: Megaspeed did not address the allegations surrounding Alice Huang, but said that “to further reinforce our commitment to compliance, Megaspeed has retained a leading U.S. law firm to lead a comprehensive census of its graphics processing units (GPUs) and independently verify its export control compliance practices.”
paras.zh: Megaspeed 没有回应围绕 Alice Huang 的指控，但表示“为了进一步加强我们对合规的承诺，Megaspeed 聘请了一家领先的美国律师事务所来牵头对其图形处理单元 (GPU) 进行全面普查，并独立验证其出口管制合规做法。”

paras.en: The company added that it “welcomes appropriate government scrutiny and is committed to demonstrating through concrete actions that it operates responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable U.S. laws.”
paras.zh: 该公司补充说，它“欢迎政府适当的审查，并致力于通过具体行动证明其运营负责任、透明且符合适用的美国法律。”

paras.en: Nvidia’s stock price has plunged since its 63-year-old chief admitted over the weekend to being “unfaithful” to his wife.
paras.zh: 自从 Nvidia 63 岁的首席执行官周末承认对妻子“不忠”以来，该公司的股价已经暴跌。

paras.en: Huang quit on Thursday in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships. In a statement, Nvidia named its executive vice president and chief financial officer Colette Kress as its interim CEO.
paras.zh: 在有报道称黄仁勋有多段婚外关系后，他于周四辞职。Nvidia 在一份声明中宣布，任命其执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 为临时首席执行官。

paras.en: Nvidia’s board met Wednesday night to address Huang’s future at the company, a source familiar with the matter told NBC News, adding that the White House was aware of the meeting.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士告诉 NBC 新闻，英伟达董事会于周三晚间召开会议，讨论黄仁勋在公司的未来，并补充说白宫已知晓此次会议。

paras.en: The scandal has raised questions about how much U.S. government officials knew about Alice Huang and Megaspeed.
paras.zh: 这起丑闻引发了人们对美国政府官员对黄静和Megaspeed了解多少的质疑。

paras.en: In the spring, Secretary of State Marco Rubio circulated a memo to officials in the Trump administration outlining how U.S. intelligence showed that the Nvidia CEO was in a romantic relationship with a business executive who was an asset of China’s spy service, according to a person familiar with Nvidia and a former national security official with knowledge of the matter. The New York Times and the Financial Times first reported on this memo.
paras.zh: 据一位熟悉英伟达的人士和一位知情的前国家安全官员透露，今年春天，国务卿马可·鲁比奥向特朗普政府官员分发了一份备忘录，概述了美国情报机构如何显示英伟达首席执行官与一名属于中国间谍机构的企业高管之间的恋爱关系。 《纽约时报》和《金融时报》首先报道了这份备忘录。

paras.en: Alice Huang’s precise role and relationship with China’s spy service remain unclear, however. It’s possible she was not a career spy for China’s spy agency, the Ministry of State Security, but was asked to cooperate and share information based on her access to Huang, a former national security official with knowledge of the matter told NBC News.
paras.zh: 然而，黄爱丽的确切角色以及与中国间谍部门的关系仍不清楚。一位知情的前国家安全官员告诉 NBC 新闻，她可能不是中国间谍机构国家安全部的职业间谍，但由于她与黄的接触，被要求合作并分享信息。

paras.en: Rep. Jim Himes, D-Conn., ranking Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, told NPR that Alice Huang’s role still needed to be clarified.
paras.zh: 众议院情报委员会资深民主党人、康涅狄格州众议员吉姆·希姆斯 (Jim Himes) 告诉 NPR，爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的角色仍需要澄清。

paras.en: Democrats will soon hold control of both the House and the Senate and, as a result, will have subpoena power.
paras.zh: 民主党很快将控制众议院和参议院，因此将拥有传票权。

paras.en: On Wednesday night, as the Nvidia board met, Sens. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., and Chris Coons, D-Del., announced they had written to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick with a request to preserve records on the subject.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，在英伟达董事会召开会议时，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 和特拉华州民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯 (Chris Coons) 宣布，他们已致函商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)，请求保存有关该主题的记录。

articles.title: Highlights from Pope Leo’s historic, 12-day tour of South America
articles.author: Max Butterworth

paras.en: LIMA, Peru — They turned out in the millions to greet Pope Leo as he made his way around Uruguay, Argentina and Peru on a grueling 12-day tour of the South American nations, weeks after undergoing surgery for lung cancer.
paras.zh: 秘鲁利马——教皇利奥在接受肺癌手术几周后，开始了为期 12 天的艰苦南美国家之旅，途经乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁，数百万人前来迎接。

paras.en: Pope keeps energetic pace in trip to South America after surgery
paras.zh: 教皇手术后南美之行保持活力

paras.en: For some — particularly those in Argentina, which had not received a papal visit since Pope John Paul II in 1987 — it was the first time they would get to see a pontiff in person. A record 2.5 million people flooded onto the streets of Buenos Aires last week to try and catch a glimpse of Leo.
paras.zh: 对于一些人来说——尤其是阿根廷人，自 1987 年教皇约翰·保罗二世以来，阿根廷从未接受过教皇的访问——这是他们第一次亲自见到教皇。上周，创纪录的 250 万人涌上布宜诺斯艾利斯街头，试图一睹利奥的风采。

paras.en: The Vatican dubbed it a “homecoming” tour for the 71-year-old, as the Chicago-born pontiff, who is also a citizen of Peru, spent the final six days in the country where he lived for decades and served as a bishop until 2023.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈称这是这位71岁老人的“返乡”之旅，因为这位出生于芝加哥、也是秘鲁公民的教宗在他居住了数十年的国家度过了最后六天，并担任主教直至2023年。

paras.en: NBC News takes a look at some of the highlights from his trip.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻报道了他此行的一些亮点。

paras.en: After a 17-hour flight from Rome, Leo and his entourage touched down in Uruguay’s capital, Montevideo. Praising the Lord and thanking his wonderful medical assistants, Leo said that while some had questioned whether he would be able to make the trip because of his recent surgery, he “had no doubt and was convinced that this trip had to go forward.”
paras.zh: 从罗马出发，经过17个小时的飞行后，利奥一行抵达乌拉圭首都蒙得维的亚。利奥赞美主并感谢他出色的医疗助手，他说，虽然有些人质疑他由于最近的手术是否能够成行，但他“毫不怀疑并坚信这次旅行必须继续”。

paras.en: An estimated 40,000 people waited patiently for Leo, who traveled more than 450 miles from Montevideo to Paysandu, a riverside economic hub in Uruguay’s northwest. Many stood outside overnight, braving the rain.
paras.zh: 估计有 40,000 人耐心等待 Leo，他从蒙得维的亚行驶了 450 多英里，来到乌拉圭西北部的河畔经济中心派桑杜。许多人冒雨在外面站了一夜。

paras.en: Drawing inspiration from the nearby General Artigas International Bridge, which connects Uruguay and Argentina, Leo told the crowds that bridges bring “openness, communication and exchange.”
paras.zh: 利奥从附近连接乌拉圭和阿根廷的阿蒂加斯将军国际大桥汲取灵感，他告诉人群，桥梁带来“开放、沟通和交流”。

paras.en: After celebrating an outdoor Mass with around 50,000 people in front of the National Shrine of Our Lady of the Thirty-Three, the cathedral basilica of the Uruguayan city of Florida, Leo traveled to Argentina’s capital. It was a trip his predecessor, Pope Francis, was never able to make, even though he came from the country.
paras.zh: 在乌拉圭佛罗里达市的圣母三十三圣殿前举行了一场户外弥撒后，利奥前往阿根廷首都。这是他的前任教皇方济各从未能够进行的一次旅行，尽管他来自乡村。

paras.en: After meeting with President Javier Milei, Leo called on the country’s political leaders to “safeguard democracy” and demonstrate a “careful use of words” in his first speech in the country.
paras.zh: 在与总统哈维尔·米莱会面后，利奥呼吁该国政治领导人“捍卫民主”，并在他的首次国内演讲中表现出“谨慎使用言语”。

paras.en: An estimated 2.5 million people turned out to Leo’s first Mass in Argentina at Buenos Aires’ Monumento a los Españoles, the Vatican said, his biggest liturgical event to date. Again, thousands waited overnight hoping for a good spot.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈表示，估计有 250 万人参加了利奥在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯的西班牙纪念碑举行的第一场弥撒，这是他迄今为止规模最大的礼仪活动。再次，数千人彻夜等待，希望能找到一个好位置。

paras.en: Before he greeted the throngs, however, Leo made a pilgrimage to the Cottolengo Don Orione in the south of the city which is home to more than 400 people with disabilities.
paras.zh: 然而，在向人群致意之前，利奥前往该市南部的 Cottolengo Don Orione 朝圣，这里居住着 400 多名残疾人。

paras.en: After flying to Argentina’s second most populous city, Leo met with bishops, priests and other members of the clergy at the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Assumption where he recalled the teachings of Francis about the poor. “Even those who have the least can teach us a great deal,” he said.
paras.zh: 飞往阿根廷第二大城市后，利奥在圣母升天大教堂会见了主教、神父和其他神职人员，在那里他回顾了方济各关于穷人的教诲。 “即使是那些拥有最少的人也能教给我们很多东西，”他说。

paras.en: On a visit to the Villa Devoto Federal Penitentiary in Buenos Aires, Leo urged prisoners to use their time as an “opportunity to begin your lives anew.”
paras.zh: 在参观布宜诺斯艾利斯的维拉德沃托联邦监狱时，利奥敦促囚犯利用他们的时间作为“重新开始生活的机会”。

paras.en: The pontiff celebrated another huge Mass to a crowd of 2 million outside the shrine of Our Lady of Lujan, Argentina’s most important Catholic site, before he left the country for Peru.
paras.zh: 教宗离开阿根廷前往秘鲁之前，在阿根廷最重要的天主教圣地卢汉圣母朝圣地外，为 200 万人庆祝了另一场大型弥撒。

paras.en: On an emotional return to the South American country where he served as a missionary for two decades, Leo was greeted by an estimated 3 million people, the largest crowd of his papacy.
paras.zh: 利奥在他担任传教士二十年的南美国家满怀激情地返回时，受到了估计有 300 万人的欢迎，这是他任教皇期间人数最多的人群。

paras.en: In a closely watched speech to President Keiko Fujimori, he urged her to confront the wounds of the country’s turbulent past, alluding to the contested legacy of her father and presidential predecessor, Alberto Fujimori, who was in office from 1990 to 2000 and later convicted of human rights abuses. He was pardoned in 2017 and died in 2024.
paras.zh: 在对藤森庆子总统的一次备受关注的演讲中，他敦促她正视该国动荡的过去所带来的创伤，并提到了她的父亲、前任总统阿尔贝托·藤森留下的有争议的遗产。藤森在 1990 年至 2000 年任职，后来因侵犯人权而被定罪。他于 2017 年被赦免，并于 2024 年去世。

paras.en: On a triumphant return Friday to the city of Chiclayo, where as Robert Prevost he served as bishop for eight years and was affectionately nicknamed “Padre Roberto,” Leo said it was a blessing to be in his adopted home exactly one month after he underwent lung cancer surgery, an operation which many feared would force him to cancel the trip.
paras.zh: 周五凯旋返回奇克拉约市时，利奥在接受肺癌手术一个月后，以罗伯特·普雷沃斯特的身份担任主教八年，并被亲切地称为“罗伯托神父”，这是一件幸事，许多人担心这次手术会迫使他取消行程。

paras.en: “As I look at your faces, a prayer of thanksgiving to the Lord arises in my heart for the blessing you have been and continue to be in my life,” he said, as the crowd, estimated by the Vatican to have been 1.5 million people, cheered in the Pampas de Pimentel, a desert plain to the west of the city.
paras.zh: 他说：“当我看着你们的脸时，我心里升起对上帝的感恩祈祷，感谢你们一直以来并将继续给予我的生命。”据梵蒂冈估计，人群在皮门特尔潘帕斯沙漠平原上欢呼雀跃。

paras.en: After boarding a military helicopter, Leo flew to a remote corner of his former diocese to hold an open-air Mass in the Andean highlands.
paras.zh: 登上军用直升机后，利奥飞往他前教区的一个偏远角落，在安第斯高地举行露天弥撒。

paras.en: Acknowledging that many in the 20,000-strong crowd had a much more difficult journey than him, he told them the journey that they made was “not only a passage along difficult roads, but also a pilgrimage of faith.”
paras.zh: 他承认，在两万名群众中，有很多人经历了比他艰难得多的旅程，他告诉他们，他们的旅程“不仅是一条艰难的道路，也是一次信仰的朝圣”。

paras.en: After approximately 100,000 people took part in the meeting at the Saqsaywaman National Archaeological Park, Leo was greeted by a largely Indigenous audience in the Peruvian city of Pucallpa, an eastern gateway to the Amazon, about 124 miles west of the Brazilian border.
paras.zh: 约 10 万人参加了在 Saqsaywaman 国家考古公园举行的会议后，利奥在秘鲁城市普卡尔帕受到了大部分土著观众的欢迎，普卡尔帕是亚马逊东部的门户，距离巴西边境以西约 124 英里。

paras.en: There, he condemned deforestation in the world’s largest rainforest and pollution caused by oil and gold production. “Many Indigenous leaders have been murdered for defending their territories,” he said, “The blood of these brothers cries out to God and demands justice.”
paras.zh: 在那里，他谴责了世界上最大的热带雨林的砍伐以及石油和黄金生产造成的污染。 “许多原住民领袖因保卫自己的领土而被谋杀，”他说，“这些兄弟的鲜血向上帝呼喊，要求伸张正义。”

paras.en: After meeting staff and residents at shelter for the Little Sisters of the Abandoned Elderly, a religious institute dedicated to the care of older people, Leo will hold a short ceremony at the Callao Air Base in Peru, before he departs for Rome, where he will arrive Tuesday morning.
paras.zh: 在与遗弃老人小姐妹庇护所（一家致力于照顾老年人的宗教机构）会面后，利奥将在秘鲁卡亚俄空军基地举行一个简短的仪式，然后前往罗马，周二上午抵达罗马。

paras.en: Claudio Lavanga reported from Lima, Veronica Sanchis Bencomo from New York, and Max Butterworth from London.
paras.zh: Claudio Lavanga 从利马报道，Veronica Sanchis Bencomo 从纽约报道，Max Butterworth 从伦敦报道。

paras.zh: 托马斯·詹姆斯·马里诺尼将于 2027 年 11 月再次出庭接受宣判。

articles.title: Breaking: Magnitude-6.6 earthquake tremors felt in Darwin
articles.author: Gemma Ferguson

paras.en: Hundreds of Australians have reported feeling tremors from a magnitude-6.6 earthquake that struck Indonesia this morning.
paras.zh: 数百名澳大利亚人报告称，今天早上印度尼西亚发生了 6.6 级地震，他们感到了震动。

paras.en: According to the Bureau of Meteorology (BOM), the earthquake struck Tanimbar Islands about 6:41am Darwin time.
paras.zh: 据气象局 (BOM) 称，达尔文时间早上 6 点 41 分左右，塔宁巴尔群岛发生地震。

paras.en: Geoscience Australia said the quake began 29 kilometres under the Banda Sea, with more than 400 reports made so far by Australians who felt the tremors.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地球科学局表示，地震发生在班达海下 29 公里处，迄今为止，已有 400 多份感受到地震的澳大利亚人发出了报告。

paras.en: The BOM said no part of Australia's mainland or islands faces a tsunami threat from the earthquake.
paras.zh: 气象局表示，澳大利亚大陆或岛屿的任何部分都没有面临地震造成的海啸威胁。

articles.title: Carney arrives in China for meeting with Xi Jinping, Asia-Pacific summit
articles.author: Dylan Robertson

paras.en: Carney arrives in China for meeting with Xi Jinping, Asia-Pacific summit
paras.zh: 卡尼抵达中国与习近平举行亚太峰会

paras.en: Shenzhen is PM's last stop of 9-day overseas trip
paras.zh: 深圳是总理9天海外访问的最后一站

paras.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney arrived in China on Monday, where he is set to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping and leaders from across the Pacific Rim.
paras.zh: 马克·卡尼总理周一抵达中国，并将与中国国家主席习近平和环太平洋地区领导人会面。

paras.en: On his fourth and final stop of a nine-day overseas trip, Carney is in the city of Shenzhen, a tech hub in southeastern China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.
paras.zh: 卡尼为期九天的海外访问的第四站也是最后一站是在中国东南部的科技中心深圳参加亚太经合组织峰会。

paras.en: His first official task, however, will be a bilateral meeting with Xi on Tuesday morning. Ahead of the trip, Carney said Canada could do more with China in terms of agriculture, clean and conventional energy and financial services.
paras.zh: 然而，他的第一项正式任务将是周二上午与习近平举行双边会晤。卡尼在访问前表示，加拿大可以在农业、清洁和传统能源以及金融服务方面与中国做更多的事情。

paras.en: "We've established pretty clear guardrails on the areas that we're going to focus on … I'm using our words, not theirs," he told reporters in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, on Sunday, where he was attending the Francophonie summit.
paras.zh: “我们已经在我们要关注的领域建立了相当明确的护栏……我用的是我们的话，而不是他们的话，”他周日在柬埔寨金边参加法语国家峰会时对记者说。

paras.en: Earlier on this trip he was in the Philippines for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and Ireland for a European Political Community meeting.
paras.zh: 此行早些时候，他在菲律宾参加东南亚国家联盟，并在爱尔兰参加欧洲政治共同体会议。

paras.en: - Carney sets out to deepen ties with China. Has the threat landscape changed?
paras.zh: - 卡尼着手深化与中国的关系。威胁形势发生了变化吗？

paras.en: - Carney says Canada could turn to Chinese automakers if Trump trade talks fail
paras.zh: - 卡尼表示，如果特朗普贸易谈判失败，加拿大可能会转向中国汽车制造商

paras.en: Carney said he expects to speak with Xi about "the evolution of the international system, China's role in that and Canadian priorities."
paras.zh: 卡尼表示，他希望与习近平讨论“国际体系的演变、中国在其中的作用以及加拿大的优先事项”。

paras.en: An overarching topic will be Chinese investments into Canada's auto sector. Both countries agreed earlier this year to allow a limited amount of Chinese electric vehicles into Canada.
paras.zh: 一个首要话题将是中国对加拿大汽车行业的投资。两国今年早些时候同意允许有限数量的中国电动汽车进入加拿大。

paras.en: Carney has said he wants Chinese carmakers to set up shop, but only if they provide decent jobs, saying he is wary of plants where workers assemble cars using components mostly made in China.
paras.zh: 卡尼表示，他希望中国汽车制造商开设工厂，但前提是它们能提供体面的就业机会，他对工人们使用主要是中国制造的零部件组装汽车的工厂持谨慎态度。

paras.en: He said trade talks with Washington will shape how Canada approaches Chinese investment.
paras.zh: 他表示，与华盛顿的贸易谈判将影响加拿大对待中国投资的方式。

paras.en: "It's part of the trade negotiations," he said. "Depending where that settles, there'll be other options — European options, Asian options."
paras.zh: “这是贸易谈判的一部分，”他说。 “根据最终结果，还会有其他选择——欧洲选择、亚洲选择。”

paras.en: "This is not leverage, but you know, action-reaction. It depends."
paras.zh: “这不是杠杆作用，而是行动-反应。这取决于情况。”

paras.en: This is the second time this year Carney has met with Xi in China — he travelled to Beijing in January for the first meeting between a Canadian prime minister and Chinese president in eight years. The relationship between Canada and China had soured during the tenure of former prime minister Justin Trudeau, largely over accusations from Canada about foreign interference from China.
paras.zh: 这是卡尼今年第二次在中国会见习近平——他于一月份前往北京，参加八年来加拿大总理与中国国家主席的首次会面。加拿大和中国的关系在前总理贾斯汀·特鲁多任职期间恶化，主要是因为加拿大指责中国进行外国干涉。

paras.en: Before leaving Canada, Carney said he would raise foreign interference with Xi, prompting a Chinese government spokesperson to deny any such activities take place.
paras.zh: 卡尼在离开加拿大之前表示，他将提出外国对习近平的干涉，这促使中国政府发言人否认发生任何此类活动。

paras.en: Carney will also meet with various leaders from the APEC forum, a group of 21 economies on both sides of the Pacific that work together to break down trade barriers. The grouping includes members as varied as Taiwan, Australia and Peru.
paras.zh: 卡尼还将与亚太经合组织论坛的多位领导人会面，该论坛由太平洋两岸 21 个经济体组成，共同努力打破贸易壁垒。该组织的成员包括台湾、澳大利亚和秘鲁。

paras.en: Carney's office says he will stick with his focus of drumming up more investment and diversifying Canadian trade.
paras.zh: 卡尼的办公室表示，他将坚持吸引更多投资和实现加拿大贸易多元化的重点。

paras.en: Dancers perform as Carney arrives in Shenzhen. (Adrian Wyld/The Canadian Press)
paras.zh: 卡尼抵达深圳时，舞者在表演。 （阿德里安·怀尔德/加拿大新闻社）

paras.en: Vina Nadjibulla, co-founder of the Centre for Strategic Statecraft, said she'll be watching to see whether Carney allows more Chinese investments into Canada "in critical sectors, in energy and technology, particularly related to renewables and batteries" in addition to auto manufacturing.
paras.zh: 战略治国中心联合创始人维娜·纳吉布拉 (Vina Nadjibulla) 表示，除了汽车制造之外，她还将关注卡尼是否允许更多中国投资加拿大“能源和技术等关键领域，特别是与可再生能源和电池相关的领域”。

paras.en: "We have to constantly triangulate our relationship with China with our discussions with the U.S. — and also watch then what happens between the U.S. and China bilaterally," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们必须不断通过与美国的讨论来衡量我们与中国的关系，并观察美国和中国之间的双边关系。”

paras.en: In 2022, Canada ordered three Chinese firms to divest their interests in critical minerals operations in Canada, citing national security concerns.
paras.zh: 2022年，加拿大以国家安全为由，命令三家中国公司剥离其在加拿大关键矿产业务的权益。

paras.en: Nadjibulla also said the summit should help craft the foreign policy review that Carney aims to table in the House of Commons in the coming weeks, as well as next year's planned renewal of the 2022 Indo-Pacific strategy launched by Trudeau.
paras.zh: 纳吉布拉还表示，此次峰会应有助于制定卡尼计划在未来几周内向下议院提交的外交政策审查，以及明年计划更新的特鲁多发起的2022年印太战略。

paras.en: "We now have a really solid foundation," Nadjibulla said, noting that leaders from Asia have visited Canada or are planning to, notably Vietnam and India.
paras.zh: 纳吉布拉表示：“我们现在拥有非常坚实的基础。”他指出，亚洲领导人已经访问或计划访问加拿大，特别是越南和印度。

paras.en: "Canada is finally on their radar and has relevance to their own diversification agendas and their own economic security and resilience agendas."
paras.zh: “加拿大终于进入了他们的视线，并且与他们自己的多元化议程以及经济安全和复原力议程相关。”

paras.en: She said any update to Ottawa's regional strategy must include a look at relations with Taiwan, a self-governing island which China claims. The federal cabinet has left a trade arrangement sitting unsigned for more than a year, despite the House foreign affairs committee urging the government to proceed with more economic relations.
paras.zh: 她表示，渥太华地区战略的任何更新都必须考虑与台湾的关系，台湾是中国声称拥有主权的一个自治岛屿。尽管众议院外交事务委员会敦促政府加强经济关系，但联邦内阁一年多来一直没有签署一项贸易安排。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump will also be in attendance, and a meeting with him, Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin is planned for Thursday.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也将出席，并计划于周四与他、习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行会晤。

paras.en: - Carney says he will not boycott APEC 'family photo' with Putin
paras.zh: - 卡尼表示他不会抵制与普京的APEC“全家福”

paras.en: - Analysis Trump's increasing support for Russia carries existential danger for Canada
paras.zh: - 分析特朗普对俄罗斯日益增加的支持给加拿大带来了生存危险

paras.en: - Carney embarks on a worldwide summit tour to build bridges with Europe and Asia
paras.zh: - 卡尼开始全球峰会之旅，与欧洲和亚洲建立桥梁

paras.en: That has raised alarm among European officials, as some suggest U.S.-brokered peace talks between Russia and Ukraine have included proposals they say would leave both Ukraine and Europe vulnerable.
paras.zh: 这引起了欧洲官员的警惕，一些人表示，美国斡旋的俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的和平谈判包含了他们认为会使乌克兰和欧洲都陷入脆弱的提议。

paras.en: Carney said Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva recently told him he encouraged the talks in order to end the war. Carney said Canada wants a just peace for Ukraine and a ceasefire is needed.
paras.zh: 卡尼说，巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦最近告诉他，他鼓励通过谈判来结束战争。卡尼表示，加拿大希望乌克兰实现公正和平，需要停火。

paras.en: Nadjibulla said it's incredible the trilateral meeting might happen, adding it reinforces Carney's warnings about "unconstrained great-power politics" in his January speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos.
paras.zh: 纳吉布拉表示，三方会议的召开令人难以置信，并补充说，这强化了卡尼在一月份达沃斯世界经济论坛演讲中关于“不受约束的大国政治”的警告。

paras.en: "It's a reminder that other countries need to double down on their efforts to build resilience and agency, so that they don't become collateral — so they don't end up on the menu of great-power competition, but rather have a seat at the table," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“这提醒人们，其他国家需要加倍努力建设韧性和机构，这样它们就不会成为抵押品——这样它们就不会最终出现在大国竞争的名单上，而是在谈判桌上占有一席之地。”

paras.en: China has indicated great enthusiasm for Carney's visit. The state-controlled English-language newspaper Global Times has framed it as a mutually beneficial partnership in a turbulent world.
paras.zh: 中方对卡尼访华表现出极大热情。官方英文报纸《环球时报》将其描述为动荡世界中的互利伙伴关系。

paras.en: "The ability of China and Canada to address previous trade frictions through calm and equal-footed dialogue not only helps strengthen bilateral strategic mutual trust, but also injects confidence into global economic and trade co-operation," said Zhao Xingshu of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, according to the newspaper.
paras.zh: 据该报报道，中国社会科学院院士赵兴树表示：“中加能够通过平静、平等的对话解决此前的贸易摩擦，不仅有助于增强双边战略互信，也为全球经贸合作注入信心。”

paras.en: "Nearly eight years of limited high-level exchanges mean rebuilding mutual understanding between officials and institutions will require time. At this stage, maintaining the momentum of stabilization in bilateral relations is itself an important and realistic objective."
paras.zh: “近八年的高层交往有限，意味着官员和机构之间重建相互了解需要时间。现阶段，保持双边关系稳定势头本身就是一个重要而现实的目标。”

paras.en: The APEC summit takes place in Shenzhen, which borders Hong Kong. Canada has repeatedly expressed concern about growing repression in Hong Kong as the territory transitions from semi-autonomy to full Chinese rule.
paras.zh: APEC峰会在毗邻香港的深圳举行。随着香港从半自治向中国全面统治过渡，加拿大一再对香港日益加剧的镇压表示担忧。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Canada joined Western peers in condemning 10-year sentences for politicians and democracy activists under national security laws, particularly Joshua Wong.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，加拿大与西方国家一起谴责根据国家安全法对政客和民主活动人士判处 10 年徒刑，尤其是黄之锋。

paras.en: "We call for an immediate end to all unjust prosecutions of individuals charged," the joint statement says.
paras.zh: 联合声明称：“我们呼吁立即停止对被指控个人的所有不公正起诉。”

paras.en: It urges Chinese leaders to "uphold their international commitments and honour the rights and freedoms guaranteed to the people of Hong Kong" when the British government ceded sovereignty.
paras.zh: 它敦促中国领导人在英国政府放弃主权时“恪守其国际承诺，尊重香港人民所享有的权利和自由”。

paras.en: Carney has said he raises human rights issues privately with China but avoids public criticism.
paras.zh: 卡尼表示，他私下向中国提出人权问题，但避免公开批评。

articles.title: U.S. Supreme Court set to hear 3 major Trump agenda immigration cases
articles.author: Chris Iorfida

paras.en: U.S. Supreme Court set to hear 3 major Trump agenda immigration cases
paras.zh: 美国最高法院将审理特朗普议程的三起主要移民案件

paras.en: Top court just added major asylum case to its docket, with third-country deportation arguments set for Dec. 9
paras.zh: 最高法院刚刚将重大庇护案件列入其备审案件，第三国驱逐论点定于 12 月 9 日举行

paras.en: The U.S. Supreme Court late last week agreed to take on a case central to the Trump administration's immigration agenda concerning the conditions under which migrants can request asylum.
paras.zh: 美国最高法院上周晚些时候同意受理特朗普政府移民议程的核心案件，该案件涉及移民可以申请庇护的条件。

paras.en: While the announcement ended up being buried in a Friday afternoon news cycle that saw the unforeseen ground stop of U.S. air travel, it means that the top court will now hear at least three major immigration-related cases in its session that runs through June 2027.
paras.zh: 虽然这一消息最终被埋没在周五下午的新闻周期中，美国航空旅行意外停止，但这意味着最高法院现在将在持续到 2027 年 6 月的开庭中审理至少三起与移民相关的重大案件。

paras.en: The Trump administration's "retinterpretation of certain detention and deportation policies" has led to a "particularly high number of immigration disputes" compared to previous sessions," according to SCOTUSblog, which tracks the work of the top court. The blog, in an October post, also highlighted a handful of other cases that, while narrower in scope in terms of their ramifications, could also be described as immigration-related.
paras.zh: 据跟踪最高法院工作的 SCOTUSblog 称，与之前的会议相比，特朗普政府“对某些拘留和驱逐政策的重新解释”导致“移民纠纷数量特别多”。该博客在 10 月份的一篇文章中还强调了其他一些案件，虽然其影响范围较小，但也可以被描述为与移民相关。

paras.en: The top court in the 2025-2026 session rejected a Trump administration bid to end birthright citizenship going forward, but it made an impactful ruling that has paved the way for the federal government to deport large numbers of Haitian Americans and other residents who have been in the U.S. for years after fleeing natural disasters or turmoil in their home countries.
paras.zh: 最高法院在2025年至2026年的会议上拒绝了特朗普政府终止出生公民权的提议，但它做出了一项有影响力的裁决，为联邦政府驱逐大量海地裔美国人和其他因逃离本国自然灾害或动乱而在美国生活多年的居民铺平了道路。

paras.en: Overall, these new cases could lead to Supreme Court rulings that further reshape the American immigration and asylum system, or at least provide clarity in response to actions, some very controversial, that have been undertaken by President Donald Trump's second administration.
paras.zh: 总体而言，这些新案件可能会导致最高法院作出裁决，进一步重塑美国移民和庇护制度，或者至少对唐纳德·特朗普总统第二届政府所采取的行动（其中一些非常有争议）提供明确的回应。

paras.en: Here is a look at the three major cases, so far, of the 2026-2027 docket:
paras.zh: 以下是迄今为止 2026-2027 年案卷中的三个主要案例：

paras.en: Generally speaking, U.S. laws have recognized through the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) and other legislation the rights of migrants to make an asylum claim when arriving at a border entry point, or even if they are caught trying to cross into the country between entry points. In most years, denials have been greater than asylum claims being granted, though the percentage has fluctuated.
paras.zh: 一般来说，美国法律通过《移民和国籍法》（INA）和其他立法承认移民在抵达边境入境点时，或者即使他们在试图在入境点之间入境时被抓到时提出庇护申请的权利。在大多数年份，拒绝的庇护申请数量多于批准的庇护申请数量，尽管比例有所波动。

paras.en: In his final year in office, former president Joe Biden sought to stem the tide of surging arrivals at the southern border and encourage appointment-based claims with what was described as an executive order meant to be temporary, which limited asylum eligibility based on the daily number of encounters at the border.
paras.zh: 在任职的最后一年，前总统乔·拜登试图遏制南部边境入境人数激增的趋势，并通过所谓的临时行政命令鼓励基于预约的申请，该命令根据每天在边境遇到的人数限制了庇护资格。

paras.en: On the very first day of his second presidential term in 2025, Trump signed an executive order deemed necessary due to an "invasion" at the southern border.
paras.zh: 特朗普在 2025 年第二个总统任期的第一天，签署了一项因南部边境“入侵”而被视为必要的行政命令。

paras.en: Trump's order has essentially amounted to a blanket asylum ban for migrants caught crossing between border points. The prohibition has also applied to migrants who arrive at official border crossings and lack certain medical or criminal history information, a requirement that advocates say is often impossible to meet for people fleeing violence.
paras.zh: 特朗普的命令实质上相当于对跨过边境点的移民实行全面庇护禁令。该禁令还适用于抵达官方过境点且缺乏某些医疗或犯罪历史信息的移民，倡导者称这一要求对于逃离暴力的人来说往往不可能满足。

paras.en: It was blocked first by a federal judge and then in April by the U.S. Court of Appeals in D.C. The panel ruled 2-1 that the INA doesn't "allow the president to remove [migrants] under summary removal procedures of his own making."
paras.zh: 该法案首先被一名联邦法官否决，随后于 4 月份被华盛顿特区的美国上诉法院否决。专家组以 2 比 1 的裁决裁定 INA“不允许总统根据他自己制定的简易驱逐程序驱逐[移民]。”

paras.en: In a partial dissent, Judge Justin Walker wrote that the administration can broadly deny asylum applications, but that the INA and other laws forbid sending people back to countries where they would be persecuted.
paras.zh: 贾斯汀·沃克法官表示部分反对，他写道，政府可以广泛拒绝庇护申请，但《移民和国籍法》和其他法律禁止将人们送回他们会受到迫害的国家。

paras.en: - On immigration, Trump administration has chalked up many more wins than setbacks
paras.zh: - 在移民问题上，特朗普政府的胜利多于挫折

paras.en: - Trump names Miller, an architect of U.S. deportation agenda, as new chief of staff
paras.zh: - 特朗普任命美国驱逐议程设计师米勒为新任幕僚长

paras.en: Whether that has been practised in the asylum claims the government does consider is arguable. Denial rates in some cases have climbed to over 90 per cent, according to the Transactional Records Access Clearinghouse at Syracuse University. Denial rates that high have not been seen for decades, if ever.
paras.zh: 政府确实考虑的庇护申请中是否采用了这种做法是有争议的。根据雪城大学交易记录访问信息交换所的数据，某些情况下的拒绝率已攀升至 90% 以上。如此高的拒绝率，几十年来从未见过。

paras.en: Democratic House Rep. Rob Menendez of New Jersey, posting Friday after it was learned the Supreme Court would take on the case, said "fixing our broken immigration system means upholding our values as a nation of immigrants" while "protecting the right to seek asylum."
paras.zh: 新泽西州民主党众议院众议员罗布·梅嫩德斯 (Rob Menendez) 在得知最高法院将受理此案后于周五发帖表示，“修复我们破碎的移民体系意味着维护我们作为移民国家的价值观”，同时“保护寻求庇护的权利”。

paras.en: The Supreme Court justices will gather to hear oral arguments on Dec. 9 regarding a controversial plank of the Trump administration's deportation policies, also related to executive orders the president signed on his first day back in the Oval Office in 2025.
paras.zh: 最高法院法官将于 12 月 9 日聚集在一起，就特朗普政府驱逐出境政策中一项有争议的内容听取口头辩论，该政策也与总统 2025 年重返椭圆形办公室第一天签署的行政命令有关。

paras.en: The U.S. traditionally has followed a principle of non-refoulement. That is, not returning persons to countries where it could be reasonably expected they'd face persecution or torture due to race, religion, sexuality, political views or other factors.
paras.zh: 美国历来遵循不驱回原则。也就是说，不将人员遣返回有理由预期他们会因种族、宗教、性取向、政治观点或其他因素而面临迫害或酷刑的国家。

paras.en: People deported from the U.S., all nationals of third countries, under an agreement to accept such deportees, arrive at the Juan Santamaria International Airport, near Alajuela, Costa Rica, on April 11. (Mayela Lopez/Reuters)
paras.zh: 根据接受此类被驱逐者的协议，被美国驱逐出境的人（所有第三国国民）于 4 月 11 日抵达哥斯达黎加阿拉胡埃拉附近的胡安·圣玛丽亚国际机场。（马耶拉·洛佩兹/路透社）

paras.en: Flowing through the Trump executive orders, however, the administration has sought workarounds through third-country deportations. According to a website run by two human rights organizations, the Trump administration has spent more than $95 million US to deport over 28,000 people to 31 different countries and has struck agreements to potentially send people to four additional countries.
paras.zh: 然而，根据特朗普的行政命令，政府通过第三国驱逐寻求解决办法。据两个人权组织运营的网站称，特朗普政府已花费超过 9500 万美元将 28,000 多人驱逐到 31 个不同的国家，并已达成协议，可能将人员遣送至另外 4 个国家。

paras.en: In many cases, people are being sent to countries to which they have no connection. In addition, some of the countries that have struck agreements with the U.S. have had questionable track records in terms of upholding human rights and freedoms.
paras.zh: 在许多情况下，人们被送往与他们没有联系的国家。此外，一些与美国达成协议的国家在维护人权和自由方面的记录值得怀疑。

paras.en: - U.S. Supreme Court says Trump can continue deportations to 3rd countries — for now
paras.zh: - 美国最高法院称特朗普可以暂时继续将其驱逐到第三个国家

paras.en: - Liberia to begin accepting up to 1,200 deportees from the U.S.
paras.zh: - 利比里亚将开始接收多达 1,200 名来自美国的被驱逐者

paras.en: "These migrants are being transferred to countries or territories with which they have no ties, which can be a traumatizing and isolating experience that compounds harms already suffered which triggered their fleeing to the U.S. in the first place," the UN's Human Rights Council said in a statement earlier this year condemning the practice.
paras.zh: 联合国人权理事会在今年早些时候的一份声明中谴责这种做法，表示：“这些移民被转移到与他们没有联系的国家或地区，这可能是一次令人痛苦和孤立的经历，加剧了他们已经遭受的伤害，而正是这些伤害首先引发了他们逃往美国。”

paras.en: The administration has said that it has struck deals with foreign governments where the safety of the deportees has been assured. But the New York Times reported last week after an extensive investigation that it had it identified 110 persons who were deported to a third country but then put on a plane back to their home country of origin, even after U.S. courts had established they had reasonable fears in leaving those countries to seek asylum.
paras.zh: 美国政府表示，已与外国政府达成协议，确保被驱逐者的安全。但《纽约时报》上周报道称，经过广泛调查后，它发现有 110 人被驱逐到第三国，但随后又被送上飞机返回原籍国，尽管美国法院已确定他们有合理理由担心离开这些国家寻求庇护。

paras.en: Under past administrations, most non-citizens without a criminal record who were arrested away from border points had an opportunity to request a bond hearing. In many cases, ththem to work and remain free while their cases, which would ultimately determine if they would be deported, wound their through immigration court.
paras.zh: 在过去的政府领导下，大多数在边境点以外被捕的没有犯罪记录的非公民都有机会请求保释听证会。在许多情况下，他们要求工作并保持自由，而他们的案件将最终决定他们是否会被驱逐出境，并通过移民法庭对他们造成伤害。

paras.en: The Trump administration has ended that practice, citing an interpretation of existing 1996 legislation. After conflicting rulings in federal courts across the U.S., the Supreme Court will take up the issue after the American Civil Liberties Union filed a lawsuit on behalf of Ricardo Aparecido Barbosa da Cunha.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府引用了对 1996 年现行立法的解释，结束了这种做法。在美国各地联邦法院​​做出相互矛盾的裁决后，美国公民自由联盟代表里卡多·阿帕雷西多·巴博萨·达库尼亚提起诉讼后，最高法院将处理这一问题。

paras.en: - Canadian dentist detained by ICE in Minnesota released after federal court ruling
paras.zh: - 联邦法院裁决后，被明尼苏达州 ICE 拘留的加拿大牙医获释

paras.en: - CBC Investigates Winnipeg-born man deported back to Canada after 9 months in ICE detention
paras.zh: - CBC 调查出生于温尼伯的男子在 ICE 拘留 9 个月后被驱逐回加拿大

paras.en: The Brazilian man entered the U.S. without authorization two decades ago and, according to his lawyers, has never been charged or convicted of a crime. Nevertheless, after federal immigration agents detained him on his way to work in September 2025, an immigration judge subsequently denied him a bond hearing.
paras.zh: 这名巴西男子二十年前未经授权进入美国，据他的律师称，他从未被指控或定罪。然而，在联邦移民特工于 2025 年 9 月在上班途中拘留他后，一名移民法官随后拒绝了他的保释听证会。

paras.en: According to the Deportation Data Project at UC Berkeley and UCLA, the number of detention beds for people arrested within the U.S. has more than quadrupled in the past two years, meaning the stakes for this case are considerable.
paras.zh: 根据加州大学伯克利分校和加州大学洛杉矶分校的驱逐数据项目，过去两年，美国境内被捕者的拘留床位数量增加了四倍多，这意味着此案的风险相当大。

paras.en: As with the asylum case just announced Friday, no date has been set yet for oral arguments.
paras.zh: 与周五刚刚宣布的庇护案一样，口头辩论的日期尚未确定。

paras.en: With files from the Associated Press and Reuters
paras.zh: 来自美联社和路透社的文件

articles.title: Journalists call for justice after reporter found dead in Mexican coastal city of Acapulco
articles.author: Sara Jabakhanji

paras.en: Journalists call for justice after reporter found dead in Mexican coastal city of Acapulco
paras.zh: 记者在墨西哥沿海城市阿卡普尔科被发现死亡后，记者呼吁伸张正义

paras.en: Authorities probing death of Eduardo Flores, who reported on social issues, missing persons
paras.zh: 当局正在调查爱德华多·弗洛雷斯的死亡，他报道了社会问题和失踪人员

paras.en: Mexican journalist Eduardo Flores Salado was found dead over the weekend in Mexico's coastal city of Acapulco, intensifying concerns about reporters as the country remains among the world's deadliest for media workers.
paras.zh: 墨西哥记者爱德华多·弗洛雷斯·萨拉多周末在墨西哥沿海城市阿卡普尔科被发现死亡，加剧了人们对记者的担忧，因为该国仍然是世界上媒体工作者死亡最严重的国家之一。

paras.en: His body was found Saturday night in the Canuto Nogueda neighbourhood, according to local authorities, in the outskirts of Acapulco, Guerrero, a popular resort city in southern Guerrero state.
paras.zh: 据地方当局称，周六晚上，他的尸体在格雷罗州南部热门度假城市格雷罗州阿卡普尔科郊区的卡努托·诺格达（Canuto Nogueda）社区被发现。

paras.en: On Sunday, the Guerrero state prosecutor's office said that the case was being investigated as an "aggravated homicide." It did not announce any arrests or provide a cause of death or motive.
paras.zh: 周日，格雷罗州检察官办公室表示，此案正在作为“严重凶杀案”进行调查。它没有宣布任何逮捕行动，也没有提供死因或动机。

paras.en: Dozens of Flores's colleagues in Guerrero held a demonstration outside of the state attorney general's office on Monday, calling on Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum and local authorities to undergo a comprehensive investigation and implement stricter measures to keep journalists and their families safe.
paras.zh: 弗洛雷斯在格雷罗州的数十名同事周一在州总检察长办公室外举行示威，呼吁墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆和地方当局进行全面调查，并采取更严格的措施，确保记者及其家人的安全。

paras.en: "There is a lot of fear, of course. You have to be courageous to do journalism, to be a journalist in Guerrero," Cristian Zamora, a journalist and director at the Digital Agency, who had been friends with Flores since 2015 and was in attendance at the Monday demonstration.
paras.zh: “当然，有很多恐惧。你必须勇敢地从事新闻工作，成为格雷罗州的一名记者，”记者兼数字机构主管克里斯蒂安·萨莫拉 (Cristian Zamora) 自 2015 年以来一直是弗洛雷斯的朋友，并参加了周一的示威活动。

paras.en: "Every day, we go out and we don't know if we're going to return. Every day, we say something and we don't know who we're going to bother. We don't have that freedom."
paras.zh: “每天，我们出去，我们都不知道是否会回来。每天，我们都会说一些话，但我们不知道我们会打扰谁。我们没有那种自由。”

paras.en: Eduardo Flores was a well-known journalist in Acupulco. (Eduardo Flores/Facebook)
paras.zh: 爱德华多·弗洛雷斯是阿库普尔科的一位著名记者。 （爱德华多·弗洛雷斯/脸书）

paras.en: Over nearly two decades, Flores covered missing persons cases, security and social issues, working as a reporter for multiple local outlets.
paras.zh: 近二十年来，弗洛雷斯为多家当地媒体担任记者，报道失踪人员案件、安全和社会问题。

paras.en: Most recently, Flores worked with digital news outlet Enfoque Informativo and was well known in Acapulco for his activism within the 2SLGBTQ+ community. He also co-founded tabloid news outlet La Prensa Rosa, which translates to the Pink Press.
paras.zh: 最近，弗洛雷斯与数字新闻媒体 Enfoque Informativo 合作，并因其在 2SLGBTQ+ 社区中的积极活动而在阿卡普尔科广为人知。他还共同创办了小报新闻媒体 La Prensa Rosa，翻译过来就是“粉红出版社”。

paras.en: Mexico is consistently named one of the most dangerous and deadliest countries in the world for journalists, with Reporters Without Borders ranking the country as the second-most dangerous place for reporters last year, after Gaza.
paras.zh: 墨西哥一直被评为世界上对记者来说最危险和最致命的国家之一，无国界记者组织去年将该国列为继加沙之后对记者来说第二危险的地方。

paras.en: Journalists indignant over targeted attacks in Mexico
paras.zh: 记者对墨西哥发生的针对性袭击感到愤怒

paras.en: Zamora described Flores as a "great friend, supportive, attentive and polite."
paras.zh: 萨莫拉形容弗洛雷斯是“一位很好的朋友，乐于助人、细心且有礼貌”。

paras.en: "He was murdered," he told CBC News. "All of us, his fellow journalists, it caused us indignation, anger at what is happening in the country."
paras.zh: “他被谋杀了，”他告诉加拿大广播公司新闻。 “我们所有人，他的记者同事，这引起了我们的愤慨，对这个国家正在发生的事情感到愤怒。”

paras.en: Local 2SLGBTQ+ activist Alberto Serna Mogollon said Flores — whom he and other friends called by the common nicknames "Lalo" or "Lalito" — was a vocal member and supporter of the movement.
paras.zh: 当地 2SLGBTQ+ 活动家阿尔贝托·塞尔纳·莫戈隆 (Alberto Serna Mogollon) 表示，弗洛雷斯（他和其他朋友给弗洛雷斯起了昵称“Lalo”或“Lalito”）是该运动的直言不讳的成员和支持者。

paras.en: "That is why we are here: stand in solidarity, asking for justice from the competent authorities," he told CBC News.
paras.zh: 他告诉加拿大广播公司新闻：“这就是我们在这里的原因：团结一致，要求主管当局伸张正义。”

paras.en: A number of international human rights organizations — including London-based advocacy group Article 19 and Amnesty International — have documented that attacks, threats and murders of journalists frequently go unpunished in Mexico.
paras.zh: 许多国际人权组织——包括总部位于伦敦的“Article 19”倡导组织和国际特赦组织——都记录了在墨西哥袭击、威胁和谋杀记者的行为经常逍遥法外。

paras.en: In a post on X on Sunday, Article 19 said it condemned the alleged murder of Flores, calling on the Guerrero state prosecutor's office to "conduct a prompt, thorough, and impartial investigation ... that considers their journalistic work as a possible motive for the murder and keeps other lines of investigation open."
paras.zh: 在周日的 X 帖子中，第 19 条表示谴责涉嫌谋杀弗洛雷斯的行为，呼吁格雷罗州检察官办公室“进行迅速、彻底和公正的调查……将他们的新闻工作视为谋杀的可能动机，并保持其他调查渠道的开放。”

paras.en: Article 19 has documented 181 such cases since 2000 in the Latin American country, many of these concentrated in states with a strong presence of organized crime groups.
paras.zh: 自 2000 年以来，第 19 条记录了这个拉丁美洲国家的 181 起此类案件，其中许多集中在有组织犯罪集团猖獗的国家。

paras.en: It also called on the Protection Mechanism for Human Rights Defenders and Journalists, a state-run program meant to help protect journalists and human rights defenders, to assess the risks facing reporters' families and colleagues and to ensure their protection.
paras.zh: 它还呼吁建立人权捍卫者和记者保护机制，这是一个旨在帮助保护记者和人权捍卫者的国家计划，评估记者家人和同事面临的风险并确保他们受到保护。

paras.en: The program declined the Associated Press' request for an interview and did not provide comment for this story.
paras.zh: 该节目拒绝了美联社的采访请求，也没有对此事发表评论。

paras.en: 98% of journalist homicides remain unpunished
paras.zh: 98%的记者谋杀案仍未受到惩罚

paras.en: Last Wednesday, the AP reported on "exposed shortcomings" in the 2012 program meant to safeguard to more than 2,000 individuals, including approximately 500 journalists.
paras.zh: 上周三，美联社报道了 2012 年计划中“暴露的缺陷”，该计划旨在保护 2,000 多人，其中包括约 500 名记者。

paras.en: Under the mechanism's framework, each case first undergoes a risk assessment by a governing board, which creates a security plan. It can then provide tailored physical and emergency measures, such as panic buttons, bodyguards, armoured vehicles and temporary relocation. The mechanism ultimately works alongside federal and state authorities to implement and monitor these protections over time.
paras.zh: 在该机制的框架下，每个案例首先由理事会进行风险评估，并制定安全计划。然后，它可以提供量身定制的物理和紧急措施，例如紧急按钮、保镖、装甲车和临时搬迁。该机制最终与联邦和州当局合作，随着时间的推移实施和监控这些保护措施。

paras.en: Eight journalists were killed while enrolled in the program between 2017 and 2022, according to a joint investigation by Amnesty International and the Committee to Protect Journalists.
paras.zh: 根据国际特赦组织和保护记者委员会的联合调查，2017 年至 2022 年间，有 8 名记者在参加该计划时被杀。

paras.en: Propuesta Cívica, a Mexican civil society organization that provides legal support to journalists and their families, estimates that 98 per cent of journalist homicides remain unpunished.
paras.zh: Propuesta Cívica 是一个为记者及其家人提供法律支持的墨西哥民间社会组织，该组织估计，98% 的记者谋杀案仍未受到惩罚。

paras.en: "The deeper structural problem is that the mechanism has been given a responsibility that belongs to the state as a whole," Vanessa Carrillo, Propuesta Cívica's co-director, told the Associated Press last week.
paras.zh: “更深层次的结构性问题是，该机制被赋予了属于整个国家的责任，”Propuesta Cívica 联合主任瓦妮莎·卡里略 (Vanessa Carrillo) 上周对美联社表示。

paras.en: Cameras, a video recorder, a microphone and placards are placed together on the ground during a protest in July 2023, by journalists to demand justice for the murder of a regional correspondent who was found slain two days prior in, Guadalajara, Mexico. (Ulises Ruiz/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 2023 年 7 月的一次抗议活动中，记者们将相机、录像机、麦克风和标语牌放在地上，要求对两天前在墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉被发现被杀的一名地区记者的谋杀案伸张正义。 （尤利塞斯·鲁伊斯/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The Inter-American Commission for Human Rights has emphasized that the state must prevent attacks and reduce risks, not simply investigate them.
paras.zh: 美洲人权委员会强调，国家必须防止袭击并降低风险，而不仅仅是调查袭击。

paras.en: According to Propuesta Cívica, Mexico's federal Protection Mechanism is hampered by bureaucratic delays, insufficient staffing and a reactive approach. Protection measures are often inadequate, risk assessments delayed and safeguards withdrawn despite ongoing threats.
paras.zh: 据 Propuesta Cívica 称，墨西哥的联邦保护机制因官僚主义拖延、人员不足和被动态度而受到阻碍。尽管威胁持续存在，但保护措施往往不足，风险评估被推迟，保障措施也被撤回。

paras.en: In 2025, President Sheinbaum said the program could receive additional funding if needed, but Reporters Without Borders said the government has made little progress in fulfilling its press freedom commitments, including a promised review of the program.
paras.zh: 希因鲍姆总统表示，如果需要，该计划可以在 2025 年获得额外资金，但无国界记者组织表示，政府在履行新闻自由承诺（包括承诺对该计划进行审查）方面几乎没有取得任何进展。

paras.en: Flores's death follows that of Roxana Guzman, who directed a Veracruz crime news outlet, Pulso Informativo del Sureste.
paras.zh: 弗洛雷斯去世前，罗克珊娜·古兹曼（Roxana Guzman）去世，她是韦拉克鲁斯犯罪新闻媒体 Pulso Informativo del Sureste 的负责人。

paras.en: A video she recorded of masked men breaking down her front door before her abduction on June 2 was widely shared on social media. Her remains were found a month later. Authorities said eight people had been arrested over Guzman's kidnapping and killing, including four municipal police officers from a small town 300 kilometres south.
paras.zh: 6 月 2 日，她在被绑架前录制了一段蒙面男子破门而入的视频，该视频在社交媒体上广泛传播。一个月后，她的遗体被发现。当局称，已有八人因古兹曼绑架和杀害而被捕，其中包括来自以南 300 公里小镇的四名市警察。

paras.en: Flores's employer Enfoque Informativo condemned his death and demanded a thorough and transparent investigation.
paras.zh: 弗洛雷斯的雇主 Enfoque Informativo 谴责了他的死亡，并要求进行彻底、透明的调查。

paras.en: "This attack not only takes the life of a colleague, friend, and valuable human being; it constitutes a direct attack on freedom of expression," it said in a statement on Sunday.
paras.zh: “这次袭击不仅夺去了同事、朋友和有价值的人的生命；它构成了对言论自由的直接攻击，”该公司在周日的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: "They will not silence us. We will continue to report with the same determination and professional ethics that characterized the work of Eduardo Flores Salado."
paras.zh: “他们不会让我们沉默。我们将继续以与爱德华多·弗洛雷斯·萨拉多工作特点相同的决心和职业道德进行报道。”

paras.en: With files from CBC's Tania Miranda Perez, Reuters and The Associated Press
paras.zh: 来自 CBC 塔尼亚·米兰达·佩雷斯、路透社和美联社的文件

articles.title: Guinea's gold rush: Arrests, deportations spark outcry

paras.en: In Siguiri, northeastern Guinea, the gold rush has come to an abrupt end. "To date, 1,263 people, including Guineans, Burkinabe, Malians, Togolese, Nigerians, Ivorians, and Ghanaians, have been arrested and taken to Conakry for legal proceedings," Guinea's army spokesman, General Mamadou Aliou Sow, said. He added that officers from the Criminal Investigation Division, the National Police, and the National Gendarmerie are currently conducting interrogations.
paras.zh: 在几内亚东北部的锡吉里，淘金热已经戛然而止。几内亚陆军发言人马马杜·阿利乌·索乌将军表示：“迄今为止，已有 1,263 人被捕，其中包括几内亚人、布基纳法索人、马里人、多哥人、尼日利亚人、科特迪瓦人和加纳人，并被带到科纳克里接受法律诉讼。”他补充说，刑事调查部门、国家警察和国家宪兵队的警官目前正在进行审讯。

paras.en: The operation follows the ban on illegal gold mining in the Siguiri administrative region. According to Guinean authorities, the aim is to stop mining practices considered harmful to the environment. Uncontrolled gold mining depletes the soil, destroys vegetation and chokes waterways.
paras.zh: 此次行动是在锡吉里行政区禁止非法金矿开采之后进行的。据几内亚当局称，此举的目的是停止被认为对环境有害的采矿活动。不受控制的金矿开采会耗尽土壤、破坏植被并堵塞水道。

paras.en: "We know that there have recently been various forms of gold mining here involving the use of chemicals that can destroy the environmentand pollute our water sources," Toumany Sangare, chairman of the Siguiri civil society council, told DW.
paras.zh: 西吉里民间社会理事会主席图马尼·桑加雷（Toumany Sangare）告诉德国之声：“我们知道，最近这里出现了各种形式的金矿开采，其中涉及使用化学物质，这些化学物质会破坏环境并污染我们的水源。”

paras.en: The closure of the mining sites is having a significant impact on the local economy. For many workers, it means the sudden loss of their main source of income. DW spoke with young gold panners from Burkina Faso who had been driven out of Siguiri. Some said they had walked more than 200 km (124 miles) to the Malian capital, Bamako.
paras.zh: 矿区的关闭对当地经济产生了重大影响。对于许多工人来说，这意味着突然失去主要收入来源。德国之声采访了被赶出西吉里的布基纳法索年轻淘金者。一些人说，他们步行了 200 多公里（124 英里）到达马里首都巴马科。

paras.en: "We tried our luck, but just as we were beginning to feel hopeful, we were told to leave," Noufa, in his early 20s, who arrived in Siguiri in early October to work in a small mine, told DW. Another Burkinabe, who goes by the name Mc One, told DW he set out for Siguiri to earn money to provide for his elderly parents and relatives. "I left just under five months ago. We went through very difficult times there."
paras.zh: 20岁出头的努法于10月初抵达西吉里，在一个小矿井工作，他告诉德国之声：“我们尝试了运气，但正当我们开始感到希望时，我们被告知离开。”另一位名叫 Mc One 的布基纳法索人告诉德国之声，他前往西吉里是为了赚钱养活年迈的父母和亲戚。 “我不到五个月前离开。我们在那里度过了非常困难的时期。”

paras.en: Did Guinean authorities target foreigners?
paras.zh: 几内亚当局是否针对外国人？

paras.en: Guinean authorities refute the allegation that the ban on gold mining specifically targeted foreigners, saying the measure applies to all illegal gold miners. The closure of the mine primarily affects Guineans, Mohamed Nabe, chairman of the Committee on Mining and Industry, told DW.
paras.zh: 几内亚当局驳斥了金矿开采禁令专门针对外国人的指控，称该措施适用于所有非法金矿开采者。矿业和工业委员会主席穆罕默德·纳贝（Mohamed Nabe）告诉德国之声，该矿的关闭主要影响几内亚人。

paras.en: "Millions of Guineans are affected by this, compared to just a few thousand foreigners," Nabe said, adding that like everywhere else, there are cross-border population movements. "Of course, this can raise certain security concerns, but it was not the security aspect that motivated this decision. The main reasons are environmental in nature, as well as the need to better organize, structure, and regulate the mining sector."
paras.zh: 纳贝说：“与只有几千名外国人相比，数百万几内亚人受到了影响。”他补充说，与其他地方一样，也存在跨境人口流动。 “当然，这可能会引起某些安全问题，但促使这一决定的并不是安全方面。主要原因是环境问题，以及需要更好地组织、构建和监管采矿业。”

paras.en: Supporting the move, Morissanda Kouyate, Guinea's Foreign Minister, said his country is not the only one to ban illegal gold mining. However, according to Burkina Faso's Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana, the deported nationals were allegedly subjected to "cruel, inhuman, and degrading treatment." He spoke of "brutality" and alleged that the operation had resulted in deaths and injuries.
paras.zh: 几内亚外交部长莫里桑达·库亚特支持这一举措，他表示，几内亚并不是唯一禁止非法金矿开采的国家。然而，据布基纳法索安全部长穆罕默德杜·萨纳称，被驱逐的国民据称遭受了“残忍、不人道和有辱人格的待遇”。他谈到了“残酷”，并声称这次行动导致了人员伤亡。

paras.en: Malian journalist Amadou Oumar Diallo also criticized the alleged brutality of the Guinean authorities. In his view, they violated human rights. "Normally, when you prevent someone from exercising their freedom, you also have to provide for them," Diallo told DW. "This care is expensive. Detention alone costs a lot of money. The Guinean government took the easy way out by refusing to adhere to these principles and deporting all these people."
paras.zh: 马里记者阿马杜·乌马尔·迪亚洛也批评了几内亚当局所谓的残暴行为。在他看来，他们侵犯了人权。迪亚洛告诉德国之声：“通常情况下，当你阻止某人行使自由时，你也必须为他们提供保障。” “这种护理是昂贵的。光是拘留就需要花很多钱。几内亚政府拒绝遵守这些原则并驱逐所有这些人，从而采取了简单的出路。”

paras.en: While Burkina Faso strongly condemned the treatment of gold panners, Mali's leadership initially adopted a somewhat more restrained tone. Officially, Bamako described Guinea's decision to expel the miners as "sovereign."
paras.zh: 虽然布基纳法索强烈谴责淘金者的待遇，但马里领导层最初采取了较为克制的语气。巴马科官方称几内亚驱逐矿工的决定是“主权”的。

paras.en: Most recently, however, Mali's Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maiga, spoke of a "humanitarian catastrophe." On November 8, he traveled to Kouremale on the border between Mali and Guinea, where dozens of deported Malians were returning to the country. Given the close ties between Mali and Guinea, Maiga regretted the lack of coordination between the two countries.
paras.zh: 然而，最近，马里总理阿卜杜拉耶·迈加少将谈到了一场“人道主义灾难”。 11月8日，他前往马里和几内亚边境的库雷马莱，那里有数十名被驱逐的马里人正在返回该国。鉴于马里和几内亚之间的密切关系，迈加对两国之间缺乏协调表示遗憾。

paras.en: Currently, authorities in Mali and Burkina Faso are organizing efforts to assist their citizens: buses and trucks have been mobilized from both Bamako and Ouagadougou to bring the deported gold miners back to their home countries.
paras.zh: 目前，马里和布基纳法索当局正在组织努力协助本国公民：巴马科和瓦加杜古都调动了公共汽车和卡车，将被驱逐的金矿工人带回祖国。

paras.en: Parallel to the events in Siguiri, the Nimba Gold Refinery (NGR) has begun operations in Conakry. With this, Guinea joins other West African nations such as Burkina Faso, Mali, and Cote d'Ivoire. The Guinean government's goal is to refine 30% of the 70 metric tons (70,000 kg) of gold mined in the country domestically.
paras.zh: 与锡吉里事件同时进行的，宁巴黄金精炼厂 (NGR) 已在科纳克里开始运营。至此，几内亚加入了布基纳法索、马里和科特迪瓦等其他西非国家的行列。几内亚政府的目标是在国内开采 70 公吨（70,000 公斤）黄金中的 30% 进行精炼。

paras.en: Dr. Ibrahim Diallo, a mining expert, suggested that the Guinean authorities may have wanted to bring the gold mines in Siguiri under their control to supply the Nimba Gold Refinery (NGR). "What's happening in Siguiri isn't gold panning. A gold panner doesn't use a bulldozer or an excavator."
paras.zh: 矿业专家易卜拉欣·迪亚洛博士表示，几内亚当局可能想将锡吉里的金矿纳入自己的控制之下，为宁巴黄金精炼厂（NGR）供货。 “西吉里发生的事情不是淘金。淘金者不使用推土机或挖掘机。”

paras.en: Patrick Schein, chairman of the Alliance for Responsible Mining (ARM), told DW that it made more sense for Guinea to build up reserves with domestic gold rather than imported gold. However, he also stressed that the gold must be certified to be internationally recognized.
paras.zh: 负责任采矿联盟（ARM）主席Patrick Schein告诉德国之声，对于几内亚来说，使用国内黄金而不是进口黄金来建立储备更有意义。不过，他也强调，黄金必须经过认证才能得到国际认可。

paras.en: He does not anticipate significant local demand, so exports are crucial. It remains to be seen whether the refinery in Conakry can be competitive in this regard. For jewelry manufacturing, for example, international-level technical expertise is required.
paras.zh: 他预计当地需求不会很大，因此出口至关重要。科纳克里炼油厂在这方面是否具有竞争力还有待观察。例如，对于珠宝制造来说，需要国际水平的技术专业知识。

paras.en: Another issue, according to the ARM chairman, is that the location of refining determines the gold's origin. "So if I'm in Guinea and import or buy gold that comes from another country, that gold becomes Guinean gold through local refining," Schein said. "If Guinea serves as a transit hub for gold from the subregion, it would—unintentionally—become a center for money laundering," he added.
paras.zh: ARM 董事长表示，另一个问题是提炼地点决定了黄金的来源。 “因此，如果我在几内亚进口或购买来自其他国家的黄金，这些黄金通过当地精炼就会变成几内亚黄金，”沙因说。他补充说：“如果几内亚成为该次区域黄金的转运枢纽，它就会无意中成为洗钱中心。”

paras.en: According to Schein, tracing refined gold is harder than tracing raw gold. However, if the goal of refining [gold] in Guinea is to ensure better traceability, pay miners better wages and create a mercury-free processing chain, then that is a good initiative. "But now this must also be put into practice."
paras.zh: 根据 Schein 的说法，追踪精炼黄金比追踪原金更困难。然而，如果几内亚提炼[黄金]的目标是确保更好的可追溯性、向矿工支付更好的工资并创建无汞加工链，那么这是一个很好的举措。 “但现在这也必须付诸实践。”

paras.en: Mohamed Toure in Conakry and Mahamadou Kane in Bamako contributed to this article
paras.zh: 科纳克里的穆罕默德·图雷和巴马科的穆罕默德杜·凯恩对本文做出了贡献

paras.en: This article was originally written in German
paras.zh: 这篇文章最初是用德语写的

articles.title: Iran's growing exodus of young talent

paras.en: "I had actually decided to leave Iran back in 2023," a physician in her mid-30s, who wished to remain anonymous, told DW.
paras.zh: “我实际上已经决定在 2023 年离开伊朗，”一位不愿透露姓名的 30 多岁医生告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Her decision followed the 2022 death in police custody of 22-year-old Iranian-Kurdish woman Jina Mahsa Amini, who had been arrested by Iran's so-called morality police for allegedly violating the country's strict dress code.
paras.zh: 她做出这一决定之前，22 岁的伊朗库尔德妇女吉娜·马赫萨·阿米尼 (Jina Mahsa Amini) 于 2022 年在警方拘留期间死亡，她因涉嫌违反该国严格的着装规范而被伊朗所谓的道德警察逮捕。

paras.en: Amini's death sparked widespread protests and inspired the "Woman, Life, Freedom" movement, which challenged authorities' enforcement of Iran's hijab mandate.
paras.zh: 阿米尼之死引发了广泛的抗议活动，并激发了“妇女、生命、自由”运动，该运动对当局执行伊朗头巾规定提出了挑战。

paras.en: The physician said that the US-Israel war with Iran ultimately accelerated her plans to leave her homeland. She has been living with her family in a rented apartment in Turkey since early summer. From there, they hope to continue on to Germany.
paras.zh: 这位医生说，美以与伊朗的战争最终加速了她离开祖国的计划。从初夏开始，她就和家人一起住在土耳其的一套租来的公寓里。他们希望从那里继续前往德国。

paras.en: "It took two years for my professional qualifications to be recognized in Germany. After that, I applied for an appointment at the German Embassy in Tehran," the physician said.
paras.zh: “我的专业资格花了两年时间才在德国得到认可。之后，我向德国驻德黑兰大使馆申请了预约，”这位医生说。

paras.en: "Then the 12-day war broke out in the summer of 2025. The embassy closed and suddenly we were all left in limbo, not knowing what would happen next."
paras.zh: “然后，持续 12 天的战争在 2025 年夏天爆发。大使馆关闭，突然我们都陷入了困境，不知道接下来会发生什么。”

paras.en: She became concerned after the US and Israel launched fresh airstrikes on Iran on February 28, 2026 — not just about the escalating conflict, but also about the prospect of internal unrest and political instability.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月 28 日，美国和以色列对伊朗发动新一轮空袭后，她开始感到担忧——不仅担心冲突不断升级，还担心国内动荡和政治不稳定的前景。

paras.en: "Like many others we encountered during the emigration process, we decided to first move to a neighboring country," she said. "The plan was to stay in a third country for six months and then apply for a visa through the German embassy there. That's why my family and I came to Turkey."
paras.zh: “就像我们在移民过程中遇到的许多其他人一样，我们决定首先搬到邻国，”她说。 “计划是在第三国停留六个月，然后通过那里的德国大使馆申请签证。这就是我和我的家人来到土耳其的原因。”

paras.en: Turkey is one of the few countries that allows Iranian citizens to enter without a visa for up to 90 days.
paras.zh: 土耳其是少数几个允许伊朗公民免签证入境最长 90 天的国家之一。

paras.en: Since the latest conflict began, thousands of Iranians have crossed the border into Turkey. Many are trying to secure their stay through residence permits rather than seeking asylum.
paras.zh: 自最近的冲突开始以来，数千名伊朗人越过边境进入土耳其。许多人试图通过居留许可来获得居留权，而不是寻求庇护。

paras.en: According to official Turkish statistics, nearly 100,000 Iranian citizens were residing there in 2025. Among them are many academics and skilled professionals hoping to settle permanently in Europe or North America, seeing little future for themselves in Iran's war-hit economy.
paras.zh: 据土耳其官方统计，到2025年，将有近10万伊朗公民居住在那里。其中有许多学者和技术熟练的专业人士希望在欧洲或北美永久定居，他们在伊朗饱受战争打击的经济中看不到自己的未来。

paras.en: A US naval blockade of Iranian ports in the Gulf over the past few months has disrupted oil exports, trade and government revenues. The turmoil has compounded the impact of decades of sanctions and economic mismanagement.
paras.zh: 过去几个月，美国对伊朗海湾港口的海上封锁扰乱了石油出口、贸易和政府收入。这场动荡加剧了数十年制裁和经济管理不善的影响。

paras.en: The situation has put most businesses under pressure by restricting access to foreign currency and raw materials, among other problems, threatening revenues and jobs.
paras.zh: 这种情况使大多数企业面临压力，限制获得外汇和原材料等问题，威胁到收入和就业。

paras.en: The worsening conditions have left many people struggling to afford food, housing, health care and education.
paras.zh: 日益恶化的情况使许多人难以负担食物、住房、医疗保健和教育。

paras.en: The physician said the situation at the German embassy in Tehran, however, has improved in recent months. Some of her unmarried friends, who also initially moved to Turkey and spent substantial sums maintaining their stay there, have already returned to Iran to submit new visa applications from home.
paras.zh: 这位医生表示，不过近几个月来，德国驻德黑兰大使馆的情况有所改善。她的一些未婚朋友最初也搬到了土耳其，并花费了大量资金维持在那里的逗留，现在已经返回伊朗，从国内提交新的签证申请。

paras.en: She and her husband, however, have decided to stick to their original plan and wait out the six-month residency period in Turkey despite the difficulties.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管困难重重，她和丈夫还是决定坚持原计划，等待土耳其六个月的居留期结束。

paras.en: "I can't and don't want to go to Germany without my family. I don't know how long it would take for them to receive family reunification visas," she explained. "And I don't know what might happen in the meantime. A new war could break out at any moment."
paras.zh: “如果没有我的家人，我不能也不想去德国。我不知道他们需要多长时间才能获得家庭团聚签证，”她解释道。 “我不知道在此期间会发生什么。一场新的战争随时可能爆发。”

paras.en: The departure of highly qualified professionals and students has become one of the most pressing challenges facing Iranian society. Today, there are few families in which someone has not already emigrated or is not at least considering doing so.
paras.zh: 高素质专业人士和学生的离开已成为伊朗社会面临的最紧迫挑战之一。如今，很少有家庭中有人还没有移民，或者至少没有考虑这样做。

paras.en: A 2025 study by the University of Guilan in Iran examined the relationship between opportunities for social participation and students' willingness to emigrate.
paras.zh: 伊朗桂兰大学 2025 年的一项研究调查了社会参与机会与学生移民意愿之间的关系。

paras.en: The researchers found a statistically significant correlation: Students who felt they had fewer opportunities to shape their future in Iran were more likely to consider emigrating.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了统计上显着的相关性：那些认为自己在伊朗塑造未来的机会较少的学生更有可能考虑移民。

paras.en: Economic concerns are only part of the picture. Limited political participation, social restrictions and a sense of powerlessness are also driving many young Iranians to leave.
paras.zh: 经济担忧只是问题的一部分。有限的政治参与、社会限制和无力感也促使许多伊朗年轻人离开。

paras.en: Mahsa, who is in her mid-20s, told DW that she has already secured admission to a German university.
paras.zh: 20多岁的玛莎告诉德国之声，她已经获得一所德国大学的录取。

paras.en: Ali, meanwhile, dreams of a life outside Iran. The 23-year-old holds a bachelor's degree in engineering and is currently preparing for the entrance exam for a master's program at a public university. His long-term goal is to obtain a stronger qualification and then leave Iran — ideally with a scholarship.
paras.zh: 与此同时，阿里梦想着在伊朗以外的地方生活。 23岁的他拥有工程学学士学位，目前正在准备一所公立大学硕士课程的入学考试。他的长期目标是获得更强的资格，然后离开伊朗——最好能获得奖学金。

paras.en: "That's my dream of a better future," he said.
paras.zh: “这是我对更美好未来的梦想，”他说。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: Nvidia scandal: China's chips dilemma, US rivalry shape AI race

paras.en: China has ambitious plans to become the leader in the global race for artificial intelligence (AI). Beijing is aware that the country needs cutting-edge chips to achieve this goal.
paras.zh: 中国制定了雄心勃勃的计划，要成为全球人工智能 (AI) 竞赛的领导者。北京意识到该国需要尖端芯片来实现这一目标。

paras.en: Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang, who chairs the Communist Party's Commission on Science and Technology, has been tasked with strengthening China's capacity for technological innovation, which would enhance its strategic competitiveness against the United States.
paras.zh: 中共中央科委主任、国务院副总理丁薛祥的任务是加强中国的技术创新能力，这将增强其对美国的战略竞争力。

paras.en: The party is currently using AI to monitor citizens, develop advanced unmanned weapons systems, and transform economic sectors through robotics and industrial automation, among other things.
paras.zh: 该党目前正在使用人工智能来监控公民，开发先进的无人武器系统，并通过机器人和工业自动化等来改变经济部门。

paras.en: But the US has so far been leading the way in manufacturing technology and chip design. And Washington has taken a slew of measures to retain its dominance in this strategic sector.
paras.zh: 但迄今为止，美国在制造技术和芯片设计方面一直处于领先地位。华盛顿采取了一系列措施来保持其在这一战略领域的主导地位。

paras.en: US moves to restrict China's access to chips
paras.zh: 美国采取措施限制中国获取芯片

paras.en: As early as 2023, the then Biden administration decided to restrict the export of advanced semiconductors and chip manufacturing equipment to China, citing national security reasons.
paras.zh: 早在2023年，当时的拜登政府就以国家安全为由，决定限制向中国出口先进半导体和芯片制造设备。

paras.en: Beijing slammed the US restrictions, calling them "unilateral and arbitrary."
paras.zh: 北京猛烈抨击美国的限制，称其为“单方面和任意的”。

paras.en: US chipmakers, however, have been drawn to China's vast and rapidly growing market.
paras.zh: 然而，美国芯片制造商却被中国广阔且快速增长的市场所吸引。

paras.en: Jensen Huang, who resigned as CEO of the American AI chip manufacturer Nvidia last week, enjoyed something of a rock star status in China. The 63-year-old, who was born in Taiwan, is viewed in China as a successful entrepreneur.
paras.zh: 上周辞去美国人工智能芯片制造商英伟达首席执行官职务的黄仁勋在中国享有摇滚明星的地位。这位 63 岁的老人出生于台湾，在中国被视为一位成功的企业家。

paras.en: Huang, who has emerged as a key adviser on AI to US President Donald Trumpduring his second term, has pushed for looser regulations and fewer restrictions on selling AI chips to China.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普第二任期内成为人工智能方面的重要顾问，他推动放宽监管，减少对中国出售人工智能芯片的限制。

paras.en: In December, the Trump administration granted Nvidia permission to ship its H200 chips to China, provided the US got a 25% cut of sales.
paras.zh: 去年 12 月，特朗普政府允许 Nvidia 向中国出口其 H200 芯片，但美国的销售额要减少 25%。

paras.en: Although the H200 is not part of Nvidia's highest-performance series, it is significantly more efficient than competing Chinese products.
paras.zh: 虽然H200不是Nvidia最高性能系列的一部分，但它的效率明显高于中国的竞争产品。

paras.en: Each of these chips carries a hefty $27,000 (€24,000) price tag, and Nvidia estimates demand in China at 2 million units, which corresponds to sales of approximately $5.4 billion from this product alone.
paras.zh: 每款芯片的标价高达 27,000 美元（24,000 欧元），Nvidia 估计中国的需求量为 200 万颗，仅该产品的销售额就约为 54 亿美元。

paras.en: But Huang resigned last week following revelations of extramarital relationships, including one involving a businesswoman suspected by the US of spying for Beijing.
paras.zh: 但黄上周在婚外关系被曝光后辞职，其中包括一名被美国怀疑为北京从事间谍活动的女商人。

paras.en: The scandal not only sent shockwaves through the global AI and semiconductor industries, but also fueled highly contentious political debates in China and the US.
paras.zh: 该丑闻不仅给全球人工智能和半导体行业带来冲击，还引发了中美两国极具争议的政治辩论。

paras.en: Washington, which sees its national security threatened, is said to be planning further restrictions against China to close loopholes that allow Chinese firms to acquire advanced American semiconductors.
paras.zh: 华盛顿认为其国家安全受到威胁，据说正在计划对中国实施进一步限制，以堵住允许中国企业获取先进美国半导体的漏洞。

paras.en: China, on the other hand, denied it engaged in an attempt to ensnare Huang, saying the spying allegations were unsubstantiated and a smear campaign against Beijing.
paras.zh: 另一方面，中国否认试图诱捕黄，称间谍指控未经证实，是针对北京的抹黑活动。

paras.en: Beijing also stepped up its rhetoric ahead of the meeting between President Xi Jinping and Trump at this week's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 在中国国家主席习近平和特朗普本周在中国南方城市深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会上会晤之前，北京方面也加强了言论。

paras.en: "China has consistently opposed the misuse of export control measures that jeopardize the stability of global industrial and supply chains, as this is not in the interest of either party," Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said on November 13.
paras.zh: 中国外交部发言人毛宁11月13日表示，中方一贯反对滥用出口管制措施，损害全球产业链供应链稳定，这不符合任何一方的利益。

paras.en: Some Chinese media outlets have also criticized the reporting on the issue.
paras.zh: 一些中国媒体也批评了有关问题的报道。

paras.en: "Jensen Huang cheated on his wife. What does that have to do with China?" asked China's state-run Global Times newspaper in an editorial.
paras.zh: “黄仁勋出轨了，这和中国有什么关系？”中国官方报纸《环球时报》在一篇社论中问道。

paras.en: It accused the US media of turning the affair into a "Hollywood thriller" but without providing the "hard evidence to back up the central allegations."
paras.zh: 它指责美国媒体将这件事变成了“好莱坞惊悚片”，但却没有提供“支持核心指控的确凿证据”。

paras.en: Many Chinese have also taken to the microblogging and social media platform Weibo to comment on the controversy.
paras.zh: 许多中国人也在微博和社交媒体平台微博上对这一争议发表评论。

paras.en: A user wrote that Huang's downfall was, in essence, "the result of political maneuvering within the United States," while another user asked: "Could a love affair really cause Mr. Huang to resign? Isn't this plot a little too melodramatic?"
paras.zh: 有网友写道，黄先生的垮台本质上是“美国内部政治操纵的结果”，而另一位网友则问道：“黄先生真的会因恋情而辞职吗？这个情节是不是有点太戏剧化了？”

paras.en: Behind the verbal sparring lies an economic calculation.
paras.zh: 言语争吵的背后，隐藏着经济算计。

paras.en: Ding, the Chinese vice premier, has to decide whether China should continue to rely on US chips or back its domestic industry in the hope that it can achieve the breakthrough needed to surpass American competitors.
paras.zh: 中国副总理丁俊晖必须决定中国是否应该继续依赖美国芯片，还是支持国内产业，以期实现超越美国竞争对手所需的突破。

paras.en: Around 600,000 Nvidia H200 chips, for instance, are currently sitting in Hong Kong, awaiting Chinese import approval.
paras.zh: 例如，大约 60 万个 Nvidia H200 芯片目前存放在香港，等待中国的进口批准。

paras.en: The White House has already given the green light, but Beijing has yet to approve the imports.
paras.zh: 白宫已经批准了进口，但北京尚未批准进口。

paras.en: For Karson Elmgren, research manager at the Institute for AI Policy and Strategy in Washington, that is puzzling. "To me, this suggests that China does not view short-term advantages as decisive and is confident in its ability to replace US chips over the medium term."
paras.zh: 对于华盛顿人工智能政策与战略研究所的研究经理卡森·埃尔姆格伦来说，这令人费解。 “对我来说，这表明中国并不认为短期优势具有决定性，并且对其在中期内取代美国芯片的能力充满信心。”

paras.en: Chinese AI products are also increasingly using "Made in China" chips.
paras.zh: 中国的人工智能产品也越来越多地使用“中国制造”的芯片。

paras.en: "This effectively mitigates the risks of cyberattacks by foreign actors," wrote Tiantian Wang of the Harbin Institute of Technology in a recent study on China's semiconductor strategy.
paras.zh: 哈尔滨工业大学的王甜甜在最近关于中国半导体战略的研究中写道：“这有效地降低了外国行为者网络攻击的风险。”

paras.en: This is the case not only to civilian sectors. "Against the backdrop of the current complex geopolitical situation, strengthening autonomy and control over national defense and critical infrastructure has become a core element of the national security strategy," Wang explained.
paras.zh: 不仅民用部门的情况如此。 “在当前复杂的地缘政治形势下，加强国防和关键基础设施的自主可控已成为国家安全战略的核心内容。”

paras.en: According to her, for example, the radar systems in China's fifth-generation Chengdu J-20 fighter jet and in the Dongfeng-41 intercontinental ballistic missile are equipped exclusively with Chinese chips.
paras.zh: 她举例说，中国第五代成都歼20战斗机和东风41洲际弹道导弹的雷达系统都完全配备了中国芯片。

paras.en: China is increasingly focused on autonomous AI chip platforms developed domestically, Wang underscored.
paras.zh: 王强调，中国越来越关注国内开发的自主人工智能芯片平台。

paras.en: "This has created a closed ecosystem that encompasses data, algorithms, computing power, and chips, thereby reducing systemic dependence on foreign chips such as Nvidia," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充道：“这创建了一个包含数据、算法、计算能力和芯片的封闭生态系统，从而减少了对英伟达等外国芯片的系统性依赖。”

paras.en: China lacks advanced chip-making equipment
paras.zh: 中国缺乏先进的芯片制造设备

paras.en: However, China still lacks production equipment for state-of-the-art chips.
paras.zh: 然而，中国仍然缺乏最先进芯片的生产设备。

paras.en: Chip manufacturing requires lithography systems that expose raw silicon materials to ultraviolet light.
paras.zh: 芯片制造需要将原始硅材料暴露在紫外线下的光刻系统。

paras.en: Bowing to pressure from Washington, the Dutch maker of lithography machines, ASML, has stopped exporting its most advanced machines to China.
paras.zh: 迫于华盛顿的压力，荷兰光刻机制造商ASML已停止向中国出口其最先进的设备。

paras.en: The ban helps secure the US's technological lead in AI chips, said the Center for Technology & Statecraft, a Washington-based think tank. If China were to import additional ASML systems like it did in 2024 and 2025, "its annual production could be sufficient to wipe out much of the US lead and, under certain scenarios, even surpass it."
paras.zh: 华盛顿智库技术与治国中心表示，这项禁令有助于确保美国在人工智能芯片方面的技术领先地位。如果中国像2024年和2025年那样进口更多的ASML系统，“其年产量可能足以消除美国的大部分领先优势，在某些情况下甚至会超过美国。”

paras.en: According to the international consulting firm Deloitte, China is planning further extensive investments. "The focus is on supporting companies through long-term capital provision and research-oriented incentives to build sustainable innovation in key technologies."
paras.zh: 据国际咨询公司德勤称，中国正计划进一步进行大规模投资。 “重点是通过长期资本提供和以研究为导向的激励措施来支持公司在关键技术上建立可持续创新。”

paras.en: Policymakers aim to stabilize the entire supply chain, expand self-sufficiency, and actively manage risks, the study noted. "The focus is shifting from supporting individual companies to fostering synergies within the supply chain, establishing quality systems, and ensuring the secure management of critical resources in order to promote the development of a more resilient industrial organizational structure."
paras.zh: 研究指出，政策制定者的目标是稳定整个供应链、扩大自给自足并积极管理风险。 “重点正从支持个体企业转向培育供应链内的协同效应、建立质量体系、确保关键资源的安全管理，以促进更具弹性的产业组织结构的发展。”

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: Photos: California residents gather to watch massive El Nino-fuelled waves

paras.en: Residents have flocked to the waterfront in coastal towns across California to watch giant waves brought on by a potentially historic El Nino climate pattern.
paras.zh: 居民纷纷涌向加州沿海城镇的海滨，观看潜在的历史性厄尔尼诺气候模式带来的巨浪。

paras.en: For days, heavy surf has pounded the West Coast of the United States, slamming into piers and inundating coastal areas.
paras.zh: 连日来，猛烈的海浪袭击了美国西海岸，冲击码头并淹没沿海地区。

paras.en: The National Weather Service (NWS) said on Monday that a Pacific storm is expected to bring further rain and snowfall to the western US this week.
paras.zh: 美国国家气象局（NWS）周一表示，预计太平洋风暴本周将给美国西部带来更多降雨和降雪。

paras.en: A day earlier, the weather service issued a high surf advisory for all beaches along the Pacific Coast, forecasting waves to break as high as 10.7 metres, or 35 feet.
paras.zh: 一天前，气象部门向太平洋沿岸所有海滩发布了高浪警告，预测海浪将高达 10.7 米（35 英尺）。

paras.en: “Stay out of the water, stay off rocks and jetties, and never turn your back on the ocean,” the NWS added, citing the risk of “sneaker waves” — powerful surges of water that can reach higher than expected on a beach, only to pull back into the ocean with potentially deadly force.
paras.zh: “远离水面，远离岩石和码头，永远不要背对大海，”国家气象局补充道，并提到了“运动鞋波浪”的风险——强大的水流可以达到海滩上比预期更高的高度，但最终会以潜在的致命力量拉回海洋。

paras.en: Despite the warnings, big-wave watchers gathered at famed lookout points like Mavericks Beach in northern California’s Half Moon Bay.
paras.zh: 尽管有警告，巨浪观察者还是聚集在著名的观景点，例如加州北部半月湾的 Mavericks 海滩。

paras.en: Mavericks is considered one of the premier big-wave surfing spots in North America, with water cresting as high as a five-storey building. Surfers from across the world have descended on the beach in recent days to catch swells reaching approximately 18 metres, or 60 feet.
paras.zh: Mavericks 被认为是北美首屈一指的大浪冲浪点之一，浪高高达五层楼。最近几天，来自世界各地的冲浪者纷纷涌向海滩，捕捉高达 18 米（60 英尺）的海浪。

paras.en: Some of the offshore waves have been so strong that they were detected by the Berkeley Seismology Lab, which wrote about the phenomenon on its blog.
paras.zh: 一些离岸波浪非常强烈，以至于伯克利地震实验室检测到了它们，并在其博客上写下了这一现象。

paras.en: “A few miles offshore, there are no beaches for the waves to hit, but their bottoms bang into the continental shelf, where the shallow coastal waters drop off sharply into deeper ocean regions,” the lab explained.
paras.zh: 该实验室解释说：“在离岸几英里的地方，没有可供海浪撞击的海滩，但它们的底部会撞到大陆架上，那里的浅沿海水域急剧下降到更深的海洋区域。”

paras.en: “This impact is strong enough to make all of California shake. In fact, it makes the entire continent wiggle a little.”
paras.zh: “这种冲击力足以让整个加州都摇晃起来。事实上，它让整个大陆都有点摇晃。”

paras.en: While it is typical for California to experience storms in November and December, this year’s heavy rainfall and powerful surf have been turbocharged by a climate phenomenon known as El Nino.
paras.zh: 虽然加利福尼亚州在 11 月和 12 月经历风暴是很常见的，但今年的强降雨和强大的海浪因厄尔尼诺气候现象而加剧。

paras.en: The El Nino pattern occurs when the recurrent warming of the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean releases heat into the atmosphere. Already, experts say ocean temperatures off of California are reaching record levels for this time of year, making the water feel warmer than normal.
paras.zh: 当东部热带太平洋反复变暖向大气中释放热量时，就会发生厄尔尼诺现象。专家表示，加利福尼亚州附近的海洋温度已经达到一年中这个时候的创纪录水平，使海水感觉比平时温暖。

paras.en: El Nino can also alter weather patterns around the world. Scientists and state officials expect an especially strong El Nino this year to result in heavy rain for California in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象还会改变世界各地的天气模式。科学家和州政府官员预计，今年特别强烈的厄尔尼诺现象将在未来几周内给加州带来大雨。

paras.en: “The odds of an unusually wet, and perhaps exceptionally wet, second half of November continue to rise in California,” climate scientist Daniel Swain said in a social media post.
paras.zh: 气候科学家丹尼尔·斯温（Daniel Swain）在社交媒体帖子中表示：“加州 11 月下半月出现异常潮湿，甚至可能异常潮湿的可能性继续上升。”

articles.title: Sudanese army air attack kills 13 in western Sudan: Rights group

paras.en: An air strike launched by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) has killed at least 13 civilians in the Abu Qalb area of West Kordofan state, according to the Emergency Lawyers rights group.
paras.zh: 据紧急律师人权组织称，苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 发动的空袭已造成西科尔多凡州阿布盖尔布地区至少 13 名平民死亡。

paras.en: Warplanes belonging to the military government carried out the attack on the Abu Zabad locality, with the victims including women and children, “according to preliminary monitoring” the legal collective said in a social media post on Monday. Al Jazeera was unable to immediately verify the report.
paras.zh: 该法律团体周一在社交媒体上发帖称，“根据初步监测”，属于军政府的战机对阿布扎巴德地区发动了袭击，受害者包括妇女和儿童。半岛电视台无法立即核实该报道。

paras.en: Several homes were also destroyed in the strike, which took place the previous day, Emergency Lawyers said. The group, which documents human rights violations and crimes in the war between the SAF and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), cited videos circulating of “horrific scenes” of destruction.
paras.zh: 紧急律师说，前一天发生的罢工还摧毁了几所房屋。该组织记录了苏丹武装部队和准军事快速支援部队（RSF）之间战争中的侵犯人权行为和犯罪行为，并引用了流传的“可怕的破坏场景”视频。

paras.en: “The continued use of indiscriminate airstrikes on residential areas poses a direct threat to civilian lives and constitutes a grave violation of the rules of international humanitarian law,” it said in its statement.
paras.zh: 声明称，“继续对居民区进行不分青红皂白的空袭，对平民生命构成直接威胁，严重违反国际人道法规则。”

paras.en: Mohamed Didan, the official spokesperson for the Special Operations Forces that fight alongside the SAF, said on Facebook that his troops had moved through Abu Zabad and “eliminated” RSF positions in West Kordofan.
paras.zh: 与苏丹武装部队并肩作战的特种作战部队官方发言人穆罕默德·迪丹在脸书上表示，他的部队已穿过阿布扎巴德，并“消灭”了无国界医生组织在西科尔多凡的阵地。
